/-!
ZF from the quotient interface `KQHyp.QHyp`.

The bisimulation quotient of a `QHyp` structure satisfies the six `ZFAxioms` fields (infinity
through `InductiveAttempts.ordinary_infinity_of_container` from an empty set in a singleton-closed
set), exact power sets, and closure of the internally well-founded part (`wf_closure`, from the
quotient's collection). Its well-founded part is then a model of ZF with Foundation
(`WFModel.domain_models_ZF`), so ZF has no refutation (`zf_consistent`).
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KQ1ZF

open KQHyp WellFoundedPart WFModel SingletonInfinity

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

theorem base (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : QHyp mem) :
    FiniteSets.Base (KQ1Model.quotientMember mem witness h) where
  ext := KQ1Model.quotient_extensional mem witness h
  pair := KQ1Basic.quotient_pair mem witness h
  sep := KQ1Separation.quotient_separation mem witness h
  union := KQ1Basic.quotient_union mem witness h

theorem zfAxioms (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : QHyp mem) :
    ZFAxioms (KQ1Model.quotientMember mem witness h) where
  ext := KQ1Model.quotient_extensional mem witness h
  sep := KQ1Separation.quotient_separation mem witness h
  pair := KQ1Basic.quotient_pair mem witness h
  union := KQ1Basic.quotient_union mem witness h
  inf := by
    obtain ⟨Y, ⟨e, heY, he⟩, hY⟩ := KQ1Basic.quotient_empty_singleton_container mem witness h
    exact InductiveAttempts.ordinary_infinity_of_container (base mem witness h)
      (KQ1Replacement.quotient_replacement mem witness h) e he Y heY
      (closed_of_exact_singletons (base mem witness h).toBase Y hY)
  repl := KQ1Replacement.quotient_replacement mem witness h

theorem closedWF (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : QHyp mem) :
    ClosedWF (KQ1Model.quotientMember mem witness h) := fun a ha =>
  wf_closure (base mem witness h) a (KQ1Collect.quotient_fullGIC mem witness h witnessForm (fun _ => a)) ha

theorem nonempty (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : QHyp mem) :
    Nonempty (Domain (KQ1Model.quotientMember mem witness h)) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := KQ1Basic.quotient_empty mem witness h
  exact ⟨⟨e, wf_empty (base mem witness h) e he⟩⟩

/-- **A `QHyp` structure refutes no ZF proof of falsity.** -/
theorem zf_consistent (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : QHyp mem) :
    ¬ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot := by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := nonempty mem witness h
  intro hf
  exact soundness_BProv hf (fun _ => x)
    (domain_models_ZF (zfAxioms mem witness h) (closedWF mem witness h)
      (KQ1Power.quotient_power mem witness h) (fun _ => x))
    (fun _ hNil => by cases hNil)

#print axioms zf_consistent

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KQ1ZF

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.KSeedInterface222

/-!
Direct full seed models from the named theory used by `c222_complete`.

Implements the previously uncompiled fresh-label proposal in
`verification/k215/simplification/proposals/sharing-interfaces/calculus/DIRECT_FULL_SEED.md`,
following the analogous Rocq `rocq224/src/Complete222.v` construction.
The semantic matrix keeps literal equality; its interpreted code is used only
to prove derivability and choose a fresh container label.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KSeed222

open Tarski Code254 KCode222 NF BundleSemantics

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- Every free name is strictly smaller than the code of its formula. -/
theorem free_lt_enc : ∀ (f : NF) (i : Nat), NF.Free i f → i < enc f
  | .rel a b, i, h => by
      have ha := le_P_left a b
      have hb := le_P_right a b
      simp only [NF.Free, enc, wel] at *
      omega
  | .eq a b, i, h => by
      have ha := le_P_left a b
      have hb := le_P_right a b
      simp only [NF.Free, enc, weq] at *
      omega
  | .bot, _, h => h.elim
  | .imp a b, i, h => by
      have ha := le_P_left (enc a) (enc b)
      have hb := le_P_right (enc a) (enc b)
      rcases h with h | h
      · have := free_lt_enc a i h
        change i < 4 * P (enc a) (enc b)
        omega
      · have := free_lt_enc b i h
        change i < 4 * P (enc a) (enc b)
        omega
  | .all a f, i, h => by
      have := free_lt_enc f i h.2
      have := le_P_right a (enc f)
      change i < 4 * P a (enc f) + 2
      omega

/-- Equality interpretation preserves each free name. -/
theorem free_th : ∀ (f : NF) (i : Nat), NF.Free i f → NF.Free i (KEind222.th f)
  | .rel _ _, _, h => h
  | .eq a b, i, h => by
      have ha := KEind222.aux_ne_l a b
      have hb := KEind222.aux_ne_r a b
      simp only [KEind222.th, KEind222.Eind, KEind222.Ev, KEind222.wa,
        KEind222.Bin, KEind222.Bout, KEind222.biff, NF.neg, NF.Free]
      rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
  | .bot, _, h => h.elim
  | .imp a b, i, h => h.elim (fun h => Or.inl (free_th a i h))
      (fun h => Or.inr (free_th b i h))
  | .all a f, i, h => ⟨h.1, free_th f i h.2⟩

theorem th_bundleNF (a b k : Nat) (m : NF) :
    KEind222.th (bundleNF a b k m) = bundleNF a b k (KEind222.th m) := by
  simp only [bundleNF, closNF, reqNF, negNF, KEind222.th]

/-- Updating a name absent from the free support does not affect satisfaction. -/
theorem sat_update_fresh (mem : V → V → Prop) (m : NF) {k : Nat}
    (hfresh : ¬ NF.Free k m) (e : Nat → V) (d : V) :
    Tarski.Sat mem (update e k d) m ↔ Tarski.Sat mem e m := by
  apply sat_ext
  intro n hn
  exact update_other e d (fun h => hfresh (h ▸ hn))

theorem named_req_iff (mem : V → V → Prop) (E : Nat → V) (b k : Nat)
    (hkb : k ≠ b) (m : NF) :
    Tarski.Sat mem E (reqNF b k m) ↔
      ∀ y, Tarski.Sat mem (update E b y) m →
        ∃ z, Tarski.Sat mem (update E b z) m ∧ mem z (E k) := by
  simp only [reqNF, negNF, Tarski.Sat, update_idem, update_same,
    update_other _ _ hkb]
  exact forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr_right fun _ => neg_forall_imp _ _

theorem named_clos_iff (mem : V → V → Prop) (E : Nat → V)
    (a b k : Nat) (hab : a ≠ b) (hka : k ≠ a) (hkb : k ≠ b) (m : NF) :
    Tarski.Sat mem E (closNF a b k m) ↔
      ∀ y, mem y (E k) → ∃ x,
        Tarski.Sat mem (update (update E a x) b y) m ∧
        ∀ x', (∀ w, mem w x' → mem w y) →
          ∀ y', Tarski.Sat mem (update (update E a x') b y') m →
            ∃ z, Tarski.Sat mem (update (update E a x') b z) m ∧ mem z (E k) := by
  simp only [closNF, negNF, Tarski.Sat, named_req_iff mem _ b k hkb,
    update_same, update_other _ _ hka, update_other _ _ hkb,
    update_other _ _ (Ne.symm hka), update_other _ _ (Ne.symm hkb),
    update_other _ _ (Ne.symm hab), update_idem]
  simp only [update_swap _ hab, update_idem]
  exact forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr_right fun _ => neg_forall_imp _ _

/-- Named bundle semantics needs freshness, but no irreflexivity assumption. -/
theorem named_bundle_iff_seed (mem : V → V → Prop) (e : Nat → V)
    (a b k : Nat) (hab : a ≠ b) (hka : k ≠ a) (hkb : k ≠ b)
    (m : NF) (hfresh : ¬ NF.Free k m) :
    Tarski.Sat mem e (bundleNF a b k m) ↔
      SeedProp mem (fun x y => Tarski.Sat mem (update (update e a x) b y) m) (e a) := by
  have hRV : Tarski.Sat mem e (imp (rel a b) (all k (rel a b))) := by
    simp only [Tarski.Sat, update_other _ _ (Ne.symm hka),
      update_other _ _ (Ne.symm hkb)]
    exact fun h _ => h
  change (¬ (Tarski.Sat mem e (imp (rel a b) (all k (rel a b))) →
    Tarski.Sat mem e (all k (imp (closNF a b k m) (negNF (reqNF b k m)))))) ↔ _
  simp only [hRV, true_implies]
  change (¬ ∀ C, Tarski.Sat mem (update e k C) (closNF a b k m) →
    ¬ Tarski.Sat mem (update e k C) (reqNF b k m)) ↔ _
  rw [neg_forall_imp]
  unfold SeedProp
  apply exists_congr
  intro C
  rw [named_clos_iff mem _ a b k hab hka hkb, named_req_iff mem _ b k hkb]
  simp only [update_swap _ hka, update_swap _ hkb,
    sat_update_fresh mem m hfresh, update_same, update_self]
  exact and_comm

/-- The derivable named theory gives the full seed property on its original domain. -/
theorem seed_direct (mem : V → V → Prop)
    (hT : ∀ f, DerivableNF f → ∀ e : Nat → V, Tarski.Sat mem e f)
    (ψ : NF) (e : Nat → V) :
    SeedProp mem (fun x y => Tarski.Sat mem (update (update e 0 x) 1 y) ψ) (e 0) := by
  let m := negNF (negNF ψ)
  let k := enc (KEind222.th m)
  have hbig : 1 < k := by
    have h := le_P_right (enc (KEind222.th (negNF ψ))) F
    change 1 < 4 * P (enc (KEind222.th (negNF ψ))) F
    unfold F at h ⊢
    omega
  have hfresh : ¬ NF.Free k m := fun h =>
    Nat.lt_irrefl k (free_lt_enc _ k (free_th m k h))
  have hB : DerivableNF (bundleNF 0 1 k m) := by
    unfold DerivableNF
    rw [th_bundleNF]
    change C222 (enc (bundleNF 0 1 (enc (KEind222.th m)) (KEind222.th m)))
    rw [enc_bundleNF]
    exact C222.bundle 0 1 k (by omega) (by omega)
  have hs := (named_bundle_iff_seed mem e 0 1 k (by omega)
    (by omega) (by omega) m hfresh).mp (hT _ hB e)
  apply (seedProp_congr mem (e 0) (Q := fun x y =>
    Tarski.Sat mem (update (update e 0 x) 1 y) m) (fun x y => ?_)).mp hs
  simp only [m, negNF, Tarski.Sat]
  exact ⟨fun h => Classical.byContradiction fun hn => h hn, fun h hn => hn h⟩

#print axioms named_bundle_iff_seed
#print axioms seed_direct

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KSeed222

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KIndisc222
open Tarski KSeed222
universe u

theorem fullSeed_direct_of_derivable {V : Type u} (mem : V → V → Prop)
    (hirr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x)
    (hT : ∀ f, DerivableNF f → ∀ e : Nat → V, Tarski.Sat mem e f) : FullSeed mem :=
  ⟨hirr, seed_direct mem hT⟩

#print axioms fullSeed_direct_of_derivable
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KIndisc222

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.KSeed222
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.KEind222

/-! Shared named seed syntax and semantic interface. Definitions are moved unchanged
from KSeedModel222 and KIndisc222 so the direct and optional quotient routes use
exactly the same public constants. -/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KSeed222
open Tarski Code254 KCode222 NF

/-- The bundle as a named formula with container `k` and matrix `m`. -/
def negNF (x : NF) : NF := imp x NF.bot

def reqNF (b k : Nat) (m : NF) : NF := all b (imp m (negNF (all b (imp m (negNF (rel b k))))))

def closNF (a b k : Nat) (m : NF) : NF :=
  all b (imp (rel b k) (negNF (all a (imp m (negNF (all a (imp (all k (imp (rel k a) (rel k b)))
    (reqNF b k m))))))))

def bundleNF (a b k : Nat) (m : NF) : NF :=
  negNF (imp (imp (rel a b) (all k (rel a b))) (all k (imp (closNF a b k m) (negNF (reqNF b k m)))))

theorem enc_bundleNF (a b : Nat) (m : NF) : enc (bundleNF a b (enc m) m) = bundle222 a b (enc m) := by
  simp only [bundleNF, closNF, reqNF, negNF, enc, bundle222, nks, clos, req, vrel, wn]

/-- Named formulas whose interpreted codes are derivable in the 222/221 calculus. -/
def DerivableNF (f : NF) : Prop := C222 (enc (KEind222.th f))

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KSeed222

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KIndisc222
open Tarski KSeed222
universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- The seed property for every named relation, with input name `0` and output name `1`. -/
structure FullSeed (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop where
  irr : ∀ x, ¬ mem x x
  seed : ∀ (ψ : NF) (e : Nat → V),
    SeedProp mem (fun x y => Tarski.Sat mem (update (update e 0 x) 1 y) ψ) (e 0)

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.KIndisc222

/-! Actual formula-indexed Replacement in the CP/GIC bisimulation quotient (`KQ1Replacement`). -/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientReplacement

open Form ProfileCollection ProfileComposition ProfileAxioms ProfileModel CompositionModel
open DeepPositiveClosure

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

abbrev replacementChoiceForm := KQ1Replacement.replacementChoiceForm

theorem equalityFree_replacementChoiceForm (phi : Form) :
    EqualityFree (replacementChoiceForm phi) :=
  KQ1Replacement.equalityFree_replacementChoiceForm phi

theorem sat_replacementChoiceForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form)
    (a : V) (env : Nat → V) (x y : V) :
    MatrixRelation mem (replacementChoiceForm phi) (scons a env) x y ↔
      ReplacementChoice mem a
        (fun u v => QuotientModel.RelSat mem (scons v (scons u env)) phi) x y :=
  KQ1Replacement.sat_replacementChoiceForm mem phi a env x y

theorem replacement_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (h : ModelsGIC mem)
    (a : V) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (ReplacementChoice mem a
      (fun x y => QuotientModel.RelSat mem (scons y (scons x env)) phi)) :=
  KQ1Replacement.replacement_instance mem h a phi env

/-- Partial functionality on the interpreted domain suffices for this image. -/
theorem interpreted_replacement (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) (a : V) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V)
    (hFunctional : ∀ x y z, Member mem x a →
      QuotientModel.RelSat mem (scons y (scons x env)) phi →
      QuotientModel.RelSat mem (scons z (scons x env)) phi → Eqv mem y z) :
    ∃ b, ∀ z, Member mem z b ↔ ∃ x, Member mem x a ∧
      QuotientModel.RelSat mem (scons z (scons x env)) phi :=
  KQ1Replacement.interpreted_replacement mem witness (QuotientModel.ofCPGIC mem witness h)
    a phi env hFunctional

/-- Formula relations under any quotient valuation agree with their lifted
interpretations; source slot0 is output and slot1 is input. -/
theorem quotient_relOf (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (phi : Form) (env : Nat → QuotientModel.Domain mem witness h) (x y : V) :
    relOf (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h) phi env
      (QuotientModel.mk mem witness h y) (QuotientModel.mk mem witness h x) ↔
    QuotientModel.RelSat mem
      (scons y (scons x (QuotientSeparation.liftEnv mem witness h env))) phi :=
  KQ1Replacement.quotient_relOf mem witness (QuotientModel.ofCPGIC mem witness h) phi env x y

/-- The full quotient satisfies the actual semantic `ZFAxioms.repl` interface. -/
theorem quotient_replacement (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (phi : Form) (env : Nat → QuotientModel.Domain mem witness h)
    (hFunctional : Functional (relOf (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h) phi env))
    (a : QuotientModel.Domain mem witness h) :
    ∃ b, ∀ y, QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h y b ↔
      ∃ x, QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h x a ∧
        relOf (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h) phi env y x :=
  KQ1Replacement.quotient_replacement mem witness (QuotientModel.ofCPGIC mem witness h)
    phi env hFunctional a

/-- Every repository Replacement formula holds under every quotient valuation. -/
theorem quotient_repl_form (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∀ phi env, SetTheory.Sat (QuotientModel.quotientMember mem witness h) env (Repl_form phi) :=
  KQ1Replacement.quotient_repl_form mem witness (QuotientModel.ofCPGIC mem witness h)

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientReplacement

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfilePairs
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.PositiveClosure

/-!
Equality-free profile-pair existence and diagonal bisimulations.

Each collection assumption names one explicit semantic relation instance.
The profile predicates use no actual equality or profile-congruence axiom.
This file does not yet represent those instances in first-order syntax or
prove a whole-theory interpretation. In particular, bisimulation
transitivity and quotient Extensionality remain separate obligations.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileCollection

open Profile ProfilePairs

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- The global-image collection witness; it may choose one output per input. -/
def ImageCollection (mem : V → V → Prop) (r : V → V → Prop) (a b : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ y, mem y b → ∃ x, r x y) ∧
  (∀ x, mem x a → (∃ y, r x y) → ∃ y, mem y b ∧ r x y)

def CollectionInstance (mem : V → V → Prop) (r : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, ∃ b, ImageCollection mem r a b

def Containers (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, ∃ v, mem a v ∧ PositiveClosure.Transitive mem v ∧
    ∀ x, mem x v → ∃ p, mem p v ∧ ∀ z, PositiveClosure.Sub mem z x → mem z p

theorem empty_of_collection (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (fun _ _ => False)) :
    ∃ e, ∀ z, ¬ mem z e := by
  obtain ⟨e, hs, _⟩ := hCollect witness
  exact ⟨e, fun z hz => (hs z hz).elim fun _ h => h⟩

/-- An empty object and its power bound give distinct input profiles in one host. -/
theorem two_indices_of_container (mem : V → V → Prop) (e : V)
    (hEmpty : ∀ z, ¬ mem z e) (hContainers : Containers mem) :
    ∃ domain j, mem e domain ∧ mem j domain ∧ ¬ Same mem e j := by
  obtain ⟨domain, he, _, hp⟩ := hContainers e
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hBound⟩ := hp e he
  have hej : mem e j := hBound e (PositiveClosure.sub_refl mem e)
  exact ⟨domain, j, he, hj, fun hSame => hEmpty e ((hSame e).mpr hej)⟩

def PairChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (i j a b x y : V) : Prop :=
  (Same mem x i ∧ Same mem y a) ∨ (Same mem x j ∧ Same mem y b)

/-- Two distinct input profiles suffice to collect a pair of output profiles. -/
theorem pair_of_collection (mem : V → V → Prop) (i j domain a b : V)
    (hi : mem i domain) (hj : mem j domain) (hDifferent : ¬ Same mem i j)
    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (PairChoice mem i j a b)) :
    ∃ p, Pair mem p a b := by
  obtain ⟨p, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect domain
  obtain ⟨ua, hua, hia⟩ := hCover i hi
    ⟨a, Or.inl ⟨same_refl mem i, same_refl mem a⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨ub, hub, hjb⟩ := hCover j hj
    ⟨b, Or.inr ⟨same_refl mem j, same_refl mem b⟩⟩
  have huaClass : Same mem ua a := Or.elim hia And.right fun h => absurd h.1 hDifferent
  have hubClass : Same mem ub b :=
    Or.elim hjb (fun h => absurd (same_symm mem h.1) hDifferent) And.right
  refine ⟨p, fun z => ⟨?_, fun hz => hz.elim
    (fun hza => ⟨ua, hua, same_trans mem hza (same_symm mem huaClass)⟩)
    (fun hzb => ⟨ub, hub, same_trans mem hzb (same_symm mem hubClass)⟩)⟩⟩
  rintro ⟨y, hy, hzy⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hSupport y hy
  exact Or.elim hxy (fun h => Or.inl (same_trans mem hzy h.2))
    (fun h => Or.inr (same_trans mem hzy h.2))

theorem singleton_of_pair (mem : V → V → Prop) {a s : V} (h : Pair mem s a a) :
    Singleton mem s a :=
  fun z => (h z).trans ⟨fun h => h.elim id id, Or.inl⟩

theorem orderedPairs_of_pairs (mem : V → V → Prop)
    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b) (a b : V) :
    ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hPairs a a
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hPairs a b
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hPairs s p
  exact ⟨c, s, p, singleton_of_pair mem hs, hp, hc⟩

/-- Only the false and fixed four-parameter pair-choice templates are used. -/
theorem pairs_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (hContainers : Containers mem)
    (hFalse : CollectionInstance mem (fun _ _ => False))
    (hChoices : ∀ i j a b, CollectionInstance mem (PairChoice mem i j a b)) :
    ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := empty_of_collection mem witness hFalse
  obtain ⟨domain, j, hei, hj, hDifferent⟩ := two_indices_of_container mem e he hContainers
  exact fun a b => pair_of_collection mem e j domain a b hei hj hDifferent (hChoices e j a b)

def App (mem : V → V → Prop) (r x y : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ c, mem c r ∧ OrderedPair mem x y c

theorem app_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {r x y x' y' : V}
    (hx : Same mem x x') (hy : Same mem y y') (h : App mem r x y) :
    App mem r x' y' := by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hxy⟩ := h
  exact ⟨c, hc, orderedPair_endpoint_congr mem hx hy hxy⟩

def Bisim (mem : V → V → Prop) (r : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, App mem r x y →
    (∀ a, mem a x → ∃ b, mem b y ∧ App mem r a b) ∧
    (∀ b, mem b y → ∃ a, mem a x ∧ App mem r a b)

def Eqv (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ r, Bisim mem r ∧ App mem r x y

def DiagonalChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (domain x c : V) : Prop :=
  mem x domain ∧ OrderedPair mem x x c

/-- Collecting diagonal codes over one transitive container gives reflexivity.
No endpoint itself is inferred to lie in the container from profile equality;
only its literal members are transported to the represented input. -/
theorem bisim_refl_of_collection (mem : V → V → Prop) (a domain : V)
    (ha : mem a domain) (hTrans : PositiveClosure.Transitive mem domain)
    (hPairs : ∀ x y, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem x y c)
    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (DiagonalChoice mem domain)) : Eqv mem a a := by
  obtain ⟨r, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect domain
  have hDiagonal (x : V) (hx : mem x domain) : App mem r x x := by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hPairs x x
    exact (hCover x hx ⟨c, hx, hc⟩).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, h.2.2⟩
  have hShape (x y : V) (hxy : App mem r x y) :
      ∃ t, mem t domain ∧ Same mem x t ∧ Same mem y t := by
    obtain ⟨c, hcr, hxy⟩ := hxy
    obtain ⟨t, ht, htt⟩ := hSupport c hcr
    exact ⟨t, ht, orderedPair_injective mem hxy htt⟩
  refine ⟨r, fun x y hxy => ?_, hDiagonal a ha⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt, hyt⟩ := hShape x y hxy
  have hsame : Same mem x y := same_trans mem hxt (same_symm mem hyt)
  exact ⟨fun u hu => ⟨u, (hsame u).mp hu, hDiagonal u (hTrans t ht u ((hxt u).mp hu))⟩,
    fun u hu => ⟨u, (hsame u).mpr hu, hDiagonal u (hTrans t ht u ((hyt u).mp hu))⟩⟩

def ReverseChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (r d c : V) : Prop :=
  mem d r ∧ ∃ x y, OrderedPair mem x y d ∧ OrderedPair mem y x c

theorem reverse_of_collection (mem : V → V → Prop) (r : V)
    (hPairs : ∀ x y, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem x y c)
    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (ReverseChoice mem r)) :
    ∃ s, ∀ x y, App mem s x y ↔ App mem r y x := by
  obtain ⟨s, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect r
  refine ⟨s, fun x y => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, hxy⟩
    obtain ⟨d, hdr, p, q, hpq, hqp⟩ := hSupport c hc
    obtain ⟨hxq, hyp⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem hxy hqp
    exact app_congr mem (same_symm mem hyp) (same_symm mem hxq) ⟨d, hdr, hpq⟩
  · rintro ⟨d, hdr, hyx⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hxy⟩ := hPairs x y
    obtain ⟨e, hes, _, p, q, hpq, hqp⟩ := hCover d hdr ⟨c, hdr, y, x, hyx, hxy⟩
    obtain ⟨hyp, hxq⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem hyx hpq
    exact ⟨e, hes, orderedPair_endpoint_congr mem
      (same_symm mem hxq) (same_symm mem hyp) hqp⟩

theorem bisim_reverse (mem : V → V → Prop) {r s : V}
    (hr : Bisim mem r) (hReverse : ∀ x y, App mem s x y ↔ App mem r y x) :
    Bisim mem s := by
  intro x y hxy
  obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := hr y x ((hReverse x y).mp hxy)
  exact ⟨fun a ha => (hBack a ha).imp fun b h => ⟨h.1, (hReverse a b).mpr h.2⟩,
    fun b hb => (hForth b hb).imp fun a h => ⟨h.1, (hReverse a b).mpr h.2⟩⟩

/-- Symmetry uses only the explicitly named reversal relation instances. -/
theorem eqv_symm_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop)
    (hPairs : ∀ x y, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem x y c)
    (hReverse : ∀ r, CollectionInstance mem (ReverseChoice mem r))
    {x y : V} (h : Eqv mem x y) : Eqv mem y x := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hxy⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := reverse_of_collection mem r hPairs (hReverse r)
  exact ⟨s, bisim_reverse mem hr hs, (hs y x).mpr hxy⟩

#print axioms pair_of_collection
#print axioms orderedPairs_of_pairs
#print axioms bisim_refl_of_collection
#print axioms eqv_symm_of_instances

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileCollection

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileCollection

/-!
Composition of equality-free profile-coded bisimulations.

Two named GIC templates collect one composition fiber per source code;
a third forms a union up to raw profiles. This proves exact composition
at the represented App relation, without raw Separation, profile congruence,
literal representative selection or closure for arbitrary semantic relations.
These are semantic per-instance lemmas; first-order syntax adapters and
whole-theory/machine calibration are separate obligations.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileComposition

open Profile ProfilePairs ProfileCollection

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- Every set lies in a transitive set: the half of `Containers` that the edge lemmas read.
(The tagged domain of the lower chain has these but no literal power containers.) -/
def TransContainers (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, ∃ v, mem a v ∧ PositiveClosure.Transitive mem v

theorem transContainers_of_containers {mem : V → V → Prop} (h : Containers mem) :
    TransContainers mem :=
  fun a => let ⟨v, hav, ht, _⟩ := h a; ⟨v, hav, ht⟩

theorem orderedPair_code_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b c d : V}
    (hcd : Same mem c d) (hc : OrderedPair mem a b c) : OrderedPair mem a b d :=
  let ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hOuter⟩ := hc; ⟨s, p, hs, hp, pair_object_congr mem hcd hOuter⟩

theorem app_object_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {r s : V}
    (hrs : Same mem r s) (a b : V) : App mem r a b ↔ App mem s a b :=
  ⟨fun ⟨c, hc, hab⟩ => ⟨c, (hrs c).mp hc, hab⟩, fun ⟨c, hc, hab⟩ => ⟨c, (hrs c).mpr hc, hab⟩⟩

def UnionChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (family x y : V) : Prop :=
  (∃ r, mem r family ∧ mem x r) ∧ Same mem y x

/-- Approximate raw Union is exact at the represented edge relation. -/
theorem union_edges_of_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (family : V)
    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family)) :
    ∃ s, ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ r, mem r family ∧ App mem r a b := by
  obtain ⟨domain, hFamily, hTrans⟩ := hContainers family
  obtain ⟨s, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect domain
  refine ⟨s, fun a b => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hcs, hcode⟩
    obtain ⟨d, ⟨r, hrFamily, hdr⟩, hcd⟩ := hSupport c hcs
    exact ⟨r, hrFamily, d, hdr, orderedPair_code_congr mem hcd hcode⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hrFamily, d, hdr, hcode⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hcs, _, hcd⟩ := hCover d (hTrans r (hTrans family hFamily r hrFamily) d hdr)
      ⟨d, ⟨r, hrFamily, hdr⟩, same_refl mem d⟩
    exact ⟨c, hcs, orderedPair_code_congr mem (same_symm mem hcd) hcode⟩

def FiberChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (r2 d c e : V) : Prop :=
  mem c r2 ∧ ∃ s t u, OrderedPair mem s t d ∧
    OrderedPair mem t u c ∧ OrderedPair mem s u e

def FiberProfile (mem : V → V → Prop) (r2 d s : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ t, OrderedPair mem a t d ∧ App mem r2 t b

/-- GIC over the second relation collects all edges composable with this code. -/
theorem fiber_of_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (r2 d : V)
    (hCodes : ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c)
    (hCollect : CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d)) :
    ∃ s, FiberProfile mem r2 d s := by
  obtain ⟨s, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hCollect r2
  refine ⟨s, fun a b => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, hes, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hcr2, p, q, u, hpq, hqu, hpu⟩ := hSupport e hes
    obtain ⟨hap, hbu⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem hab hpu
    refine ⟨q, orderedPair_endpoint_congr mem (same_symm mem hap) (same_refl mem q) hpq, ?_⟩
    exact app_congr mem (same_refl mem q) (same_symm mem hbu) ⟨c, hcr2, hqu⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, hat, c, hcr2, htb⟩
    obtain ⟨e, hae⟩ := hCodes a b
    obtain ⟨f, hfs, _, p, q, u, hpq, hqu, hpu⟩ :=
      hCover c hcr2 ⟨e, hcr2, a, t, b, hat, htb, hae⟩
    exact ⟨f, hfs, orderedPair_endpoint_congr mem
      (same_symm mem (orderedPair_injective mem hat hpq).1)
      (same_symm mem (orderedPair_injective mem htb hqu).2) hpu⟩

def CompositionChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (r1 r2 d s : V) : Prop :=
  mem d r1 ∧ FiberProfile mem r2 d s

/-- Two GIC layers plus the named approximate-union instance compose App exactly. -/
theorem composition_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (r1 r2 : V)
    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
    (hCodes : ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c)
    (hFibers : ∀ d, CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d))
    (hComposition : CollectionInstance mem (CompositionChoice mem r1 r2))
    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family)) :
    ∃ s, ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ t, App mem r1 a t ∧ App mem r2 t b := by
  obtain ⟨family, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hComposition r1
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem family hContainers (hUnions family)
  refine ⟨s, fun a b => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hab
    obtain ⟨fiber, hfFamily, habFiber⟩ := (hs a b).mp hab
    obtain ⟨d, hdr1, hFiber⟩ := hSupport fiber hfFamily
    obtain ⟨t, hat, htb⟩ := (hFiber a b).mp habFiber
    exact ⟨t, ⟨d, hdr1, hat⟩, htb⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ⟨d, hdr1, hat⟩, htb⟩
    obtain ⟨fiber, hFiber⟩ := fiber_of_instance mem r2 d hCodes (hFibers d)
    obtain ⟨selected, hSelected, _, hSelectedFiber⟩ :=
      hCover d hdr1 ⟨fiber, hdr1, hFiber⟩
    exact (hs a b).mpr ⟨selected, hSelected, (hSelectedFiber a b).mpr ⟨t, hat, htb⟩⟩

theorem bisim_composition (mem : V → V → Prop) {r1 r2 s : V}
    (h1 : Bisim mem r1) (h2 : Bisim mem r2)
    (hComp : ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ t, App mem r1 a t ∧ App mem r2 t b) :
    Bisim mem s := by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨t, hat, htb⟩ := (hComp a b).mp hab
  obtain ⟨hF1, hB1⟩ := h1 a t hat
  obtain ⟨hF2, hB2⟩ := h2 t b htb
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hF1 x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := hF2 y hy
    exact ⟨z, hz, (hComp x z).mpr ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩ := hB2 z hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hB1 y hy
    exact ⟨x, hx, (hComp x z).mpr ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩

/-- Bisimulation transitivity from the three fixed collection-template families. -/
theorem eqv_trans_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop)
    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
    (hCodes : ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c)
    (hFibers : ∀ r2 d, CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d))
    (hCompositions : ∀ r1 r2, CollectionInstance mem (CompositionChoice mem r1 r2))
    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family))
    {x y z : V} (hxy : Eqv mem x y) (hyz : Eqv mem y z) : Eqv mem x z := by
  obtain ⟨r1, h1, hxy⟩ := hxy
  obtain ⟨r2, h2, hyz⟩ := hyz
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := composition_of_instances mem r1 r2 hContainers hCodes
    (hFibers r2) (hCompositions r1 r2) hUnions
  exact ⟨s, bisim_composition mem h1 h2 hs, (hs x z).mpr ⟨y, hxy, hyz⟩⟩

theorem join_edges_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (r1 r2 : V)
    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b)
    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family)) :
    ∃ s, ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ App mem r1 a b ∨ App mem r2 a b := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hPairs r1 r2
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem p hContainers (hUnions p)
  refine ⟨s, fun a b => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hab
    obtain ⟨r, hrp, hrab⟩ := (hs a b).mp hab
    rcases (hp r).mp ⟨r, hrp, same_refl mem r⟩ with hr1 | hr2
    · exact Or.inl ((app_object_congr mem hr1 a b).mp hrab)
    · exact Or.inr ((app_object_congr mem hr2 a b).mp hrab)
  · rintro (h1 | h2)
    · obtain ⟨r, hrp, hr1⟩ := (hp r1).mpr (Or.inl (same_refl mem r1))
      exact (hs a b).mpr ⟨r, hrp, (app_object_congr mem hr1 a b).mp h1⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hrp, hr2⟩ := (hp r2).mpr (Or.inr (same_refl mem r2))
      exact (hs a b).mpr ⟨r, hrp, (app_object_congr mem hr2 a b).mp h2⟩

theorem singleton_edges (mem : V → V → Prop) (k p : V) (hp : Pair mem p k k) :
    ∀ a b, App mem p a b ↔ OrderedPair mem a b k := by
  intro a b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hcp, hab⟩
    exact orderedPair_code_congr mem (((hp c).mp ⟨c, hcp, same_refl mem c⟩).elim id id) hab
  · intro hab
    obtain ⟨c, hcp, hkc⟩ := (hp k).mpr (Or.inl (same_refl mem k))
    exact ⟨c, hcp, orderedPair_code_congr mem hkc hab⟩

theorem bisim_union_edges (mem : V → V → Prop) (family s : V)
    (hFamily : ∀ r, mem r family → Bisim mem r)
    (hUnion : ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ ∃ r, mem r family ∧ App mem r a b) :
    Bisim mem s := by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrab⟩ := (hUnion a b).mp hab
  obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := hFamily r hr a b hrab
  refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hForth x hx
    exact ⟨y, hy, (hUnion x y).mpr ⟨r, hr, hxy⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hBack y hy
    exact ⟨x, hx, (hUnion x y).mpr ⟨r, hr, hxy⟩⟩

theorem bisim_join_edges (mem : V → V → Prop) {r1 r2 s : V}
    (h1 : Bisim mem r1) (h2 : Bisim mem r2)
    (hJoin : ∀ a b, App mem s a b ↔ App mem r1 a b ∨ App mem r2 a b) :
    Bisim mem s := by
  intro a b hab
  rcases (hJoin a b).mp hab with hab1 | hab2
  · obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := h1 a b hab1
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hForth x hx
      exact ⟨y, hy, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inl hxy)⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hBack y hy
      exact ⟨x, hx, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inl hxy)⟩
  · obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := h2 a b hab2
    refine ⟨fun x hx => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hForth x hx
      exact ⟨y, hy, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inr hxy)⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hBack y hy
      exact ⟨x, hx, (hJoin x y).mpr (Or.inr hxy)⟩

def MatchChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y a r : V) : Prop :=
  mem a x ∧ ∃ b, mem b y ∧ Bisim mem r ∧ App mem r a b

def BackMatchChoice (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y b r : V) : Prop :=
  mem b y ∧ ∃ a, mem a x ∧ Bisim mem r ∧ App mem r a b

/-- Collect entire forward and backward matching bisimulations, then adjoin the root edge. -/
theorem eqv_matching_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y : V)
    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b)
    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family))
    (hForwardCollection : CollectionInstance mem (MatchChoice mem x y))
    (hBackCollection : CollectionInstance mem (BackMatchChoice mem x y))
    (hForward : ∀ a, mem a x → ∃ b, mem b y ∧ Eqv mem a b)
    (hBack : ∀ b, mem b y → ∃ a, mem a x ∧ Eqv mem a b) : Eqv mem x y := by
  obtain ⟨ff, hSupportF, hCoverF⟩ := hForwardCollection x
  obtain ⟨bf, hSupportB, hCoverB⟩ := hBackCollection y
  obtain ⟨fr, hUnionF⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem ff hContainers (hUnions ff)
  obtain ⟨br, hUnionB⟩ := union_edges_of_instance mem bf hContainers (hUnions bf)
  have hBisF : Bisim mem fr := bisim_union_edges mem ff fr (fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨a, _, b, _, hBis, _⟩ := hSupportF r hr; exact hBis) hUnionF
  have hBisB : Bisim mem br := bisim_union_edges mem bf br (fun r hr => by
    obtain ⟨b, _, a, _, hBis, _⟩ := hSupportB r hr; exact hBis) hUnionB
  obtain ⟨joined, hJoin⟩ := join_edges_of_instances mem fr br hContainers hPairs hUnions
  have hRootF : ∀ a, mem a x → ∃ b, mem b y ∧ App mem joined a b := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb, r, hr, hab⟩ := hForward a ha
    obtain ⟨selected, hSelected, _, b', hb', _, hab'⟩ :=
      hCoverF a ha ⟨r, ha, b, hb, hr, hab⟩
    exact ⟨b', hb', (hJoin a b').mpr (Or.inl
      ((hUnionF a b').mpr ⟨selected, hSelected, hab'⟩))⟩
  have hRootB : ∀ b, mem b y → ∃ a, mem a x ∧ App mem joined a b := by
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha, r, hr, hab⟩ := hBack b hb
    obtain ⟨selected, hSelected, _, a', ha', _, hab'⟩ :=
      hCoverB b hb ⟨r, hb, a, ha, hr, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a', ha', (hJoin a' b).mpr (Or.inr
      ((hUnionB a' b).mpr ⟨selected, hSelected, hab'⟩))⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := orderedPairs_of_pairs mem hPairs x y
  obtain ⟨single, hSingle⟩ := hPairs k k
  have hSingleEdges := singleton_edges mem k single hSingle
  obtain ⟨r, hRootJoin⟩ :=
    join_edges_of_instances mem joined single hContainers hPairs hUnions
  refine ⟨r, fun a b hab => ?_, (hRootJoin x y).mpr (Or.inr ((hSingleEdges x y).mpr hk))⟩
  rcases (hRootJoin a b).mp hab with hOld | hRoot
  · obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := bisim_join_edges mem hBisF hBisB hJoin a b hOld
    refine ⟨fun u hu => ?_, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, huv⟩ := hForth u hu
      exact ⟨v, hv, (hRootJoin u v).mpr (Or.inl huv)⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := hBack v hv
      exact ⟨u, hu, (hRootJoin u v).mpr (Or.inl huv)⟩
  · obtain ⟨hax, hby⟩ := orderedPair_injective mem ((hSingleEdges a b).mp hRoot) hk
    refine ⟨fun u hu => ?_, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, hv, huv⟩ := hRootF u ((hax u).mp hu)
      exact ⟨v, (hby v).mpr hv, (hRootJoin u v).mpr (Or.inl huv)⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := hRootB v ((hby v).mp hv)
      exact ⟨u, (hax u).mpr hu, (hRootJoin u v).mpr (Or.inl huv)⟩

def Member (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ u, mem u y ∧ Eqv mem x u

/-- Quotient Extensionality uses only the two explicit matching templates and App union. -/
theorem eqv_extensionality_of_instances (mem : V → V → Prop)
    (hContainers : TransContainers mem)
    (hPairs : ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b)
    (hUnions : ∀ family, CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family))
    (hForwardCollection : ∀ x y, CollectionInstance mem (MatchChoice mem x y))
    (hBackCollection : ∀ x y, CollectionInstance mem (BackMatchChoice mem x y))
    (hRefl : ∀ x, Eqv mem x x)
    (hSymm : ∀ x y, Eqv mem x y → Eqv mem y x)
    (x y : V) (hMembers : ∀ z, Member mem z x ↔ Member mem z y) : Eqv mem x y := by
  apply eqv_matching_of_instances mem x y hContainers hPairs hUnions
    (hForwardCollection x y) (hBackCollection x y)
  · exact fun a ha => (hMembers a).mp ⟨a, ha, hRefl a⟩
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hba⟩ := (hMembers b).mpr ⟨b, hb, hRefl b⟩
    exact ⟨a, ha, hSymm b a hba⟩

#print axioms union_edges_of_instance
#print axioms composition_of_instances
#print axioms eqv_trans_of_instances
#print axioms eqv_extensionality_of_instances

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileComposition

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileSyntax

/-!
The actual equality-free CP/GIC model and its first collection instances.

The schema ranges only over equality-free `SetTheory.Form` matrices and their
parameter environments. This file exhibits the particular matrices used for
empty sets, profile pairs, diagonal codes and reversed codes, connecting those
semantic lemmas to literal first-order instances. No profile congruence or
actual-equality axiom is assumed. The full interpretation remains unfinished.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileModel

open Form Profile ProfilePairs ProfileCollection ProfileSyntax DeepPositiveClosure

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

def containerForm : Form :=
  fAll (fEx (fAnd (fMem 1 0)
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 1) (fAnd (subsetForm 0 1)
      (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 2)
        (fAll (fImp (subsetForm 0 2) (fMem 0 1))))))))))

def ModelsGIC (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ phi, EqualityFree phi → ∀ env, Sat mem env (gicForm phi)

def ModelsCPGIC (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∀ env, Sat mem env containerForm) ∧ ModelsGIC mem

theorem sat_containerForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env containerForm ↔ Containers mem := by
  constructor
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨v, hav, hClosure⟩ := h a
    refine ⟨v, hav, fun x hx => (sat_subsetForm mem _ 0 1).mp (hClosure x hx).1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hpv, hBound⟩ := (hClosure x hx).2
    exact ⟨p, hpv, fun z hz => hBound z ((sat_subsetForm mem _ 0 2).mpr hz)⟩
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨v, hav, hTrans, hPower⟩ := h a
    refine ⟨v, hav, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hpv, hBound⟩ := hPower x hx
    exact ⟨(sat_subsetForm mem _ 0 1).mpr (hTrans x hx), p, hpv,
      fun z hz => hBound z ((sat_subsetForm mem _ 0 2).mp hz)⟩

theorem equalityFree_containerForm : EqualityFree containerForm :=
  ⟨True.intro, ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_subsetForm 0 1,
    ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_subsetForm 0 2, True.intro⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩

theorem collectionInstance_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) (r s : V → V → Prop)
    (h : ∀ x y, r x y ↔ s x y) (hr : CollectionInstance mem r) :
    CollectionInstance mem s := by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨b, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hr a
  exact ⟨b, fun y hy => (hSupport y hy).imp fun x => (h x y).mp, fun x hx ⟨y, hxy⟩ =>
    (hCover x hx ⟨y, (h x y).mpr hxy⟩).imp fun z hz => ⟨hz.1, (h x z).mp hz.2⟩⟩

/-- Transfer only the supplied, equality-free definable relation instance. -/
theorem instance_of_matrix (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem)
    (phi : Form) (hFree : EqualityFree phi) (env : Nat → V) (r : V → V → Prop)
    (hRep : ∀ x y, MatrixRelation mem phi env x y ↔ r x y) :
    CollectionInstance mem r :=
  collectionInstance_congr mem _ r hRep
    ((sat_gicForm mem phi env).mp (hModel phi hFree env))

theorem false_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) :
    CollectionInstance mem (fun _ _ => False) :=
  instance_of_matrix mem hModel fBot True.intro (fun _ => witness) _
    (fun _ _ => Iff.rfl)

def pairChoiceForm : Form :=
  fOr (fAnd (sameForm 0 2) (sameForm 1 4))
    (fAnd (sameForm 0 3) (sameForm 1 5))

theorem equalityFree_pairChoiceForm : EqualityFree pairChoiceForm :=
  ⟨⟨equalityFree_sameForm 0 2, equalityFree_sameForm 1 4⟩,
    ⟨equalityFree_sameForm 0 3, equalityFree_sameForm 1 5⟩⟩

theorem pairChoice_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (i j a b : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (PairChoice mem i j a b) :=
  instance_of_matrix mem hModel pairChoiceForm equalityFree_pairChoiceForm
    (scons i (scons j (scons a (fun _ => b)))) _ fun _ _ => or_congr
      (and_congr (sat_sameForm mem _ 0 2) (sat_sameForm mem _ 1 4))
      (and_congr (sat_sameForm mem _ 0 3) (sat_sameForm mem _ 1 5))

def diagonalChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem 0 2) (orderedPairForm 0 0 1)

theorem equalityFree_diagonalChoiceForm : EqualityFree diagonalChoiceForm :=
  ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_orderedPairForm 0 0 1⟩

theorem diagonal_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (domain : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (DiagonalChoice mem domain) :=
  instance_of_matrix mem hModel diagonalChoiceForm equalityFree_diagonalChoiceForm
    (fun _ => domain) _ fun _ _ => and_congr Iff.rfl (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 0 0 1)

def reverseChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem 0 2) (fEx (fEx (fAnd
    (orderedPairForm 1 0 2) (orderedPairForm 0 1 3))))

theorem equalityFree_reverseChoiceForm : EqualityFree reverseChoiceForm :=
  ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_orderedPairForm 1 0 2,
    equalityFree_orderedPairForm 0 1 3⟩⟩

theorem reverse_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (r : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (ReverseChoice mem r) :=
  instance_of_matrix mem hModel reverseChoiceForm equalityFree_reverseChoiceForm
    (fun _ => r) _ fun _ _ =>
      ⟨fun ⟨hd, x, y, hxy, hyx⟩ => ⟨hd, x, y, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 1 0 2).mp hxy,
        (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 0 1 3).mp hyx⟩,
      fun ⟨hd, x, y, hxy, hyx⟩ => ⟨hd, x, y, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 1 0 2).mpr hxy,
        (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 0 1 3).mpr hyx⟩⟩

/-- Actual first-order CP/GIC instances give the profile-pair resource. -/
theorem pairs_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∀ a b, ∃ p, Pair mem p a b :=
  pairs_of_instances mem witness
    ((sat_containerForm mem (fun _ => witness)).mp (h.1 _))
    (false_instance mem witness h.2) (pairChoice_instance mem h.2)

theorem orderedPairs_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∀ a b, ∃ c, OrderedPair mem a b c :=
  orderedPairs_of_pairs mem (pairs_of_model mem witness h)

theorem eqv_refl_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    ∀ a, Eqv mem a a := by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨domain, ha, hTrans, _⟩ :=
    ((sat_containerForm mem (fun _ => witness)).mp (h.1 _)) a
  exact bisim_refl_of_collection mem a domain ha hTrans
    (orderedPairs_of_model mem witness h) (diagonal_instance mem h.2 domain)

theorem eqv_symm_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    {x y : V} (hxy : Eqv mem x y) : Eqv mem y x :=
  eqv_symm_of_instances mem (orderedPairs_of_model mem witness h)
    (reverse_instance mem h.2) hxy

#print axioms pairs_of_model
#print axioms eqv_refl_of_model
#print axioms eqv_symm_of_model

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileModel

import FirstOrder.Fol

/-!
Profile equality for the equality-free closure kernels. This file uses the
repository's actual first-order syntax and Tarski semantics. It proves the
one-sided congruence simplification and invariance of equality-erased formulas.
It does not prove a theory interpretation or a machine consistency endpoint.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Profile

universe u
variable {V : Type u} (mem : V → V → Prop)

def Same (x y : V) : Prop := ∀ z, mem z x ↔ mem z y

def OneWay : Prop := ∀ x y, Same mem x y → ∀ z, mem x z → mem y z

def Full : Prop := ∀ x y, Same mem x y → ∀ z, mem x z ↔ mem y z

theorem same_refl (x : V) : Same mem x x := fun _ => Iff.rfl

theorem same_symm {x y : V} (h : Same mem x y) : Same mem y x :=
  fun z => (h z).symm

theorem same_trans {x y z : V} (hxy : Same mem x y) (hyz : Same mem y z) :
    Same mem x z := fun w => (hxy w).trans (hyz w)

theorem oneWay_iff_full : OneWay mem ↔ Full mem :=
  ⟨fun h x y hxy z => ⟨h x y hxy z, h y x (same_symm mem hxy) z⟩,
    fun h x y hxy z => (h x y hxy z).mp⟩

theorem mem_congr (h : OneWay mem) {x x' y y' : V}
    (hx : Same mem x x') (hy : Same mem y y') :
    mem x y ↔ mem x' y' :=
  ((oneWay_iff_full mem).mp h x x' hx y).trans (hy x')

/-- The equality-free formula saying that variables `i,j` have equal members. -/
def sameForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  .fAll (fIff (.fMem 0 (i + 1)) (.fMem 0 (j + 1)))

def eraseEquality : Form → Form
  | .fMem i j => .fMem i j
  | .fEq i j => sameForm i j
  | .fBot => .fBot
  | .fImp a b => .fImp (eraseEquality a) (eraseEquality b)
  | .fAnd a b => .fAnd (eraseEquality a) (eraseEquality b)
  | .fOr a b => .fOr (eraseEquality a) (eraseEquality b)
  | .fAll a => .fAll (eraseEquality a)
  | .fEx a => .fEx (eraseEquality a)

/-- Tarski semantics with equality interpreted as predecessor-profile equality. -/
def ProfileSat (env : Nat → V) : Form → Prop
  | .fMem i j => mem (env i) (env j)
  | .fEq i j => Same mem (env i) (env j)
  | .fBot => False
  | .fImp a b => ProfileSat env a → ProfileSat env b
  | .fAnd a b => ProfileSat env a ∧ ProfileSat env b
  | .fOr a b => ProfileSat env a ∨ ProfileSat env b
  | .fAll a => ∀ x, ProfileSat (scons x env) a
  | .fEx a => ∃ x, ProfileSat (scons x env) a

theorem sat_sameForm (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (sameForm i j) ↔ Same mem (env i) (env j) := by
  simp only [sameForm, Sat, fIff, scons, Same]
  exact ⟨fun h z => ⟨(h z).1, (h z).2⟩, fun h z => ⟨(h z).mp, (h z).mpr⟩⟩

theorem sat_eraseEquality (f : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env (eraseEquality f) ↔ ProfileSat mem env f := by
  induction f generalizing env with
  | fMem i j | fBot => rfl
  | fEq i j => exact sat_sameForm mem env i j
  | fImp a b iha ihb | fAnd a b iha ihb | fOr a b iha ihb =>
      simp only [eraseEquality, Sat, ProfileSat, iha, ihb]
  | fAll a ih | fEx a ih => simp only [eraseEquality, Sat, ProfileSat, ih]

/-- Profile-congruent assignments give the same truth value after equality erasure. -/
theorem profileSat_congr (h : OneWay mem) (f : Form) (e e' : Nat → V)
    (he : ∀ i, Same mem (e i) (e' i)) :
    ProfileSat mem e f ↔ ProfileSat mem e' f := by
  induction f generalizing e e' with
  | fMem i j => exact mem_congr mem h (he i) (he j)
  | fEq i j =>
      exact ⟨fun hij => same_trans mem (same_symm mem (he i)) (same_trans mem hij (he j)),
        fun hij => same_trans mem (he i) (same_trans mem hij (same_symm mem (he j)))⟩
  | fBot => rfl
  | fImp a b iha ihb | fAnd a b iha ihb | fOr a b iha ihb =>
      simp only [ProfileSat, iha e e' he, ihb e e' he]
  | fAll a ih =>
      have hc : ∀ x i, Same mem (scons x e i) (scons x e' i) := by
        intro x i
        cases i with
        | zero => exact same_refl mem x
        | succ i => exact he i
      simp only [ProfileSat]
      exact forall_congr' fun x => ih _ _ (hc x)
  | fEx a ih =>
      have hc : ∀ x i, Same mem (scons x e i) (scons x e' i) := by
        intro x i
        cases i with
        | zero => exact same_refl mem x
        | succ i => exact he i
      simp only [ProfileSat]
      exact exists_congr fun x => ih _ _ (hc x)

theorem sat_eraseEquality_congr (h : OneWay mem) (f : Form) (e e' : Nat → V)
    (he : ∀ i, Same mem (e i) (e' i)) :
    Sat mem e (eraseEquality f) ↔ Sat mem e' (eraseEquality f) :=
  (sat_eraseEquality mem f e).trans
    ((profileSat_congr mem h f e e' he).trans (sat_eraseEquality mem f e').symm)

#print axioms oneWay_iff_full
#print axioms sat_eraseEquality_congr

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Profile

/-!
Equality-free ordered-pair codes with endpoint uniqueness up to raw profiles.

No profile congruence, Extensionality, set existence or actual singleton axiom
is assumed. All definitions use only membership and logical connectives; Lean
equality is not part of the represented predicates. Existence of these codes
in the equality-free container/collection theory is a separate obligation.
The final bisimulation interpretation and machine calibration remain open.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfilePairs

open Profile

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- Membership saturated in its first argument by raw predecessor profiles. -/
def ClassMember (mem : V → V → Prop) (a b : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ z, mem z b ∧ Same mem a z

/-- A nonempty singleton of profile classes; literal representatives may vary. -/
def Singleton (mem : V → V → Prop) (s a : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ z, ClassMember mem z s ↔ Same mem z a

def Pair (mem : V → V → Prop) (p a b : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ z, ClassMember mem z p ↔ Same mem z a ∨ Same mem z b

def OrderedPair (mem : V → V → Prop) (a b c : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ s p, Singleton mem s a ∧ Pair mem p a b ∧ Pair mem c s p

theorem classMember_right_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b : V}
    (h : Same mem a b) (z : V) :
    ClassMember mem z a ↔ ClassMember mem z b :=
  ⟨fun ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ => ⟨t, (h t).mp ht, hzt⟩, fun ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ => ⟨t, (h t).mpr ht, hzt⟩⟩

theorem classMember_left_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b : V}
    (h : Same mem a b) (c : V) :
    ClassMember mem a c ↔ ClassMember mem b c :=
  ⟨fun ⟨t, ht, hat⟩ => ⟨t, ht, same_trans mem (same_symm mem h) hat⟩,
    fun ⟨t, ht, hbt⟩ => ⟨t, ht, same_trans mem h hbt⟩⟩

/-- Every inner member class of a Kuratowski code contains its first endpoint. -/
theorem orderedPair_first (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b c : V}
    (h : OrderedPair mem a b c) (z : V) (hz : ClassMember mem z c) :
    ClassMember mem a z := by
  obtain ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hc⟩ := h
  exact ((hc z).mp hz).elim
    (fun hzs => (classMember_right_congr mem hzs a).mpr ((hs a).mpr (same_refl mem a)))
    (fun hzp => (classMember_right_congr mem hzp a).mpr ((hp a).mpr (Or.inl (same_refl mem a))))

/-- The union of the inner member classes is exactly the two endpoint classes. -/
theorem orderedPair_union (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b c : V}
    (h : OrderedPair mem a b c) (z : V) :
    (∃ t, ClassMember mem t c ∧ ClassMember mem z t) ↔
      Same mem z a ∨ Same mem z b := by
  obtain ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨fun ⟨t, ht, hzt⟩ => ((hc t).mp ht).elim
      (fun hts => Or.inl ((hs z).mp ((classMember_right_congr mem hts z).mp hzt)))
      (fun htp => (hp z).mp ((classMember_right_congr mem htp z).mp hzt)),
    fun hz => ⟨p, (hc p).mpr (Or.inr (same_refl mem p)), (hp z).mpr hz⟩⟩

/-- Endpoint uniqueness requires only raw profiles, without profile congruence. -/
theorem orderedPair_injective (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b a' b' c : V}
    (h : OrderedPair mem a b c) (h' : OrderedPair mem a' b' c) :
    Same mem a a' ∧ Same mem b b' := by
  have hUnion (z : V) :
      (Same mem z a ∨ Same mem z b) ↔ (Same mem z a' ∨ Same mem z b') :=
    (orderedPair_union mem h z).symm.trans (orderedPair_union mem h' z)
  obtain ⟨s', _, hs', _, hc'⟩ := h'
  have hFirst : Same mem a a' :=
    (hs' a).mp (orderedPair_first mem h s' ((hc' s').mpr (Or.inl (same_refl mem s'))))
  refine ⟨hFirst, ?_⟩
  by_cases hba : Same mem b a
  · exact ((hUnion b').mpr (Or.inr (same_refl mem b'))).elim
      (fun hb'a => same_trans mem hba (same_symm mem hb'a)) (same_symm mem)
  · exact ((hUnion b).mp (Or.inr (same_refl mem b))).elim
      (fun hba' => (hba (same_trans mem hba' (same_symm mem hFirst))).elim) id

theorem singleton_object_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {s t a : V}
    (hst : Same mem s t) (hs : Singleton mem s a) : Singleton mem t a :=
  fun z => (classMember_right_congr mem hst z).symm.trans (hs z)

theorem pair_object_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {p q a b : V}
    (hpq : Same mem p q) (hp : Pair mem p a b) : Pair mem q a b :=
  fun z => (classMember_right_congr mem hpq z).symm.trans (hp z)

theorem orderedPair_code_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b c d : V}
    (hcd : Same mem c d) (h : OrderedPair mem a b c) : OrderedPair mem a b d := by
  obtain ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨s, p, hs, hp, pair_object_congr mem hcd hc⟩

/-- Codes are stable under changing either endpoint within its raw profile. -/
theorem orderedPair_endpoint_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) {a b a' b' c : V}
    (ha : Same mem a a') (hb : Same mem b b') (h : OrderedPair mem a b c) :
    OrderedPair mem a' b' c := by
  obtain ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hc⟩ := h
  have hA (z : V) : Same mem z a ↔ Same mem z a' :=
    ⟨fun hz => same_trans mem hz ha, fun hz => same_trans mem hz (same_symm mem ha)⟩
  have hB (z : V) : Same mem z b ↔ Same mem z b' :=
    ⟨fun hz => same_trans mem hz hb, fun hz => same_trans mem hz (same_symm mem hb)⟩
  exact ⟨s, p, fun z => (hs z).trans (hA z), fun z => (hp z).trans (or_congr (hA z) (hB z)), hc⟩

#print axioms orderedPair_injective
#print axioms orderedPair_endpoint_congr

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfilePairs

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileCollection
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.DeepPositiveClosure

/-!
Actual first-order syntax for the equality-free collection interpretation.

The GIC matrix uses input slot 0, output slot 1 and parameter slots 2+k.
Profile-singleton, pair and ordered-pair predicates have checked satisfaction
specifications. No logical equality is introduced by these definitions.
This is not yet the whole bisimulation interpretation or a machine theorem.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileSyntax

open Form Profile ProfilePairs ProfileCollection DeepPositiveClosure

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

def classMemberForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 (j + 1)) (sameForm (i + 1) 0))

def singletonForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fIff (classMemberForm 0 (i + 1)) (sameForm 0 (j + 1)))

def pairForm (p i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fIff (classMemberForm 0 (p + 1))
    (fOr (sameForm 0 (i + 1)) (sameForm 0 (j + 1))))

def orderedPairForm (i j c : Nat) : Form :=
  fEx (fEx (fAnd (singletonForm 1 (i + 2))
    (fAnd (pairForm 0 (i + 2) (j + 2)) (pairForm (c + 2) 1 0))))

theorem sat_classMemberForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (classMemberForm i j) ↔ ClassMember mem (env i) (env j) :=
  ⟨fun ⟨z, hz, hSame⟩ => ⟨z, hz, (sat_sameForm mem (scons z env) (i + 1) 0).mp hSame⟩,
    fun ⟨z, hz, hSame⟩ => ⟨z, hz, (sat_sameForm mem (scons z env) (i + 1) 0).mpr hSame⟩⟩

theorem sat_singletonForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (singletonForm i j) ↔ Singleton mem (env i) (env j) :=
  ⟨fun h z => (sat_classMemberForm mem (scons z env) 0 (i + 1)).symm.trans
      ((Sat_fIff.mp (h z)).trans (sat_sameForm mem (scons z env) 0 (j + 1))),
    fun h z => Sat_fIff.mpr ((sat_classMemberForm mem (scons z env) 0 (i + 1)).trans
      ((h z).trans (sat_sameForm mem (scons z env) 0 (j + 1)).symm))⟩

theorem sat_pairForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (p i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (pairForm p i j) ↔ Pair mem (env p) (env i) (env j) := by
  have hRight (z : V) := or_congr
    (sat_sameForm mem (scons z env) 0 (i + 1))
    (sat_sameForm mem (scons z env) 0 (j + 1))
  exact ⟨fun h z => (sat_classMemberForm mem (scons z env) 0 (p + 1)).symm.trans
      ((Sat_fIff.mp (h z)).trans (hRight z)),
    fun h z => Sat_fIff.mpr ((sat_classMemberForm mem (scons z env) 0 (p + 1)).trans
      ((h z).trans (hRight z).symm))⟩

theorem sat_orderedPairForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i j c : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (orderedPairForm i j c) ↔
      OrderedPair mem (env i) (env j) (env c) :=
  ⟨fun ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hc⟩ => ⟨s, p, (sat_singletonForm mem _ 1 (i + 2)).mp hs,
      (sat_pairForm mem _ 0 (i + 2) (j + 2)).mp hp, (sat_pairForm mem _ (c + 2) 1 0).mp hc⟩,
    fun ⟨s, p, hs, hp, hc⟩ => ⟨s, p, (sat_singletonForm mem _ 1 (i + 2)).mpr hs,
      (sat_pairForm mem _ 0 (i + 2) (j + 2)).mpr hp, (sat_pairForm mem _ (c + 2) 1 0).mpr hc⟩⟩

def appForm (r i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 (r + 1)) (orderedPairForm (i + 1) (j + 1) 0))

def bisimForm (r : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fAll (fImp (appForm (r + 2) 1 0) (fAnd
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 2)
      (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 2) (appForm (r + 4) 1 0)))))
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 1)
      (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 3) (appForm (r + 4) 0 1))))))))

def eqvForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fEx (fAnd (bisimForm 0) (appForm 0 (i + 1) (j + 1)))

theorem sat_appForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (r i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (appForm r i j) ↔ App mem (env r) (env i) (env j) :=
  ⟨fun ⟨c, hc, hPair⟩ => ⟨c, hc, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ (i + 1) (j + 1) 0).mp hPair⟩,
    fun ⟨c, hc, hPair⟩ => ⟨c, hc, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ (i + 1) (j + 1) 0).mpr hPair⟩⟩

theorem sat_bisimForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (r : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (bisimForm r) ↔ Bisim mem (env r) := by
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := h x y ((sat_appForm mem _ (r + 2) 1 0).mpr hxy)
    refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hEdge⟩ := hForth a ha
      exact ⟨b, hb, (sat_appForm mem _ (r + 4) 1 0).mp hEdge⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, hEdge⟩ := hBack b hb
      exact ⟨a, ha, (sat_appForm mem _ (r + 4) 0 1).mp hEdge⟩
  · intro h x y hxy
    obtain ⟨hForth, hBack⟩ := h x y ((sat_appForm mem _ (r + 2) 1 0).mp hxy)
    refine ⟨fun a ha => ?_, fun b hb => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hEdge⟩ := hForth a ha
      exact ⟨b, hb, (sat_appForm mem _ (r + 4) 1 0).mpr hEdge⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, hEdge⟩ := hBack b hb
      exact ⟨a, ha, (sat_appForm mem _ (r + 4) 0 1).mpr hEdge⟩

theorem sat_eqvForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (eqvForm i j) ↔ Eqv mem (env i) (env j) :=
  ⟨fun ⟨r, hr, hEdge⟩ => ⟨r, (sat_bisimForm mem _ 0).mp hr,
      (sat_appForm mem _ 0 (i + 1) (j + 1)).mp hEdge⟩,
    fun ⟨r, hr, hEdge⟩ => ⟨r, (sat_bisimForm mem _ 0).mpr hr,
      (sat_appForm mem _ 0 (i + 1) (j + 1)).mpr hEdge⟩⟩

/-- GIC's support and selected-image coverage, with universally closed parameters. -/
def gicForm (phi : Form) : Form :=
  fAll (fEx (fAnd
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 1) (fEx (rename supportRename phi))))
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 2)
      (fImp (fEx (rename forwardRename phi))
        (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 2) (rename forwardRename phi))))))))

theorem sat_gicForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env (gicForm phi) ↔ CollectionInstance mem (MatrixRelation mem phi env) := by
  constructor
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨b, hSupport, hCover⟩ := h a
    refine ⟨b, fun y hy => ?_, fun x hx hOutput => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hSupport y hy
      exact ⟨x, (sat_support_matrix mem phi env a b y x).mp hxy⟩
    · have hSome : Sat mem (scons x (scons b (scons a env)))
          (fEx (rename forwardRename phi)) := by
        obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hOutput
        exact ⟨y, (sat_forward_matrix mem phi env a b x y).mpr hxy⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hCover x hx hSome
      exact ⟨y, hy, (sat_forward_matrix mem phi env a b x y).mp hxy⟩
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨b, hSupport, hCover⟩ := h a
    refine ⟨b, fun y hy => ?_, fun x hx hOutput => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hSupport y hy
      exact ⟨x, (sat_support_matrix mem phi env a b y x).mpr hxy⟩
    · have hSome : ∃ y, MatrixRelation mem phi env x y := by
        obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hOutput
        exact ⟨y, (sat_forward_matrix mem phi env a b x y).mp hxy⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hCover x hx hSome
      exact ⟨y, hy, (sat_forward_matrix mem phi env a b x y).mpr hxy⟩

theorem equalityFree_sameForm (i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (sameForm i j) :=
  ⟨⟨True.intro, True.intro⟩, ⟨True.intro, True.intro⟩⟩

theorem equalityFree_classMemberForm (i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (classMemberForm i j) :=
  ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_sameForm (i + 1) 0⟩

theorem equalityFree_singletonForm (i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (singletonForm i j) :=
  ⟨⟨equalityFree_classMemberForm 0 (i + 1), equalityFree_sameForm 0 (j + 1)⟩,
    ⟨equalityFree_sameForm 0 (j + 1), equalityFree_classMemberForm 0 (i + 1)⟩⟩

theorem equalityFree_pairForm (p i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (pairForm p i j) := by
  have hRight := And.intro (equalityFree_sameForm 0 (i + 1)) (equalityFree_sameForm 0 (j + 1))
  exact ⟨⟨equalityFree_classMemberForm 0 (p + 1), hRight⟩,
    ⟨hRight, equalityFree_classMemberForm 0 (p + 1)⟩⟩

theorem equalityFree_orderedPairForm (i j c : Nat) : EqualityFree (orderedPairForm i j c) :=
  ⟨equalityFree_singletonForm 1 (i + 2),
    ⟨equalityFree_pairForm 0 (i + 2) (j + 2), equalityFree_pairForm (c + 2) 1 0⟩⟩

theorem equalityFree_appForm (r i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (appForm r i j) :=
  ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_orderedPairForm (i + 1) (j + 1) 0⟩

theorem equalityFree_bisimForm (r : Nat) : EqualityFree (bisimForm r) :=
  ⟨equalityFree_appForm (r + 2) 1 0,
    ⟨⟨True.intro, ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_appForm (r + 4) 1 0⟩⟩,
      ⟨True.intro, ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_appForm (r + 4) 0 1⟩⟩⟩⟩

theorem equalityFree_eqvForm (i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (eqvForm i j) :=
  ⟨equalityFree_bisimForm 0, equalityFree_appForm 0 (i + 1) (j + 1)⟩

theorem equalityFree_gicForm (phi : Form) (h : EqualityFree phi) :
    EqualityFree (gicForm phi) :=
  ⟨⟨True.intro, equalityFree_rename phi supportRename h⟩,
    ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_rename phi forwardRename h,
      ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_rename phi forwardRename h⟩⟩⟩⟩

#print axioms sat_orderedPairForm
#print axioms sat_gicForm
#print axioms equalityFree_orderedPairForm

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileSyntax

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SingletonInfinity
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteSets
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientReplacement

/-!
Finite attempts on the least singleton index, without an assumed omega.

The semantic lemmas expose only the particular graph and set-existence
resources used in the argument. They do not assert collection or Separation
for arbitrary semantic relations. Literal first-order formulas and finite-set
graph adapters discharge these resources in the actual CP/GIC quotient.

The backwards attempt argument is adapted from `Std_setrec.v:agree_lemma`,
`att_base`, `exist_lemma` and `closure_thm`, upstream
297ab8df7e5de329605c3875b4934643b371a5e3. Its use with singleton and von
Neumann successor is `Std_setinf.v:or_to_zf_core` in the attributed verification.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.InductiveAttempts

open SingletonInfinity

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

def Agree (app : V → V → V → Prop) (f g z : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ v w, app f z v → app g z w → v = w

def Attempt (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    (N e a f : V) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, app f e v → v = a) ∧
  ∀ z v, mem z N → app f (singleton B z) v →
    ∃ w, app f z w ∧ v = G w

def HasAttempt (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    (N e a z : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ f, Attempt B G app N e a f ∧ ∃ v, app f z v

def Value (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    (N e a z v : V) : Prop :=
  mem z N ∧ ∃ f, Attempt B G app N e a f ∧ app f z v

/-- Only the agreement predicate for these two fixed attempts is separated. -/
theorem agree_of_separator (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    {N e a f g : V} (hN : Index B e N)
    (hSep : ∃ X, ∀ z, mem z X ↔ mem z N ∧ Agree app f g z)
    (hf : Attempt B G app N e a f) (hg : Attempt B G app N e a g) :
    ∀ z, mem z N → Agree app f g z := by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := hSep
  have heX : mem e X := (hX e).mpr ⟨hN.zero_mem, fun v w hfv hgw =>
    (hf.1 v hfv).trans (hg.1 w hgw).symm⟩
  have hcX : Closed B X := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzN, hzAgree⟩ := (hX z).mp hz
    refine (hX (singleton B z)).mpr ⟨hN.closed z hzN, fun v w hfv hgw => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v0, hfv0, hv⟩ := hf.2 z v hzN hfv
    obtain ⟨w0, hgw0, hw⟩ := hg.2 z w hzN hgw
    exact hv.trans ((congrArg G (hzAgree v0 w0 hfv0 hgw0)).trans hw.symm)
  exact fun z hz => ((hX z).mp (hN.least X heX hcX z hz)).2

/-- A one-point graph is an attempt because the base has no predecessor. -/
theorem base_attempt (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    (N e a : V) (hNz : ∀ z, mem z N → singleton B z ≠ e)
    (hPoint : ∃ f, ∀ z v, app f z v ↔ z = e ∧ v = a) :
    ∃ f, Attempt B G app N e a f ∧ app f e a := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hPoint
  exact ⟨f, ⟨fun v hv => ((hf e v).mp hv).2,
    fun z v hzN hv => (hNz z hzN ((hf (singleton B z) v).mp hv).1).elim⟩, (hf e a).mpr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩

/-- Adjunction of one new graph point preserves the backwards attempt clauses. -/
theorem extend_attempt (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    {N e a f z v : V} (hNz : ∀ u, mem u N → singleton B u ≠ e)
    (hf : Attempt B G app N e a f) (hzN : mem z N) (hfv : app f z v)
    (hExtend : ∃ g, ∀ u w,
      app g u w ↔ app f u w ∨ (u = singleton B z ∧ w = G v)) :
    ∃ g, Attempt B G app N e a g ∧ app g (singleton B z) (G v) := by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hExtend
  refine ⟨g, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, (hg _ _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
  · exact fun w hw => ((hg e w).mp hw).elim (hf.1 w) fun hw => (hNz z hzN hw.1.symm).elim
  · intro u w huN hw
    rcases (hg (singleton B u) w).mp hw with hw | ⟨hu, rfl⟩
    · exact (hf.2 u w huN hw).imp fun t ⟨ht, hwt⟩ => ⟨(hg u t).mpr (Or.inl ht), hwt⟩
    · obtain rfl := singleton_injective B hu
      exact ⟨v, (hg _ v).mpr (Or.inl hfv), rfl⟩

/-- Only the fixed attempt-domain-existence predicate is separated here. -/
theorem attempts_exist_of_separator (B : Base mem) (G : V → V)
    (app : V → V → V → Prop) {N e a : V} (hN : Index B e N)
    (hNz : ∀ z, mem z N → singleton B z ≠ e)
    (hPoint : ∃ f, ∀ z v, app f z v ↔ z = e ∧ v = a)
    (hExtend : ∀ f z v, ∃ g, ∀ u w,
      app g u w ↔ app f u w ∨ (u = z ∧ w = v))
    (hSep : ∃ X, ∀ z, mem z X ↔ mem z N ∧ HasAttempt B G app N e a z) :
    ∀ z, mem z N → HasAttempt B G app N e a z := by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := hSep
  obtain ⟨f0, hf0, hfa⟩ := base_attempt B G app N e a hNz hPoint
  have heX : mem e X := (hX e).mpr ⟨hN.zero_mem, f0, hf0, a, hfa⟩
  have hcX : Closed B X := by
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨hzN, f, hf, v, hfv⟩ := (hX z).mp hz
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgv⟩ := extend_attempt B G app hNz hf hzN hfv
      (hExtend f (singleton B z) (G v))
    exact (hX (singleton B z)).mpr ⟨hN.closed z hzN, g, hg, G v, hgv⟩
  exact fun z hz => ((hX z).mp (hN.least X heX hcX z hz)).2

/-- Explicit agreement/existence cuts and one partial-functional image resource
give closure under this fixed G; no semantic all-relations schema is postulated. -/
theorem closure_of_instances (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    {N e a : V} (hN : Index B e N)
    (hNz : ∀ z, mem z N → singleton B z ≠ e)
    (hPoint : ∃ f, ∀ z v, app f z v ↔ z = e ∧ v = a)
    (hExtend : ∀ f z v, ∃ g, ∀ u w,
      app g u w ↔ app f u w ∨ (u = z ∧ w = v))
    (hAgr : ∀ f g, ∃ X, ∀ z, mem z X ↔ mem z N ∧ Agree app f g z)
    (hEx : ∃ X, ∀ z, mem z X ↔ mem z N ∧ HasAttempt B G app N e a z)
    (hImage : (∀ z v w, Value B G app N e a z v →
      Value B G app N e a z w → v = w) →
      ∃ Y, ∀ v, mem v Y ↔ ∃ z, mem z N ∧ Value B G app N e a z v) :
    ∃ Y, mem a Y ∧ ∀ v, mem v Y → mem (G v) Y := by
  have hAgree (f g : V) :=
    agree_of_separator B G app (a := a) hN (hAgr f g)
  have hExists := attempts_exist_of_separator B G app hN hNz hPoint hExtend hEx
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := hImage fun z v w ⟨hzN, f, hf, hfv⟩ ⟨_, g, hg, hgw⟩ =>
    hAgree f g hf hg z hzN v w hfv hgw
  obtain ⟨f0, hf0, hfa⟩ := base_attempt B G app N e a hNz hPoint
  refine ⟨Y, (hY a).mpr ⟨e, hN.zero_mem, hN.zero_mem, f0, hf0, hfa⟩, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzN, _, f, hf, hfv⟩ := (hY v).mp hv
  obtain ⟨g, hg, w, hgw⟩ := hExists (singleton B z) (hN.closed z hzN)
  obtain ⟨v0, hgv0, hw⟩ := hg.2 z w hzN hgw
  have hwG : w = G v := hw.trans (congrArg G (hAgree f g hf hg z hzN v v0 hfv hgv0).symm)
  exact (hY (G v)).mpr ⟨singleton B z, hN.closed z hzN,
    hN.closed z hzN, g, hg, hwG ▸ hgw⟩

/- The templates below are actual first-order formulas. Their two atom builders
are parameters so the independently proved finite-set atoms can be reused. -/

open Form

def attemptForm (appF : Nat → Nat → Nat → Form) (stepF : Nat → Nat → Form)
    (N e a f : Nat) : Form :=
  fAnd
    (fAll (fImp (appF (f + 1) (e + 1) 0) (fEq 0 (a + 1))))
    (fAll (fAll (fAll (fImp
      (fAnd (fMem 2 (N + 3))
        (fAnd (singForm 2 1) (appF (f + 3) 1 0)))
      (fEx (fAnd (appF (f + 4) 3 0) (stepF 0 1)))))))

def agreeForm (appF : Nat → Nat → Nat → Form) (f g z : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fAll (fImp
    (fAnd (appF (f + 2) (z + 2) 1) (appF (g + 2) (z + 2) 0)) (fEq 1 0)))

def hasAttemptForm (appF : Nat → Nat → Nat → Form) (stepF : Nat → Nat → Form)
    (N e a z : Nat) : Form :=
  fEx (fAnd (attemptForm appF stepF (N + 1) (e + 1) (a + 1) 0)
    (fEx (appF 1 (z + 2) 0)))

def valueForm (appF : Nat → Nat → Nat → Form) (stepF : Nat → Nat → Form)
    (N e a z v : Nat) : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem z N)
    (fEx (fAnd (attemptForm appF stepF (N + 1) (e + 1) (a + 1) 0)
      (appF 0 (z + 1) (v + 1))))

section Syntax

variable (B : Base mem) (G : V → V) (app : V → V → V → Prop)
    (appF : Nat → Nat → Nat → Form) (stepF : Nat → Nat → Form)
    (hApp : ∀ (env : Nat → V) f x y,
      Sat mem env (appF f x y) ↔ app (env f) (env x) (env y))
    (hStep : ∀ (env : Nat → V) x y,
      Sat mem env (stepF x y) ↔ env y = G (env x))

include hApp hStep in
theorem sat_attemptForm (env : Nat → V) (N e a f : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (attemptForm appF stepF N e a f) ↔
      Attempt B G app (env N) (env e) (env a) (env f) := by
  change ((∀ v, Sat mem (scons v env) (appF (f + 1) (e + 1) 0) → v = env a) ∧
    ∀ z s v, mem z (env N) ∧
      Sat mem (scons v (scons s (scons z env))) (singForm 2 1) ∧
      Sat mem (scons v (scons s (scons z env))) (appF (f + 3) 1 0) →
      ∃ w, Sat mem (scons w (scons v (scons s (scons z env)))) (appF (f + 4) 3 0) ∧
        Sat mem (scons w (scons v (scons s (scons z env)))) (stepF 0 1)) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h0, hs⟩
    refine ⟨fun v hv => h0 v ((hApp _ _ _ _).mpr hv), fun z v hz hv => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hwApp, hwStep⟩ := hs z (singleton B z) v
      ⟨hz, (sat_singForm B _ 2 1).mpr rfl, (hApp _ _ _ _).mpr hv⟩
    exact ⟨w, (hApp _ _ _ _).mp hwApp, (hStep _ 0 1).mp hwStep⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, hs⟩
    refine ⟨fun v hv => h0 v ((hApp _ _ _ _).mp hv), ?_⟩
    rintro z s v ⟨hz, hSing, hAppV⟩
    obtain rfl : s = singleton B z := (sat_singForm B _ 2 1).mp hSing
    obtain ⟨w, hwApp, hwStep⟩ := hs z v hz ((hApp _ _ _ _).mp hAppV)
    exact ⟨w, (hApp _ _ _ _).mpr hwApp, (hStep _ 0 1).mpr hwStep⟩

include hApp in
theorem sat_agreeForm (env : Nat → V) (f g z : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (agreeForm appF f g z) ↔ Agree app (env f) (env g) (env z) := by
  change (∀ v w, Sat mem (scons w (scons v env)) (appF (f + 2) (z + 2) 1) ∧
    Sat mem (scons w (scons v env)) (appF (g + 2) (z + 2) 0) → v = w) ↔ _
  exact ⟨fun h v w hv hw => h v w ⟨(hApp _ _ _ _).mpr hv, (hApp _ _ _ _).mpr hw⟩,
    fun h v w ⟨hv, hw⟩ => h v w ((hApp _ _ _ _).mp hv) ((hApp _ _ _ _).mp hw)⟩

include hApp hStep in
theorem sat_hasAttemptForm (env : Nat → V) (N e a z : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (hasAttemptForm appF stepF N e a z) ↔
      HasAttempt B G app (env N) (env e) (env a) (env z) := by
  change (∃ f, Sat mem (scons f env) (attemptForm appF stepF (N + 1) (e + 1) (a + 1) 0) ∧
    ∃ v, Sat mem (scons v (scons f env)) (appF 1 (z + 2) 0)) ↔ _
  exact exists_congr fun _ => and_congr (sat_attemptForm B G app appF stepF hApp hStep _ _ _ _ _)
    (exists_congr fun _ => hApp _ _ _ _)

include hApp hStep in
theorem sat_valueForm (env : Nat → V) (N e a z v : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (valueForm appF stepF N e a z v) ↔
      Value B G app (env N) (env e) (env a) (env z) (env v) := by
  change (mem (env z) (env N) ∧ ∃ f,
    Sat mem (scons f env) (attemptForm appF stepF (N + 1) (e + 1) (a + 1) 0) ∧
      Sat mem (scons f env) (appF 0 (z + 1) (v + 1))) ↔ _
  exact and_congr Iff.rfl (exists_congr fun _ =>
    and_congr (sat_attemptForm B G app appF stepF hApp hStep _ _ _ _ _) (hApp _ _ _ _))

include B hApp in
theorem agreement_separator (N f g : V) :
    ∃ X, ∀ z, mem z X ↔ mem z N ∧ Agree app f g z := by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := B.sep (agreeForm appF 1 2 0) (scons f (fun _ => g)) N
  exact ⟨X, fun z => (hX z).trans
    (and_congr Iff.rfl (sat_agreeForm app appF hApp _ 1 2 0))⟩

include appF stepF hApp hStep in
theorem existence_separator (N e a : V) :
    ∃ X, ∀ z, mem z X ↔ mem z N ∧ HasAttempt B G app N e a z := by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := B.sep (hasAttemptForm appF stepF 1 2 3 0)
    (scons N (scons e (fun _ => a))) N
  exact ⟨X, fun z => (hX z).trans (and_congr Iff.rfl
    (sat_hasAttemptForm B G app appF stepF hApp hStep _ 1 2 3 0))⟩

include appF stepF hApp hStep in
theorem value_image
    (hRepl : ∀ (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V), Functional (relOf mem phi env) →
      ∀ A, ∃ Y, ∀ v, mem v Y ↔ ∃ z, mem z A ∧ relOf mem phi env v z)
    (N e a : V)
    (hFunctional : ∀ z v w, Value B G app N e a z v →
      Value B G app N e a z w → v = w) :
    ∃ Y, ∀ v, mem v Y ↔ ∃ z, mem z N ∧ Value B G app N e a z v := by
  let params := scons N (scons e (fun _ => a))
  have hr (z v : V) : relOf mem (valueForm appF stepF 2 3 4 1 0) params v z ↔
      Value B G app N e a z v :=
    sat_valueForm B G app appF stepF hApp hStep (scons v (scons z params)) 2 3 4 1 0
  have hf : Functional (relOf mem (valueForm appF stepF 2 3 4 1 0) params) :=
    fun z v w hv hw => hFunctional z v w ((hr z v).mp hv) ((hr z w).mp hw)
  obtain ⟨Y, hY⟩ := hRepl (valueForm appF stepF 2 3 4 1 0) params hf N
  exact ⟨Y, fun v => (hY v).trans
    (exists_congr (fun z => and_congr Iff.rfl (hr z v)))⟩

include appF stepF hApp hStep in
/-- Definability of the two fixed atoms discharges precisely the three
formula resources, leaving only finite graph existence/extension. -/
theorem closure_of_forms
    (hRepl : ∀ (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V), Functional (relOf mem phi env) →
      ∀ A, ∃ Y, ∀ v, mem v Y ↔ ∃ z, mem z A ∧ relOf mem phi env v z)
    {N e a : V} (hN : Index B e N)
    (hNz : ∀ z, mem z N → singleton B z ≠ e)
    (hPoint : ∃ f, ∀ z v, app f z v ↔ z = e ∧ v = a)
    (hExtend : ∀ f z v, ∃ g, ∀ u w,
      app g u w ↔ app f u w ∨ (u = z ∧ w = v)) :
    ∃ Y, mem a Y ∧ ∀ v, mem v Y → mem (G v) Y := by
  apply closure_of_instances B G app hN hNz hPoint hExtend
  · exact agreement_separator B app appF hApp N
  · exact existence_separator B G app appF stepF hApp hStep N e a
  · exact value_image B G app appF stepF hApp hStep hRepl N e a

end Syntax

/- Fixed finite graphs instantiate the preceding atom templates. -/

def GraphApp (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (f x y : V) : Prop :=
  mem (FiniteSets.kpair B x y) f

theorem point_graph (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (e a : V) :
    ∃ f, ∀ z v, GraphApp B f z v ↔ z = e ∧ v = a := by
  refine ⟨singleton B.toBase (FiniteSets.kpair B e a), fun z v => ?_⟩
  change mem (FiniteSets.kpair B z v) (singleton B.toBase (FiniteSets.kpair B e a)) ↔ _
  rw [singleton_spec B.toBase]
  exact ⟨FiniteSets.kpair_inj B, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩

theorem extend_graph (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (f z v : V) :
    ∃ g, ∀ u w, GraphApp B g u w ↔ GraphApp B f u w ∨ (u = z ∧ w = v) := by
  refine ⟨FiniteSets.insert B f (FiniteSets.kpair B z v), fun u w => ?_⟩
  change mem (FiniteSets.kpair B u w) (FiniteSets.insert B f (FiniteSets.kpair B z v)) ↔
    mem (FiniteSets.kpair B u w) f ∨ (u = z ∧ w = v)
  rw [FiniteSets.insert_spec B]
  exact or_congr Iff.rfl ⟨FiniteSets.kpair_inj B, by rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩; rfl⟩

/-- Actual finite-set atoms, two Separation cuts and one Replacement image
produce a successor-closed set without any earlier Infinity axiom. -/
theorem successor_closure (B : FiniteSets.Base mem)
    (hRepl : ∀ (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V), Functional (relOf mem phi env) →
      ∀ A, ∃ Y, ∀ v, mem v Y ↔ ∃ z, mem z A ∧ relOf mem phi env v z)
    {N e a : V} (hN : Index B.toBase e N)
    (hNz : ∀ z, mem z N → singleton B.toBase z ≠ e) :
    ∃ Y, mem a Y ∧ ∀ v, mem v Y → mem (FiniteSets.succ B v) Y :=
  closure_of_forms B.toBase (FiniteSets.succ B) (GraphApp B)
    FiniteSets.appForm FiniteSets.succForm
    (FiniteSets.sat_appForm B) (FiniteSets.sat_succForm B) hRepl hN hNz
    (point_graph B e a) (extend_graph B)

/-- The ordinary semantic Infinity axiom from one empty-root singleton container. -/
theorem ordinary_infinity_of_container (B : FiniteSets.Base mem)
    (hRepl : ∀ (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V), Functional (relOf mem phi env) →
      ∀ A, ∃ Y, ∀ v, mem v Y ↔ ∃ z, mem z A ∧ relOf mem phi env v z)
    (e : V) (he : ∀ z, ¬ mem z e) (Y : V) (heY : mem e Y)
    (hY : Closed B.toBase Y) :
    ∃ I, (∃ e0, mem e0 I ∧ ∀ z, ¬ mem z e0) ∧
      ∀ x, mem x I → ∃ sx, mem sx I ∧ ∀ t, mem t sx ↔ mem t x ∨ t = x := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := index_of_container B.toBase e Y heY hY
  obtain ⟨I, heI, hI⟩ := successor_closure B hRepl (a := e) hN
    (fun z _ => empty_not_singleton B.toBase e he z)
  exact ⟨I, ⟨e, heI, he⟩, fun x hx =>
    ⟨FiniteSets.succ B x, hI x hx, FiniteSets.succ_spec B x⟩⟩

theorem quotientFiniteBase (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    FiniteSets.Base (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h) :=
  FiniteSets.quotientBase rawMem witness h

/-- The actual CP/GIC quotient has an ordinary inductive set. All formula
resources above are instantiated by its checked first-order schemas. -/
theorem quotient_infinity (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    ∃ I, (∃ e0, QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h e0 I ∧
        ∀ z, ¬ QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h z e0) ∧
      ∀ x, QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h x I →
        ∃ sx, QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h sx I ∧
          ∀ t, QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h t sx ↔
            QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h t x ∨ t = x := by
  obtain ⟨Y, ⟨e, heY, he⟩, hY⟩ :=
    QuotientBasic.quotient_empty_singleton_container rawMem witness h
  apply ordinary_infinity_of_container (quotientFiniteBase rawMem witness h)
    (QuotientReplacement.quotient_replacement rawMem witness h) e he Y heY
  exact closed_of_exact_singletons (quotientFiniteBase rawMem witness h).toBase Y hY

theorem quotient_inf_form (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    ∀ env, Sat (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h) env Inf_form :=
  fun env => (bridge_Inf env).mpr (quotient_infinity rawMem witness h)

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.InductiveAttempts

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ProfileModel
