/-!
First-order equality-free matrix adapters for composition of bisimulations.

Every collection resource is obtained from the actual Form-indexed GIC schema.
The definitions preserve input/output slots and arbitrary parameter values.
This is an interpretation layer, not a coded proof compiler or TM endpoint.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.CompositionModel

open Form Profile ProfilePairs ProfileCollection ProfileComposition ProfileSyntax ProfileModel
open DeepPositiveClosure

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

def unionChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 3) (fMem 1 0))) (sameForm 1 0)

theorem equalityFree_unionChoiceForm : EqualityFree unionChoiceForm := by
  exact ⟨⟨True.intro, True.intro⟩, equalityFree_sameForm 1 0⟩

theorem union_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (family : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (UnionChoice mem family) := by
  apply instance_of_matrix mem hModel unionChoiceForm equalityFree_unionChoiceForm
    (fun _ => family) _
  intro x y
  exact and_congr Iff.rfl (sat_sameForm mem _ 1 0)

def fiberChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem 0 2) (fEx (fEx (fEx (fAnd (orderedPairForm 2 1 6)
    (fAnd (orderedPairForm 1 0 3) (orderedPairForm 2 0 4))))))

theorem equalityFree_fiberChoiceForm : EqualityFree fiberChoiceForm := by
  exact ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_orderedPairForm 2 1 6,
    ⟨equalityFree_orderedPairForm 1 0 3, equalityFree_orderedPairForm 2 0 4⟩⟩⟩

theorem fiber_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (r2 d : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (FiberChoice mem r2 d) := by
  apply instance_of_matrix mem hModel fiberChoiceForm equalityFree_fiberChoiceForm
    (scons r2 (fun _ => d)) _
  intro c e
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hc, s, t, u, hst, htu, hsu⟩
    exact ⟨hc, s, t, u, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 2 1 6).mp hst,
      (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 1 0 3).mp htu,
      (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 2 0 4).mp hsu⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, s, t, u, hst, htu, hsu⟩
    exact ⟨hc, s, t, u, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 2 1 6).mpr hst,
      (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 1 0 3).mpr htu,
      (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 2 0 4).mpr hsu⟩

def fiberProfileForm (r d s : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fAll (fIff (appForm (s + 2) 1 0)
    (fEx (fAnd (orderedPairForm 2 0 (d + 3)) (appForm (r + 3) 0 1)))))

theorem sat_fiberProfileForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (r d s : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (fiberProfileForm r d s) ↔ FiberProfile mem (env r) (env d) (env s) := by
  have hRight (a b : V) :
      Sat mem (scons b (scons a env))
        (fEx (fAnd (orderedPairForm 2 0 (d + 3)) (appForm (r + 3) 0 1))) ↔
      ∃ t, OrderedPair mem a t (env d) ∧ App mem (env r) t b := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, hat, htb⟩
      exact ⟨t, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 2 0 (d + 3)).mp hat,
        (sat_appForm mem _ (r + 3) 0 1).mp htb⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, hat, htb⟩
      exact ⟨t, (sat_orderedPairForm mem _ 2 0 (d + 3)).mpr hat,
        (sat_appForm mem _ (r + 3) 0 1).mpr htb⟩
  constructor
  · intro h a b
    exact (sat_appForm mem _ (s + 2) 1 0).symm.trans
      ((Sat_fIff.mp (h a b)).trans (hRight a b))
  · intro h a b
    apply Sat_fIff.mpr
    exact (sat_appForm mem _ (s + 2) 1 0).trans ((h a b).trans (hRight a b).symm)

theorem equalityFree_fiberProfileForm (r d s : Nat) : EqualityFree (fiberProfileForm r d s) := by
  have hRight := And.intro (equalityFree_orderedPairForm 2 0 (d + 3))
    (equalityFree_appForm (r + 3) 0 1)
  exact ⟨⟨equalityFree_appForm (s + 2) 1 0, hRight⟩,
    ⟨hRight, equalityFree_appForm (s + 2) 1 0⟩⟩

def compositionChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem 0 2) (fiberProfileForm 3 0 1)

theorem equalityFree_compositionChoiceForm : EqualityFree compositionChoiceForm := by
  exact ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_fiberProfileForm 3 0 1⟩

theorem composition_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (r1 r2 : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (CompositionChoice mem r1 r2) := by
  apply instance_of_matrix mem hModel compositionChoiceForm equalityFree_compositionChoiceForm
    (scons r1 (fun _ => r2)) _
  intro d s
  exact and_congr Iff.rfl (sat_fiberProfileForm mem _ 3 0 1)

theorem eqv_trans_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    {x y z : V} (hxy : Eqv mem x y) (hyz : Eqv mem y z) : Eqv mem x z := by
  exact eqv_trans_of_instances mem
    (transContainers_of_containers ((sat_containerForm mem (fun _ => witness)).mp (h.1 _)))
    (orderedPairs_of_model mem witness h)
    (fiber_instance mem h.2) (composition_instance mem h.2) (union_instance mem h.2) hxy hyz

def matchChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem 0 2) (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 4)
    (fAnd (bisimForm 2) (appForm 2 1 0))))

def backMatchChoiceForm : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem 0 3) (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 3)
    (fAnd (bisimForm 2) (appForm 2 0 1))))

theorem equalityFree_matchChoiceForm : EqualityFree matchChoiceForm := by
  exact ⟨True.intro, ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_bisimForm 2, equalityFree_appForm 2 1 0⟩⟩⟩

theorem equalityFree_backMatchChoiceForm : EqualityFree backMatchChoiceForm := by
  exact ⟨True.intro, ⟨True.intro, ⟨equalityFree_bisimForm 2, equalityFree_appForm 2 0 1⟩⟩⟩

theorem match_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (x y : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (MatchChoice mem x y) := by
  apply instance_of_matrix mem hModel matchChoiceForm equalityFree_matchChoiceForm
    (scons x (fun _ => y)) _
  intro a r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, b, hb, hr, hab⟩
    exact ⟨ha, b, hb, (sat_bisimForm mem _ 2).mp hr, (sat_appForm mem _ 2 1 0).mp hab⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, b, hb, hr, hab⟩
    exact ⟨ha, b, hb, (sat_bisimForm mem _ 2).mpr hr, (sat_appForm mem _ 2 1 0).mpr hab⟩

theorem backMatch_instance (mem : V → V → Prop) (hModel : ModelsGIC mem) (x y : V) :
    CollectionInstance mem (BackMatchChoice mem x y) := by
  apply instance_of_matrix mem hModel backMatchChoiceForm equalityFree_backMatchChoiceForm
    (scons x (fun _ => y)) _
  intro b r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hb, a, ha, hr, hab⟩
    exact ⟨hb, a, ha, (sat_bisimForm mem _ 2).mp hr, (sat_appForm mem _ 2 0 1).mp hab⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, a, ha, hr, hab⟩
    exact ⟨hb, a, ha, (sat_bisimForm mem _ 2).mpr hr, (sat_appForm mem _ 2 0 1).mpr hab⟩

theorem eqv_extensionality_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (x y : V) (hMembers : ∀ z, Member mem z x ↔ Member mem z y) : Eqv mem x y := by
  exact eqv_extensionality_of_instances mem
    (transContainers_of_containers ((sat_containerForm mem (fun _ => witness)).mp (h.1 _)))
    (pairs_of_model mem witness h) (union_instance mem h.2)
    (match_instance mem h.2) (backMatch_instance mem h.2)
    (eqv_refl_of_model mem witness h)
    (fun _ _ hxy => eqv_symm_of_model mem witness h hxy) x y hMembers

#print axioms eqv_trans_of_model
#print axioms eqv_extensionality_of_model

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.CompositionModel

import FirstOrder.Fol
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.PositiveClosure

/-!
The subset-only subset-seeded positive closure wrapper in actual `SetTheory.Form`.

Matrix slots are 0=input, 1=output, 2+k=parameter k. The three explicit renamings
place the matrix under the bound/forward/support binders without capturing its
parameters, including beneath any binders internal to the matrix itself.

This file connects one definable first-order schema instance to the previously
proved shallow semantic interface. It does not prove deductive equivalence of
whole theories, an internal ZFC proof-code theorem, or a Turing-machine endpoint.
The bridge works for arbitrary matrices. If the matrix is equality-free, the
wrapper remains equality-free; no equality is introduced by the wrapper.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.DeepPositiveClosure

open Form

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- The binary relation named by the actual matrix, with input first. -/
def MatrixRelation (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V)
    (x y : V) : Prop :=
  Sat mem (scons x (scons y env)) phi

/-- A subset test at the current De Bruijn slots i,j, with its own fresh binder. -/
def subsetForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fImp (fMem 0 (i + 1)) (fMem 0 (j + 1)))

/-- Under forall x, exists b, forall y: y=0,b=1,x=2,parameters=3+k. -/
def boundRename : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 2
  | 1 => 0
  | k + 2 => k + 3

/-- Under forall A, exists C, forall x, forall y:
y=0,x=1,C=2,A=3,parameters=4+k. -/
def forwardRename : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | 1 => 0
  | k + 2 => k + 4

/-- Under forall A, exists C, forall y, exists x:
x=0,y=1,C=2,A=3,parameters=4+k. -/
def supportRename : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | k + 2 => k + 4

/-- The local subset-boundedness antecedent. -/
def subsetBoundForm (phi : Form) : Form :=
  fAll (fEx (fAll (fImp (rename boundRename phi) (subsetForm 0 1))))

/-- The positive hull conclusion, without the local boundedness antecedent. -/
def positiveBodyForm (phi : Form) : Form :=
  fAll (fEx (fAnd
    (fAll (fAll (fImp
      (fAnd (fOr (subsetForm 1 3) (fMem 1 2)) (rename forwardRename phi))
      (fMem 0 2))))
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 1) (fEx (rename supportRename phi))))))

/-- One subset-only subset-seeded positive closure schema instance. -/
def pscForm (phi : Form) : Form :=
  fImp (subsetBoundForm phi) (positiveBodyForm phi)

theorem sat_subsetForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (subsetForm i j) ↔ PositiveClosure.Sub mem (env i) (env j) :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem bound_env (x b y : V) (env : Nat → V) :
    ∀ n, scons y (scons b (scons x env)) (boundRename n) =
      scons x (scons y env) n :=
  fun n => match n with | 0 => rfl | 1 => rfl | _ + 2 => rfl

theorem forward_env (a c x y : V) (env : Nat → V) :
    ∀ n, scons y (scons x (scons c (scons a env))) (forwardRename n) =
      scons x (scons y env) n :=
  fun n => match n with | 0 => rfl | 1 => rfl | _ + 2 => rfl

theorem support_env (a c y x : V) (env : Nat → V) :
    ∀ n, scons x (scons y (scons c (scons a env))) (supportRename n) =
      scons x (scons y env) n :=
  fun n => match n with | 0 => rfl | 1 => rfl | _ + 2 => rfl

theorem sat_bound_matrix (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V)
    (x b y : V) :
    Sat mem (scons y (scons b (scons x env))) (rename boundRename phi) ↔
      MatrixRelation mem phi env x y :=
  Sat_rename_ext phi boundRename _ _ (bound_env x b y env)

theorem sat_forward_matrix (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V)
    (a c x y : V) :
    Sat mem (scons y (scons x (scons c (scons a env)))) (rename forwardRename phi) ↔
      MatrixRelation mem phi env x y :=
  Sat_rename_ext phi forwardRename _ _ (forward_env a c x y env)

theorem sat_support_matrix (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V)
    (a c y x : V) :
    Sat mem (scons x (scons y (scons c (scons a env)))) (rename supportRename phi) ↔
      MatrixRelation mem phi env x y :=
  Sat_rename_ext phi supportRename _ _ (support_env a c y x env)

/-- The actual antecedent is exactly the shallow local bound on this matrix. -/
theorem sat_subsetBoundForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env (subsetBoundForm phi) ↔
      PositiveClosure.SubsetBounded mem (MatrixRelation mem phi env) :=
  forall_congr' fun x => exists_congr fun b => forall_congr' fun y =>
    imp_congr (sat_bound_matrix mem phi env x b y) (sat_subsetForm mem _ 0 1)

/-- No arbitrary semantic relation is substituted: this is the given Form's relation. -/
theorem sat_positiveBodyForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env (positiveBodyForm phi) ↔
      ∀ a, ∃ c, PositiveClosure.PositiveHull mem (PositiveClosure.Sub mem) (MatrixRelation mem phi env) a c := by
  constructor
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨c, hClosed, hSupport⟩ := h a
    refine ⟨c, fun x y hActive hxy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · have hStart : Sat mem (scons y (scons x (scons c (scons a env))))
          (subsetForm 1 3) ∨ mem x c := by
        rcases hActive with hSub | hMem
        · exact Or.inl ((sat_subsetForm mem _ 1 3).mpr hSub)
        · exact Or.inr hMem
      exact hClosed x y ⟨hStart, (sat_forward_matrix mem phi env a c x y).mpr hxy⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hSupport y hy
      exact ⟨x, (sat_support_matrix mem phi env a c y x).mp hxy⟩
  · intro h a
    obtain ⟨c, hClosed, hSupport⟩ := h a
    refine ⟨c, fun x y hxy => ?_, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    · have hActive : PositiveClosure.Sub mem x a ∨ mem x c := by
        rcases hxy.1 with hSub | hMem
        · exact Or.inl ((sat_subsetForm mem _ 1 3).mp hSub)
        · exact Or.inr hMem
      exact hClosed x y hActive ((sat_forward_matrix mem phi env a c x y).mp hxy.2)
    · obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hSupport y hy
      exact ⟨x, (sat_support_matrix mem phi env a c y x).mpr hxy⟩

/-- The concrete first-order wrapper has exactly the intended closure semantics. -/
theorem sat_pscForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env (pscForm phi) ↔
      PositiveClosure.ClosureInstance mem (PositiveClosure.Sub mem) (MatrixRelation mem phi env) :=
  imp_congr (sat_subsetBoundForm mem phi env) (sat_positiveBodyForm mem phi env)

/-- Universal parameter environments correspond to validity of these instances. -/
theorem valid_pscForm_iff (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) :
    (∀ env, Sat mem env (pscForm phi)) ↔
      ∀ env, PositiveClosure.ClosureInstance mem (PositiveClosure.Sub mem) (MatrixRelation mem phi env) :=
  forall_congr' fun env => sat_pscForm mem phi env

/-- A syntactic check, independent of the semantics. -/
def EqualityFree : Form → Prop
  | fMem _ _ => True
  | fEq _ _ => False
  | fBot => True
  | fImp a b => EqualityFree a ∧ EqualityFree b
  | fAnd a b => EqualityFree a ∧ EqualityFree b
  | fOr a b => EqualityFree a ∧ EqualityFree b
  | fAll a => EqualityFree a
  | fEx a => EqualityFree a

theorem equalityFree_rename (phi : Form) (r : Nat → Nat)
    (h : EqualityFree phi) : EqualityFree (rename r phi) := by
  induction phi generalizing r with
  | fMem i j | fBot => trivial
  | fEq i j => exact False.elim h
  | fImp a b iha ihb | fAnd a b iha ihb | fOr a b iha ihb => exact ⟨iha r h.1, ihb r h.2⟩
  | fAll a ih | fEx a ih => exact ih (up r) h

theorem equalityFree_subsetForm (i j : Nat) : EqualityFree (subsetForm i j) :=
  ⟨True.intro, True.intro⟩

theorem equalityFree_pscForm (phi : Form) (h : EqualityFree phi) :
    EqualityFree (pscForm phi) :=
  ⟨⟨equalityFree_rename phi boundRename h, equalityFree_subsetForm 0 1⟩,
    ⟨⟨⟨⟨equalityFree_subsetForm 1 3, True.intro⟩, equalityFree_rename phi forwardRename h⟩,
      True.intro⟩, ⟨True.intro, equalityFree_rename phi supportRename h⟩⟩⟩

#print axioms sat_pscForm
#print axioms equalityFree_pscForm

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.DeepPositiveClosure

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteSets
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientCPGIC
import ZF.Zf

/-!
The internally well-founded part, with one literal GIC witness instance.

The definitions follow the well-founded-part interpretation in the attributed
busy-beaver snapshot, ZF/stdzf_r3/regcon/WF.v, pin
297ab8df7e5de329605c3875b4934643b371a5e3. Here the already available
formula-indexed GIC collects transitive well-founded witnesses directly;
there is no choice of a canonical witness and no inference of Collection
from functional Replacement without Foundation.

The finite base has Extensionality, Pairing, Union and actual Form Separation.
The only Separation matrix used below is membership in a parameter, for an
intersection. WF closure requests one displayed GIC formula. Its matrix is
equality-free. InternallyWellFounded quantifies over represented sets, not
arbitrary external subsets, and no external WellFounded relation is assumed.
This is not yet the full ZF interpretation or a consistency comparison.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WellFoundedPart

open Form PositiveClosure DeepPositiveClosure ProfileCollection ProfileSyntax

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

def NonemptySet (mem : V → V → Prop) (s : V) : Prop := ∃ x, mem x s

def Minimal (mem : V → V → Prop) (m s : V) : Prop :=
  mem m s ∧ ∀ z, mem z m → ¬ mem z s

def InternallyWellFounded (mem : V → V → Prop) (t : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, Sub mem s t → NonemptySet mem s → ∃ m, Minimal mem m s

def TW (mem : V → V → Prop) (t : V) : Prop :=
  Transitive mem t ∧ InternallyWellFounded mem t

def WF (mem : V → V → Prop) (x : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, TW mem t ∧ mem x t

def transitiveForm (i : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fImp (fMem 0 (i + 1)) (subsetForm 0 (i + 1)))

def nonemptyForm (i : Nat) : Form := fEx (fMem 0 (i + 1))

def minimalElementForm (m s : Nat) : Form :=
  fAnd (fMem m s)
    (fAll (fImp (fMem 0 (m + 1)) (fImp (fMem 0 (s + 1)) fBot)))

def minimalForm (i : Nat) : Form := fEx (minimalElementForm 0 (i + 1))

def wellFoundedForm (i : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fImp (subsetForm 0 (i + 1))
    (fImp (nonemptyForm 0) (minimalForm 0)))

def twForm (i : Nat) : Form := fAnd (transitiveForm i) (wellFoundedForm i)

def wfForm (i : Nat) : Form := fEx (fAnd (twForm 0) (fMem (i + 1) 0))

/-- Input 0, witness output 1; there are no additional parameters. -/
def witnessForm : Form := fAnd (twForm 1) (fMem 0 1)

theorem sat_transitiveForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (transitiveForm i) ↔ Transitive mem (env i) :=
  forall_congr' fun x => imp_congr_right fun _ => sat_subsetForm mem (scons x env) 0 (i + 1)

theorem sat_nonemptyForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (nonemptyForm i) ↔ NonemptySet mem (env i) := Iff.rfl

theorem sat_minimalElementForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (m s : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (minimalElementForm m s) ↔ Minimal mem (env m) (env s) := Iff.rfl

theorem sat_minimalForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (minimalForm i) ↔ ∃ m, Minimal mem m (env i) :=
  exists_congr fun m => sat_minimalElementForm mem (scons m env) 0 (i + 1)

theorem sat_wellFoundedForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (wellFoundedForm i) ↔ InternallyWellFounded mem (env i) :=
  forall_congr' fun s => imp_congr (sat_subsetForm mem (scons s env) 0 (i + 1))
    (imp_congr (sat_nonemptyForm mem (scons s env) 0) (sat_minimalForm mem (scons s env) 0))

theorem sat_twForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (twForm i) ↔ TW mem (env i) :=
  and_congr (sat_transitiveForm mem env i) (sat_wellFoundedForm mem env i)

theorem sat_wfForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (wfForm i) ↔ WF mem (env i) :=
  exists_congr fun t => and_congr (sat_twForm mem (scons t env) 0) Iff.rfl

theorem sat_witnessForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (x t : V) :
    MatrixRelation mem witnessForm env x t ↔ TW mem t ∧ mem x t :=
  and_congr (sat_twForm mem (scons x (scons t env)) 1) Iff.rfl

theorem equalityFree_witnessForm : EqualityFree witnessForm := by
  simp [witnessForm, twForm, transitiveForm, wellFoundedForm, nonemptyForm,
    minimalForm, minimalElementForm, subsetForm, EqualityFree]

theorem equalityFree_wfForm (i : Nat) : EqualityFree (wfForm i) := by
  simp [wfForm, twForm, transitiveForm, wellFoundedForm, nonemptyForm,
    minimalForm, minimalElementForm, subsetForm, EqualityFree]

/-- This is exactly the Separation instance with matrix Mem(0,1). -/
theorem intersection_exists (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (s t : V) :
    ∃ b, ∀ x, mem x b ↔ mem x s ∧ mem x t :=
  B.sep (fMem 0 1) (fun _ => t) s

/-- Meeting a TW set suffices: intersect, take a minimal element, and use
transitivity to rule out children lying elsewhere in the original set. -/
theorem minimal_of_meets_tw (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (t : V) (ht : TW mem t)
    (s : V) (hMeet : ∃ x, mem x s ∧ mem x t) : ∃ m, Minimal mem m s := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := intersection_exists B s t
  have hSub : Sub mem b t := fun x hx => ((hb x).mp hx).2
  obtain ⟨x, hxs, hxt⟩ := hMeet
  obtain ⟨m, hmb, hMin⟩ := ht.2 b hSub ⟨x, (hb x).mpr ⟨hxs, hxt⟩⟩
  refine ⟨m, ((hb m).mp hmb).1, ?_⟩
  intro z hzm hzs
  exact hMin z hzm ((hb z).mpr ⟨hzs, ht.1 m (hSub m hmb) z hzm⟩)

theorem tw_union (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (c : V)
    (hFamily : ∀ t, mem t c → TW mem t) : TW mem (FiniteSets.union B c) := by
  constructor
  · intro x hx z hz
    obtain ⟨t, hxt, htc⟩ := (FiniteSets.union_spec B c x).mp hx
    exact (FiniteSets.union_spec B c z).mpr
      ⟨t, (hFamily t htc).1 x hxt z hz, htc⟩
  · intro s hs hne
    obtain ⟨x, hxs⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨t, hxt, htc⟩ := (FiniteSets.union_spec B c x).mp (hs x hxs)
    exact minimal_of_meets_tw B t (hFamily t htc) s ⟨x, hxs, hxt⟩

/-- Adjoin a set whose every member already lies in the TW set. -/
theorem tw_adjoin (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (u a : V)
    (hu : TW mem u) (ha : Sub mem a u) : TW mem (FiniteSets.insert B u a) := by
  constructor
  · intro x hx z hz
    rcases (FiniteSets.insert_spec B u a x).mp hx with hx | hxa
    · exact (FiniteSets.insert_spec B u a z).mpr (Or.inl (hu.1 x hx z hz))
    · have hza : mem z a := hxa ▸ hz
      exact (FiniteSets.insert_spec B u a z).mpr (Or.inl (ha z hza))
  · intro s hs hne
    classical
    by_cases hMeet : ∃ x, mem x s ∧ mem x u
    · exact minimal_of_meets_tw B u hu s hMeet
    · obtain ⟨x, hxs⟩ := hne
      rcases (FiniteSets.insert_spec B u a x).mp (hs x hxs) with hxu | hxa
      · exact False.elim (hMeet ⟨x, hxs, hxu⟩)
      · subst x
        exact ⟨a, hxs, fun z hza hzs => hMeet ⟨z, hzs, ha z hza⟩⟩

/-- A single displayed actual GIC formula collects all needed TW witnesses.
No schema over arbitrary semantic relations is a premise. -/
theorem wf_closure (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (a : V)
    (hG : Sat mem (fun _ => a) (gicForm witnessForm))
    (ha : ∀ x, mem x a → WF mem x) : WF mem a := by
  have hc : CollectionInstance mem (fun x t => TW mem t ∧ mem x t) :=
    ProfileModel.collectionInstance_congr mem _ _ (sat_witnessForm mem (fun _ => a))
      ((sat_gicForm mem witnessForm (fun _ => a)).mp hG)
  obtain ⟨c, hSupport, hCover⟩ := hc a
  have hFamily : ∀ t, mem t c → TW mem t := fun t ht => (hSupport t ht).elim fun _ h => h.1
  have haU : Sub mem a (FiniteSets.union B c) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨t, htc, _, hxt⟩ := hCover x hx (ha x hx)
    exact (FiniteSets.union_spec B c x).mpr ⟨t, hxt, htc⟩
  exact ⟨FiniteSets.insert B (FiniteSets.union B c) a,
    tw_adjoin B _ a (tw_union B c hFamily) haU,
    (FiniteSets.insert_spec B _ a a).mpr (Or.inr rfl)⟩

theorem wf_closure_of_equalityFree_gic (B : FiniteSets.Base mem)
    (hG : ProfileModel.ModelsGIC mem) (a : V)
    (ha : ∀ x, mem x a → WF mem x) : WF mem a :=
  wf_closure B a (hG witnessForm equalityFree_witnessForm (fun _ => a)) ha

theorem wf_mem {x y : V} (hx : WF mem x) (hy : mem y x) : WF mem y := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨t, ht, ht.1 x hxt y hy⟩

/-- Pairing alone supplies the TW singleton witness for an actual empty set. -/
theorem wf_empty (B : FiniteSets.Base mem) (e : V) (he : ∀ z, ¬ mem z e) :
    WF mem e := by
  have ht : TW mem (FiniteSets.singleton B e) := by
    constructor
    · intro x hx z hz
      have hxe := (FiniteSets.singleton_spec B e x).mp hx
      subst x
      exact False.elim (he z hz)
    · intro s hs hne
      obtain ⟨x, hxs⟩ := hne
      have hxe := (FiniteSets.singleton_spec B e x).mp (hs x hxs)
      subst x
      exact ⟨e, hxs, fun z hze => False.elim (he z hze)⟩
  exact ⟨FiniteSets.singleton B e, ht, (FiniteSets.singleton_spec B e e).mpr rfl⟩

/-- The ordinary well-founded-part minimal-element property is internal. -/
theorem wf_minimal (a : V) (ha : WF mem a) (hne : NonemptySet mem a) :
    ∃ m, mem m a ∧ WF mem m ∧ ∀ z, mem z m → ¬ mem z a := by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hat⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hMin⟩ := ht.2 a (ht.1 a hat) hne
  exact ⟨m, hm, ⟨t, ht, ht.1 a hat m hm⟩, hMin⟩

def Domain (mem : V → V → Prop) := {x : V // WF mem x}

def domainMem (mem : V → V → Prop) (x y : Domain mem) : Prop := mem x.1 y.1

/-- The actual Reg_form holds in the WF subtype. Other ZF axioms still
require their interpreted instance proofs; this is not a full model claim. -/
theorem domain_regular (mem : V → V → Prop) :
    ∀ env : Nat → Domain mem, Sat (domainMem mem) env Reg_form := by
  apply bridge_Reg.mpr
  intro a hne
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hwm, hMin⟩ := wf_minimal a.1 a.2 ⟨x.1, hx⟩
  refine ⟨⟨m, hwm⟩, hm, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨z, hzm, hza⟩
  exact hMin z.1 hzm hza

/-- The actual quotient supplies the fixed native GIC instance and small base. -/
theorem quotient_wf_closure (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem)
    (a : QuotientModel.Domain rawMem witness h)
    (ha : ∀ x, QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h x a →
      WF (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h) x) :
    WF (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h) a :=
  wf_closure (FiniteSets.quotientBase rawMem witness h) a
    (QuotientCPGIC.quotient_fullGIC rawMem witness h witnessForm (fun _ => a)) ha

theorem quotient_domain_nonempty (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    Nonempty (Domain (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h)) := by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := QuotientBasic.quotient_empty rawMem witness h
  exact ⟨⟨e, wf_empty (FiniteSets.quotientBase rawMem witness h) e he⟩⟩

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WellFoundedPart

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFRelativization
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.PowerSets

/-! The general well-founded-part model construction.
Declarations are copied verbatim from WFModel; the CPGIC specialization
and historical enumerator consequences remain in its compatibility wrapper. -/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFModel
open Form WellFoundedPart WFRelativization
universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

abbrev ClosedWF (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a, (∀ x, mem x a → WF mem x) → WF mem a

theorem finiteBase (H : ZFAxioms mem) : FiniteSets.Base mem where
  ext := H.ext
  pair := H.pair
  sep := H.sep
  union := H.union

theorem domain_ext (H : ZFAxioms mem) (a b : Domain mem)
    (h : ∀ x, domainMem mem x a ↔ domainMem mem x b) : a = b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply H.ext
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (h ⟨x, wf_mem a.property hx⟩).mp hx
  · intro hx
    exact (h ⟨x, wf_mem b.property hx⟩).mpr hx

theorem domain_pair (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem) (a b : Domain mem) :
    ∃ p : Domain mem, ∀ x, domainMem mem x p ↔ x = a ∨ x = b := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := H.pair a.val b.val
  have hwp : WF mem p := hc p fun x hx => by
    rcases (hp x).mp hx with h | h
    · exact h.symm ▸ a.property
    · exact h.symm ▸ b.property
  refine ⟨⟨p, hwp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases (hp x.val).mp hx with h | h
    · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
    · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext h)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact (hp x.val).mpr (Or.inl (congrArg Subtype.val h))
    · exact (hp x.val).mpr (Or.inr (congrArg Subtype.val h))

theorem domain_union (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem) (a : Domain mem) :
    ∃ w : Domain mem, ∀ x, domainMem mem x w ↔
      ∃ y : Domain mem, domainMem mem x y ∧ domainMem mem y a := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := H.union a.val
  have hww : WF mem w := hc w fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hxy, hya⟩ := (hw x).mp hx
    exact wf_mem (wf_mem a.property hya) hxy
  refine ⟨⟨w, hww⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy, hya⟩ := (hw x.val).mp hx
    exact ⟨⟨y, wf_mem a.property hya⟩, hxy, hya⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hxy, hya⟩
    exact (hw x.val).mpr ⟨y.val, hxy, hya⟩

theorem domain_separation (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem)
    (phi : Form) (env : Nat → Domain mem) (a : Domain mem) :
    ∃ s : Domain mem, ∀ x, domainMem mem x s ↔
      domainMem mem x a ∧ Sat (domainMem mem) (scons x env) phi := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := H.sep (translate phi) (liftEnv mem env) a.val
  have hws : WF mem s := hc s fun x hx => wf_mem a.property ((hs x).mp hx).1
  refine ⟨⟨s, hws⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  change mem x.val s ↔ mem x.val a.val ∧ _
  rw [hs x.val]
  apply and_congr_right
  intro _
  have he : scons x.val (liftEnv mem env) = liftEnv mem (scons x env) :=
    funext fun i => by cases i <;> rfl
  rw [he]
  exact sat_translate mem phi (scons x env)

theorem domain_power (hc : ClosedWF mem) (hp : PSCCalibration.PowerSets mem)
    (a : Domain mem) :
    ∃ p : Domain mem, ∀ x, domainMem mem x p ↔ Sub (domainMem mem) x a := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hp a.val
  have hwp : WF mem p := hc p fun x hx =>
    hc x fun z hz => wf_mem a.property ((hp x).mp hx z hz)
  refine ⟨⟨p, hwp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · exact fun hx z hz => (hp x.val).mp hx z.val hz
  · exact fun hx => (hp x.val).mpr fun z hz => hx ⟨z, wf_mem x.property hz⟩ hz

/-- Separating WF from an inductive set gives an inductive WF set. -/
theorem domain_infinity (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem) :
    ∃ I : Domain mem,
      (∃ e : Domain mem, domainMem mem e I ∧ ∀ z, ¬ domainMem mem z e) ∧
      (∀ x, domainMem mem x I → ∃ sx : Domain mem, domainMem mem sx I ∧
        ∀ t, domainMem mem t sx ↔ domainMem mem t x ∨ t = x) := by
  obtain ⟨I, ⟨e, heI, he⟩, hsucc⟩ := H.inf
  obtain ⟨J, hJ⟩ := H.sep (wfForm 0) (fun _ => e) I
  have hJ' (x : V) : mem x J ↔ mem x I ∧ WF mem x :=
    (hJ x).trans (and_congr_right fun _ => sat_wfForm mem (scons x (fun _ => e)) 0)
  have hwJ : WF mem J := hc J fun x hx => ((hJ' x).mp hx).2
  have hwe : WF mem e := wf_empty (finiteBase H) e he
  refine ⟨⟨J, hwJ⟩, ⟨⟨e, hwe⟩, (hJ' e).mpr ⟨heI, hwe⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact fun z => he z.val
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨sx, hsI, hs⟩ := hsucc x.val ((hJ' x.val).mp hx).1
    have hws : WF mem sx := hc sx fun z hz => by
      rcases (hs z).mp hz with hz | hz
      · exact wf_mem x.property hz
      · exact hz.symm ▸ x.property
    refine ⟨⟨sx, hws⟩, (hJ' sx).mpr ⟨hsI, hws⟩, fun t => ?_⟩
    constructor
    · intro ht
      rcases (hs t.val).mp ht with ht | ht
      · exact Or.inl ht
      · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext ht)
    · rintro (ht | ht)
      · exact (hs t.val).mpr (Or.inl ht)
      · exact (hs t.val).mpr (Or.inr (congrArg Subtype.val ht))

/-- Both arguments are guarded, so raw functionality holds globally. -/
def replacementForm (phi : Form) : Form :=
  fAnd (wfForm 0) (fAnd (wfForm 1) (translate phi))

theorem replacementForm_spec (phi : Form) (env : Nat → Domain mem)
    (y x : V) : relOf mem (replacementForm phi) (liftEnv mem env) y x ↔
      WF mem y ∧ WF mem x ∧ Sat mem (scons y (scons x (liftEnv mem env))) (translate phi) := by
  change (Sat mem _ (wfForm 0) ∧ Sat mem _ (wfForm 1) ∧ _) ↔ _
  exact and_congr (sat_wfForm mem _ 0) (and_congr (sat_wfForm mem _ 1) Iff.rfl)

private theorem raw_rel_iff (phi : Form) (env : Nat → Domain mem)
    (y x : Domain mem) :
    Sat mem (scons y.val (scons x.val (liftEnv mem env))) (translate phi) ↔
      relOf (domainMem mem) phi env y x := by
  have he : scons y.val (scons x.val (liftEnv mem env)) = liftEnv mem (scons y (scons x env)) :=
    funext fun i => by rcases i with _ | _ | _ <;> rfl
  rw [he]
  exact sat_translate mem phi (scons y (scons x env))

theorem domain_replacement (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem)
    (phi : Form) (env : Nat → Domain mem)
    (hf : Functional (relOf (domainMem mem) phi env)) (a : Domain mem) :
    ∃ r : Domain mem, ∀ y, domainMem mem y r ↔
      ∃ x : Domain mem, domainMem mem x a ∧ relOf (domainMem mem) phi env y x := by
  have hfun : Functional (relOf mem (replacementForm phi) (liftEnv mem env)) := by
    intro x y1 y2 h1 h2
    obtain ⟨hy1, hx, h1⟩ := (replacementForm_spec phi env y1 x).mp h1
    obtain ⟨hy2, _, h2⟩ := (replacementForm_spec phi env y2 x).mp h2
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (hf ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y1, hy1⟩ ⟨y2, hy2⟩
      ((raw_rel_iff phi env ⟨y1, hy1⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩).mp h1)
      ((raw_rel_iff phi env ⟨y2, hy2⟩ ⟨x, hx⟩).mp h2))
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := H.repl (replacementForm phi) (liftEnv mem env) hfun a.val
  have hwr : WF mem r := hc r fun y hy => by
    obtain ⟨x, _, hrel⟩ := (hr y).mp hy
    exact ((replacementForm_spec phi env y x).mp hrel).1
  refine ⟨⟨r, hwr⟩, fun y => ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxa, hrel⟩ := (hr y.val).mp hy
    obtain ⟨_, hx, hrel⟩ := (replacementForm_spec phi env y.val x).mp hrel
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hxa, (raw_rel_iff phi env y ⟨x, hx⟩).mp hrel⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hxa, hrel⟩
    exact (hr y.val).mpr ⟨x.val, hxa,
      (replacementForm_spec phi env y.val x.val).mpr
        ⟨y.property, x.property, (raw_rel_iff phi env y x).mpr hrel⟩⟩

/-- All six ambient ZF fields hold in the interpreted WF domain. -/
theorem domain_zfAxioms (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem) :
    ZFAxioms (domainMem mem) where
  ext := domain_ext H
  pair := domain_pair H hc
  union := domain_union H hc
  sep := domain_separation H hc
  inf := domain_infinity H hc
  repl := domain_replacement H hc

/-- Every actual closed ZF sentence holds, including Regularity. -/
theorem domain_models_ZF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hc : ClosedWF mem)
    (hp : PSCCalibration.PowerSets mem) (env : Nat → Domain mem) :
    ∀ phi, ZFax_s phi → Sat (domainMem mem) env phi := by
  intro phi hphi
  have A := domain_zfAxioms H hc
  rcases hphi with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨phi, rfl⟩ | ⟨phi, rfl⟩
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Ext_form) Ext_form).mpr (bridge_Ext.mpr A.ext) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Reg_form) Reg_form).mpr (domain_regular mem) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Pow_form) Pow_form).mpr (bridge_Pow.mpr (domain_power hc hp)) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Pair_form) Pair_form).mpr (bridge_Pair.mpr A.pair) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Union_form) Union_form).mpr (bridge_Union.mpr A.union) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Inf_form) Inf_form).mpr (fun e => (bridge_Inf e).mpr A.inf) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound (Sep_form phi)) (Sep_form phi)).mpr
      (fun e => bridge_Sep.mpr A.sep phi e) env
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound (Repl_form phi)) (Repl_form phi)).mpr
      (fun e => (bridge_Repl phi e).mpr (A.repl phi e)) env

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFModel

    (env : Nat → Domain (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h)) :
    ∀ phi, ZFax_s phi →

/-!
The native numerical calculus and ZF with Foundation are equiconsistent.

The reverse comparison builds the internally well-founded part of the
CP/GIC quotient. Its closure uses the actual global-image collection instance
already available there; no claim that arbitrary ZF0 models satisfy full
Collection is needed. Model soundness and the existing numerical completeness
adapter supply the finite-refutation consequences. Choice and the internal
arithmetic proof-code comparison remain separate.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFTheory
open WellFoundedPart
universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- The actual quotient WF model has an explicit inhabitant and valuation. -/
theorem zf_consistent_of_model (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC mem) : ¬ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot := by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := quotient_domain_nonempty mem witness h
  intro hf
  exact soundness_BProv hf (fun _ => x)
    (WFModel.quotient_models_ZF mem witness h (fun _ => x))
    (fun _ hNil => by cases hNil)

/-- A refutation of ordinary ZF forces numerical falsity. -/
theorem c254_of_zf_refutation (hf : BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot) :
    Code254.C254 Code254.F := by
  apply Code254.c254_complete
  intro D mem hirr hBundle valuation
  exact zf_consistent_of_model mem (valuation 0)
    (Code254GIC.modelsCPGIC_of_encBundle mem hirr valuation hBundle) hf

/-- This comparison includes Foundation and Power, with no Choice axiom. -/
theorem c254_refutation_iff_zf :
    Code254.C254 Code254.F ↔ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot :=
  ⟨fun h => ZFNative.zf_refutation_of_native
      (NativeTheory254.c254_refutation_iff.mp h), c254_of_zf_refutation⟩

theorem native_refutation_iff_zf :
    BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot ↔ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot :=
  NativeTheory254.c254_refutation_iff.symm.trans c254_refutation_iff_zf

theorem native_consistency_iff_zf :
    (¬ BProv NativeTheory254.NativeAx [] Form.fBot) ↔ ¬ BProv ZFax_s [] Form.fBot :=
  not_congr native_refutation_iff_zf

/-!
Finite set constructors and literal graph atoms without Infinity.
The elementary operator and Kuratowski proofs are adapted from the repository's
ZF/Zf.lean, with their hypotheses reduced to Extensionality, Pairing and Union.
The inherited Separation field is used by the later finite-attempt construction;
no internal omega or recursion theorem is used here.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteSets
open Form
universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

structure Base (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop extends SingletonInfinity.Base mem where
  union : ∀ a, ∃ b, ∀ z, mem z b ↔ ∃ x, mem z x ∧ mem x a

noncomputable def pair (H : Base mem) (a b : V) : V := (H.pair a b).choose

theorem pair_spec (H : Base mem) (a b x : V) :
    mem x (pair H a b) ↔ (x = a ∨ x = b) :=
  (H.pair a b).choose_spec x

noncomputable abbrev singleton (H : Base mem) (a : V) : V :=
  SingletonInfinity.singleton H.toBase a

theorem singleton_spec (H : Base mem) (a x : V) :
    mem x (singleton H a) ↔ x = a := SingletonInfinity.singleton_spec H.toBase a x

noncomputable def union (H : Base mem) (u : V) : V := (H.union u).choose

theorem union_spec (H : Base mem) (u x : V) :
    mem x (union H u) ↔ ∃ v, mem x v ∧ mem v u :=
  (H.union u).choose_spec x

noncomputable def cup (H : Base mem) (a b : V) : V := union H (pair H a b)

theorem cup_spec (H : Base mem) (a b x : V) :
    mem x (cup H a b) ↔ (mem x a ∨ mem x b) := by
  unfold cup
  rw [union_spec H (pair H a b) x]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨v, hxv, hv⟩ =>
      ((pair_spec H a b v).mp hv).imp (fun (e : v = a) => e ▸ hxv)
        fun (e : v = b) => e ▸ hxv,
    fun h => h.elim (fun ha => ⟨a, ha, (pair_spec H a b a).mpr (Or.inl rfl)⟩)
      fun hb => ⟨b, hb, (pair_spec H a b b).mpr (Or.inr rfl)⟩⟩

noncomputable def succ (H : Base mem) (a : V) : V := cup H a (singleton H a)

theorem succ_spec (H : Base mem) (a x : V) :
    mem x (succ H a) ↔ (mem x a ∨ x = a) := by
  unfold succ
  rw [cup_spec H a (singleton H a) x, singleton_spec H a x]

theorem succ_self (H : Base mem) (a : V) : mem a (succ H a) :=
  (succ_spec H a a).mpr (Or.inr rfl)

noncomputable def kpair (H : Base mem) (a b : V) : V :=
  pair H (singleton H a) (pair H a b)

theorem kpair_mem (H : Base mem) (a b q : V) :
    mem q (kpair H a b) ↔ (q = singleton H a ∨ q = pair H a b) :=
  pair_spec H _ _ q

theorem singleton_inj (H : Base mem) (a b : V)
    (h : singleton H a = singleton H b) : a = b :=
  (singleton_spec H b a).mp (h ▸ (singleton_spec H a a).mpr rfl)

theorem pair_single (H : Base mem) (a b c : V)
    (h : pair H a b = singleton H c) : a = c ∧ b = c :=
  ⟨(singleton_spec H c a).mp (h ▸ (pair_spec H a b a).mpr (Or.inl rfl)),
    (singleton_spec H c b).mp (h ▸ (pair_spec H a b b).mpr (Or.inr rfl))⟩

theorem kpair_inj (H : Base mem) {a b c d : V}
    (h : kpair H a b = kpair H c d) : a = c ∧ b = d := by
  have hac : a = c := ((kpair_mem H c d (singleton H a)).mp
    (h ▸ (kpair_mem H a b _).mpr (Or.inl rfl))).elim (singleton_inj H a c)
    fun hs => (pair_single H c d a hs.symm).1.symm
  refine ⟨hac, ?_⟩
  subst hac
  -- h : kpair a b = kpair a d
  have h1 : mem (pair H a b) (kpair H a b) :=
    (kpair_mem H a b _).mpr (Or.inr rfl)
  rw [h] at h1
  rcases (kpair_mem H a d _).mp h1 with h1 | h1
  · -- pair a b = singleton a, so b = a
    have hba : b = a := (pair_single H a b a h1).2
    have h2 : mem (pair H a d) (kpair H a d) :=
      (kpair_mem H a d _).mpr (Or.inr rfl)
    rw [← h] at h2
    rcases (kpair_mem H a b _).mp h2 with h2 | h2
    · exact hba.trans (pair_single H a d a h2).2.symm
    · exact ((pair_spec H a b d).mp (h2 ▸ (pair_spec H a d d).mpr (Or.inr rfl))).elim
        (fun hd => hba.trans hd.symm) Eq.symm
  · -- pair a b = pair a d
    refine ((pair_spec H a d b).mp (h1 ▸ (pair_spec H a b b).mpr (Or.inr rfl))).elim
      (fun hb => ?_) id
    -- b = a
    exact ((pair_spec H a b d).mp (h1 ▸ (pair_spec H a d d).mpr (Or.inr rfl))).elim
      (fun hd => hb.trans hd.symm) Eq.symm


noncomputable def insert (B : Base mem) (f p : V) : V := cup B f (singleton B p)

theorem insert_spec (B : Base mem) (f p z : V) :
    mem z (insert B f p) ↔ mem z f ∨ z = p := by
  rw [insert, cup_spec B, singleton_spec B]

/-- An actual set-by-formula specification, requiring only Extensionality. -/
theorem sat_setBy (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) (phi : Form) (b : V)
    (hp : ∀ x, Sat mem (scons x env) phi ↔ mem x b) :
    Sat mem env (fSetByF i phi) ↔ env i = b := by
  rw [fSetByF_sat]
  exact ⟨fun h => B.ext _ _ fun x => (h x).trans (hp x), fun h x => by rw [h]; exact (hp x).symm⟩

/-- Inputs i,j; output k. -/
def pairForm (i j k : Nat) : Form :=
  fSetByF k (fOr (fEq 0 (i + 1)) (fEq 0 (j + 1)))

theorem sat_pairForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (i j k : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (pairForm i j k) ↔ env k = pair B (env i) (env j) :=
  sat_setBy B env k _ _ fun x => (pair_spec B (env i) (env j) x).symm

/-- Inputs i,j; output k, with Kuratowski coding. -/
def kpairForm (i j k : Nat) : Form :=
  fSetByF k (fOr (SingletonInfinity.singForm (i + 1) 0) (pairForm (i + 1) (j + 1) 0))

theorem sat_kpairForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (i j k : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (kpairForm i j k) ↔ env k = kpair B (env i) (env j) := by
  refine sat_setBy B env k _ _ fun x => ?_
  change (Sat mem (scons x env) (SingletonInfinity.singForm (i + 1) 0) ∨
    Sat mem (scons x env) (pairForm (i + 1) (j + 1) 0)) ↔ _
  rw [SingletonInfinity.sat_singForm B.toBase, sat_pairForm B, kpair_mem B]
  rfl

/-- Graph f contains the ordered pair (x,y). -/
def appForm (f x y : Nat) : Form :=
  fEx (fAnd (kpairForm (x + 1) (y + 1) 0) (fMem 0 (f + 1)))

theorem sat_appForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (f x y : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (appForm f x y) ↔ mem (kpair B (env x) (env y)) (env f) := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨p, hp, hm⟩ => ?_,
    fun hm => ⟨kpair B (env x) (env y), (sat_kpairForm B _ _ _ _).mpr rfl, hm⟩⟩
  have hp' : p = kpair B (env x) (env y) := (sat_kpairForm B _ _ _ _).mp hp
  change mem p (env f) at hm
  rwa [hp'] at hm

/-- Input i; output j, for the von Neumann successor. -/
def succForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fSetByF j (fOr (fMem 0 (i + 1)) (fEq 0 (i + 1)))

theorem sat_succForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (succForm i j) ↔ env j = succ B (env i) :=
  sat_setBy B env j _ _ fun x => (succ_spec B (env i) x).symm

theorem quotientBase (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    Base (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h) where
  toBase := SingletonInfinity.quotientBase rawMem witness h
  union := QuotientBasic.quotient_union rawMem witness h

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.FiniteSets

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientBasic

/-!
The noncircular singleton index for an ordinary-Infinity construction.

This first checkpoint follows the least-singleton-closed-set cut in
`ZF/stdzf/coq/Std_setinf.v:or_to_zf_core`, upstream
297ab8df7e5de329605c3875b4934643b371a5e3, used by the attributed Mira-Cult /
Jeff verification through `S_ax.v:S_inf` and `S_main.v:ZF_to_S0`.

The base below has only Extensionality, Pairing and actual first-order
Separation. It does not contain Infinity or Separation for arbitrary semantic
predicates. A literal ZMem formula cuts the least singleton-closed index out
of an already supplied singleton-closed container. The resulting index has
set induction and formula induction. At an empty root, singleton injectivity
and exclusion of the root from the successor range give the elementary
inductive-structure conditions needed by the separate finite-attempt graph
argument. This checkpoint does not prove ordinary `Inf_form` or construct a
full `ZFAxioms` value; no internal omega or recursion theorem is assumed.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SingletonInfinity

open Form

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

/-- The small base required by the least singleton-closed index cut. -/
structure Base (mem : V → V → Prop) : Prop where
  ext : ∀ a b, (∀ z, mem z a ↔ mem z b) → a = b
  pair : ∀ a b, ∃ p, ∀ z, mem z p ↔ z = a ∨ z = b
  sep : ∀ (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) (a : V),
    ∃ b, ∀ z, mem z b ↔ mem z a ∧ Sat mem (scons z env) phi

noncomputable def singleton (B : Base mem) (a : V) : V := (B.pair a a).choose

theorem singleton_spec (B : Base mem) (a z : V) :
    mem z (singleton B a) ↔ z = a := by
  simpa only [singleton, or_self] using (B.pair a a).choose_spec z

theorem singleton_unique (B : Base mem) (a s : V)
    (hs : ∀ z, mem z s ↔ z = a) : s = singleton B a :=
  B.ext s (singleton B a) (fun z => (hs z).trans (singleton_spec B a z).symm)

theorem singleton_injective (B : Base mem) : Function.Injective (singleton B) := by
  intro a b hab
  exact (singleton_spec B b a).mp (hab ▸ (singleton_spec B a a).mpr rfl)

theorem empty_not_singleton (B : Base mem) (e : V) (he : ∀ z, ¬ mem z e) (a : V) :
    singleton B a ≠ e :=
  fun h => he a (h ▸ (singleton_spec B a a).mpr rfl)

def Closed (B : Base mem) (X : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ x, mem x X → mem (singleton B x) X

theorem closed_of_exact_singletons (B : Base mem) (X : V)
    (h : ∀ x, mem x X → ∃ s, mem s X ∧ ∀ z, mem z s ↔ z = x) : Closed B X := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hsX, hs⟩ := h x hx
  simpa only [singleton_unique B x s hs] using hsX

def LeastMember (B : Base mem) (e z : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ X, mem e X → Closed B X → mem z X

/-- The source is slot i, and the exact singleton is slot j. -/
def singForm (i j : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fIff (fMem 0 (j + 1)) (fEq 0 (i + 1)))

theorem sat_singForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (singForm i j) ↔ env j = singleton B (env i) := by
  change (∀ z, Sat mem (scons z env)
    (fIff (fMem 0 (j + 1)) (fEq 0 (i + 1)))) ↔ _
  exact ⟨fun hs => B.ext _ _ fun z => ((Sat_fIff (mem := mem)).mp (hs z)).trans
      (singleton_spec B (env i) z).symm,
    fun hs z => (Sat_fIff (mem := mem)).mpr (show mem z (env j) ↔ z = env i by
      rw [hs]; exact singleton_spec B (env i) z)⟩

def closedForm (i : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fImp (fMem 0 (i + 1))
    (fEx (fAnd (fMem 0 (i + 2)) (singForm 1 0))))

theorem sat_closedForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (i : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (closedForm i) ↔ Closed B (env i) := by
  change (∀ x, mem x (env i) → ∃ s, mem s (env i) ∧
    Sat mem (scons s (scons x env)) (singForm 1 0)) ↔ _
  refine ⟨fun hc x hx => ?_,
    fun hc x hx => ⟨singleton B x, hc x hx, (sat_singForm B _ 1 0).mpr rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hSing⟩ := hc x hx
  have heq : s = singleton B x := (sat_singForm B _ 1 0).mp hSing
  simpa only [heq] using hs

/-- Membership in every singleton-closed set containing the distinguished root. -/
def zMemForm (z e : Nat) : Form :=
  fAll (fImp (fAnd (fMem (e + 1) 0) (closedForm 0)) (fMem (z + 1) 0))

theorem sat_zMemForm (B : Base mem) (env : Nat → V) (z e : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (zMemForm z e) ↔ LeastMember B (env e) (env z) := by
  change (∀ X, mem (env e) X ∧ Sat mem (scons X env) (closedForm 0) →
    mem (env z) X) ↔ _
  exact ⟨fun h X he hc => h X ⟨he, (sat_closedForm B _ 0).mpr hc⟩,
    fun h X hx => h X hx.1 ((sat_closedForm B _ 0).mp hx.2)⟩

/-- Induction here quantifies over represented sets; it is not unrestricted
induction over external semantic predicates. -/
structure Index (B : Base mem) (e N : V) : Prop where
  zero_mem : mem e N
  closed : Closed B N
  least : ∀ X, mem e X → Closed B X → ∀ z, mem z N → mem z X

/-- One actual ZMem Separation instance supplies the singleton index. -/
theorem index_of_container (B : Base mem) (e Y : V) (heY : mem e Y)
    (hY : Closed B Y) : ∃ N, Index B e N := by
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := B.sep (zMemForm 0 1) (fun _ => e) Y
  have hSpec (z : V) : mem z N ↔ mem z Y ∧ LeastMember B e z :=
    (hN z).trans (and_congr Iff.rfl (sat_zMemForm B _ 0 1))
  refine ⟨N, (hSpec e).mpr ⟨heY, fun _ he _ => he⟩, fun z hz => ?_,
    fun X heX hX z hz => ((hSpec z).mp hz).2 X heX hX⟩
  obtain ⟨hzY, hzLeast⟩ := (hSpec z).mp hz
  exact (hSpec (singleton B z)).mpr ⟨hY z hzY, fun X heX hX => hX z (hzLeast X heX hX)⟩

/-- Formula induction uses the actual source formula's Separation instance. -/
theorem index_formula_induction (B : Base mem) {e N : V} (hN : Index B e N)
    (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) (hZero : Sat mem (scons e env) phi)
    (hStep : ∀ x, mem x N → Sat mem (scons x env) phi →
      Sat mem (scons (singleton B x) env) phi) :
    ∀ x, mem x N → Sat mem (scons x env) phi := by
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := B.sep phi env N
  have heX : mem e X := (hX e).mpr ⟨hN.zero_mem, hZero⟩
  have hcX : Closed B X := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hxN, hPhi⟩ := (hX x).mp hx
    exact (hX (singleton B x)).mpr ⟨hN.closed x hxN, hStep x hxN hPhi⟩
  exact fun x hx => ((hX x).mp (hN.least X heX hcX x hx)).2

theorem quotientBase (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    Base (QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h) where
  ext := QuotientModel.quotient_extensional rawMem witness h
  pair := QuotientBasic.quotient_pair rawMem witness h
  sep := QuotientSeparation.quotient_separation rawMem witness h

/-- The actual quotient supplies an empty-root singleton index, not yet a
set closed under von Neumann successor. -/
theorem quotient_index (rawMem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V)
    (h : ProfileModel.ModelsCPGIC rawMem) :
    ∃ e N, (∀ z, ¬ QuotientModel.quotientMember rawMem witness h z e) ∧
      Index (quotientBase rawMem witness h) e N := by
  obtain ⟨Y, ⟨e, heY, he⟩, hY⟩ :=
    QuotientBasic.quotient_empty_singleton_container rawMem witness h
  exact ⟨e, (index_of_container (quotientBase rawMem witness h) e Y heY
    (closed_of_exact_singletons (quotientBase rawMem witness h) Y hY)).imp fun _ hN => ⟨he, hN⟩⟩

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.SingletonInfinity

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.KQ1Power

/-!
The actual quotient structure of an equality-free CP/GIC model.

An inhabited CP/GIC model supplies every field of `KQHyp.QHyp` (`ofCPGIC`): the GIC half, the
bisimilarity laws and profile pairs of the model, and interpreted union, power and
singleton-closed containers bounded by its raw CP container. The quotient is the `KQ1Model`
quotient of that structure. This module and `QuotientSeparation` … `QuotientCPGIC` state the
`KQ1*` results for CP/GIC models under their original names.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientModel

open KQHyp
open Form ProfileCollection ProfileComposition ProfileAxioms ProfileModel CompositionModel
open DeepPositiveClosure

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

theorem ofCPGIC (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) : QHyp mem :=
  have hc := (sat_containerForm mem (fun _ => witness)).mp (h.1 _)
  have refl := eqv_refl_of_model mem witness h
  have symm : ∀ x y, Eqv mem x y → Eqv mem y x := fun _ _ => eqv_symm_of_model mem witness h
  have trans : ∀ x y z, Eqv mem x y → Eqv mem y z → Eqv mem x z :=
    fun _ _ _ => eqv_trans_of_model mem witness h
  ⟨h.2, refl, symm _ _, trans _ _ _, eqv_extensionality_of_model mem witness h,
    pairs_of_model mem witness h,
    fun a => union_of_instance mem a hc refl trans (union_instance mem h.2 a),
    fun a => power_of_instances mem a hc refl symm trans
      (eqv_extensionality_of_model mem witness h) (KQ1Power.trace_instance mem h.2 a)
      (PowerSyntax.power_instance mem h.2 a),
    fun root => singleton_closed_of_containers mem root hc (pairs_of_model mem witness h)
      refl symm trans⟩

theorem member_right_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    {x y y' : V} (hyy' : Eqv mem y y') : Member mem x y ↔ Member mem x y' :=
  KQ1Model.member_right_congr mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) hyy'

abbrev memberForm := KQ1Model.memberForm

abbrev translate := KQ1Model.translate

abbrev RelSat (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) := KQ1Model.RelSat mem env

theorem sat_memberForm (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (i j : Nat) :
    Sat mem env (memberForm i j) ↔ Member mem (env i) (env j) :=
  KQ1Model.sat_memberForm mem env i j

theorem sat_translate (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat mem env (translate phi) ↔ RelSat mem env phi :=
  KQ1Model.sat_translate mem phi env

theorem equalityFree_translate (phi : Form) : EqualityFree (translate phi) :=
  KQ1Model.equalityFree_translate phi

abbrev Domain (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :=
  KQ1Model.Domain mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h)

abbrev mk (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) (x : V) :
    Domain mem witness h :=
  KQ1Model.mk mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) x

abbrev quotientMember (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) :
    Domain mem witness h → Domain mem witness h → Prop :=
  KQ1Model.quotientMember mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h)

theorem mk_eq_iff (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem) (x y : V) :
    mk mem witness h x = mk mem witness h y ↔ Eqv mem x y :=
  KQ1Model.mk_eq_iff mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) x y

theorem mk_scons (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (x : V) (env : Nat → V) :
    (fun i => mk mem witness h (scons x env i)) =
      scons (mk mem witness h x) (fun i => mk mem witness h (env i)) :=
  KQ1Model.mk_scons mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) x env

theorem sat_quotient (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (phi : Form) (env : Nat → V) :
    Sat (quotientMember mem witness h) (fun i => mk mem witness h (env i)) phi ↔
      RelSat mem env phi :=
  KQ1Model.sat_quotient mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) phi env

theorem relSat_congr (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (phi : Form) (env env' : Nat → V) (he : ∀ i, Eqv mem (env i) (env' i)) :
    RelSat mem env phi ↔ RelSat mem env' phi :=
  KQ1Model.relSat_congr mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) phi env env' he

theorem quotient_extensional (mem : V → V → Prop) (witness : V) (h : ModelsCPGIC mem)
    (x y : Domain mem witness h)
    (hMembers : ∀ z, quotientMember mem witness h z x ↔ quotientMember mem witness h z y) :
    x = y :=
  KQ1Model.quotient_extensional mem witness (ofCPGIC mem witness h) x y hMembers

#print axioms sat_quotient
#print axioms quotient_extensional
#print axioms equalityFree_translate

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.QuotientModel

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.WellFoundedPart

/-!
Actual first-order formula relativization to the internally well-founded part.

The domain and its ambient defining formula are those of WellFoundedPart,
following the attributed well-founded-part interpretation in the pinned
busy-beaver source ZF/stdzf_r3/regcon/WF.v, upstream
297ab8df7e5de329605c3875b4934643b371a5e3. Quantifiers in the translated input
formula are guarded by the ambient wfForm; that defining guard is not itself
relativized. Atomic membership and logical equality keep their original slots.

This is a semantic formula adapter for any relation, with no model axioms,
nonempty-domain premise, choice of representatives or external well-foundedness
assumption. It does not by itself transport the set-theoretic axioms, establish
a ZF model, or prove a consistency comparison or machine endpoint.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFRelativization

open Form WellFoundedPart DeepPositiveClosure

universe u
variable {V : Type u}

/-- Every original De Bruijn slot is retained. The inserted guard refers to
the new bound variable at slot0 and is evaluated in the ambient structure. -/
def translate : Form → Form
  | fMem i j => fMem i j
  | fEq i j => fEq i j
  | fBot => fBot
  | fImp a b => fImp (translate a) (translate b)
  | fAnd a b => fAnd (translate a) (translate b)
  | fOr a b => fOr (translate a) (translate b)
  | fAll a => fAll (fImp (wfForm 0) (translate a))
  | fEx a => fEx (fAnd (wfForm 0) (translate a))

/-- Parameters are the underlying values of the supplied WF-domain objects;
no arbitrary ambient representative is selected. -/
def liftEnv (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → Domain mem) : Nat → V :=
  fun i => (env i).val

theorem liftEnv_scons (mem : V → V → Prop) (x : Domain mem)
    (env : Nat → Domain mem) :
    liftEnv mem (scons x env) = scons x.val (liftEnv mem env) := by
  funext n
  cases n <;> rfl

def envOfWF (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V)
    (hWF : ∀ i, WF mem (env i)) : Nat → Domain mem :=
  fun i => ⟨env i, hWF i⟩

theorem liftEnv_envOfWF (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V)
    (hWF : ∀ i, WF mem (env i)) :
    liftEnv mem (envOfWF mem env hWF) = env := rfl

theorem sat_guard (mem : V → V → Prop) (env : Nat → V) (x : V) :
    Sat mem (scons x env) (wfForm 0) ↔ WF mem x :=
  sat_wfForm mem (scons x env) 0

/-- Satisfaction in the actual WF subtype agrees with ambient satisfaction
of the translated actual Form, including arbitrary parameter valuations. -/
theorem sat_translate (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form) :
    ∀ env : Nat → Domain mem,
      Sat mem (liftEnv mem env) (translate phi) ↔ Sat (domainMem mem) env phi := by
  induction phi with
  | fMem i j => intro env; rfl
  | fEq i j =>
    intro env
    change (env i).val = (env j).val ↔ env i = env j
    constructor
    · exact Subtype.ext
    · exact congrArg Subtype.val
  | fBot => intro env; rfl
  | fImp a b iha ihb =>
    intro env
    exact imp_congr (iha env) (ihb env)
  | fAnd a b iha ihb =>
    intro env
    exact and_congr (iha env) (ihb env)
  | fOr a b iha ihb =>
    intro env
    exact or_congr (iha env) (ihb env)
  | fAll a ih =>
    intro env
    change (∀ x : V, Sat mem (scons x (liftEnv mem env)) (wfForm 0) →
      Sat mem (scons x (liftEnv mem env)) (translate a)) ↔
        ∀ x : Domain mem, Sat (domainMem mem) (scons x env) a
    constructor
    · intro h x
      apply (ih (scons x env)).mp
      rw [liftEnv_scons]
      exact h x.val ((sat_guard mem (liftEnv mem env) x.val).mpr x.property)
    · intro h x hx
      let y : Domain mem := ⟨x, (sat_guard mem (liftEnv mem env) x).mp hx⟩
      have hy := (ih (scons y env)).mpr (h y)
      rwa [liftEnv_scons] at hy
  | fEx a ih =>
    intro env
    change (∃ x : V, Sat mem (scons x (liftEnv mem env)) (wfForm 0) ∧
      Sat mem (scons x (liftEnv mem env)) (translate a)) ↔
        ∃ x : Domain mem, Sat (domainMem mem) (scons x env) a
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, ha⟩
      let y : Domain mem := ⟨x, (sat_guard mem (liftEnv mem env) x).mp hx⟩
      refine ⟨y, (ih (scons y env)).mp ?_⟩
      rw [liftEnv_scons]
      exact ha
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      refine ⟨x.val, (sat_guard mem (liftEnv mem env) x.val).mpr x.property, ?_⟩
      have ha := (ih (scons x env)).mpr hx
      rwa [liftEnv_scons] at ha

theorem sat_translate_of_wf (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form)
    (env : Nat → V) (hWF : ∀ i, WF mem (env i)) :
    Sat mem env (translate phi) ↔
      Sat (domainMem mem) (envOfWF mem env hWF) phi := by
  exact sat_translate mem phi (envOfWF mem env hWF)

/-- The unary Separation matrix convention: its tested element occupies0. -/
theorem sat_translate_scons (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form)
    (env : Nat → Domain mem) (x : Domain mem) :
    Sat mem (scons x.val (liftEnv mem env)) (translate phi) ↔
      Sat (domainMem mem) (scons x env) phi := by
  rw [← liftEnv_scons]
  exact sat_translate mem phi (scons x env)

/-- The inherited matrix convention has first argument0 and second argument1. -/
theorem sat_translate_matrix (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form)
    (env : Nat → Domain mem) (x y : Domain mem) :
    MatrixRelation mem (translate phi) (liftEnv mem env) x.val y.val ↔
      MatrixRelation (domainMem mem) phi env x y := by
  change Sat mem (scons x.val (scons y.val (liftEnv mem env))) (translate phi) ↔ _
  rw [← liftEnv_scons mem y env, ← liftEnv_scons mem x (scons y env)]
  exact sat_translate mem phi (scons x (scons y env))

/-- The repository Replacement convention is output0,input1, written y,x. -/
theorem sat_translate_relOf (mem : V → V → Prop) (phi : Form)
    (env : Nat → Domain mem) (y x : Domain mem) :
    relOf mem (translate phi) (liftEnv mem env) y.val x.val ↔
      relOf (domainMem mem) phi env y x :=
  sat_translate_matrix mem phi env y x

/-- Relativization preserves precisely the original use of equality;
the inserted WF guards themselves are equality-free. -/
theorem equalityFree_translate (phi : Form) :
    EqualityFree (translate phi) ↔ EqualityFree phi := by
  induction phi with
  | fMem i j => rfl
  | fEq i j => rfl
  | fBot => rfl
  | fImp a b iha ihb => exact and_congr iha ihb
  | fAnd a b iha ihb => exact and_congr iha ihb
  | fOr a b iha ihb => exact and_congr iha ihb
  | fAll a ih =>
    change (EqualityFree (wfForm 0) ∧ EqualityFree (translate a)) ↔ EqualityFree a
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ih.mp h.2
    · intro h; exact ⟨equalityFree_wfForm 0, ih.mpr h⟩
  | fEx a ih =>
    change (EqualityFree (wfForm 0) ∧ EqualityFree (translate a)) ↔ EqualityFree a
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ih.mp h.2
    · intro h; exact ⟨equalityFree_wfForm 0, ih.mpr h⟩

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.WFRelativization

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.SatSupport

/-!
Absoluteness between a model of ZF and its constructible class.

`N = {x // InL x}` with `memL` is a model of the ZF bundle
(`ConstructibleZF.L_zfAxioms`). Basic set operations, internal `ω`, recorded
graph application, environment shift, truth bits and satisfaction-certificate
relations agree on constructible data. `satIn_iff` proves satisfaction agreement
for a constructible set structure and environment when the code is valid in
both the ambient and constructible models. `memRel_iff` compares the encoded
membership relation.

The extension below proves formula-code absoluteness, replaces an arbitrary
ambient environment by a constructible environment on its internally finite
support, and transports definability and `Def`. Hierarchy comparison then gives
`vEqL`: every constructible set is constructible in the sense of the constructible
model. The internal well-order and Choice arguments remain separate obligations.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleAbs

open NamedZF NForm InternalOrd InternalRank TransRec ConstructibleDef Constructible
  ConstructibleZF LeanProofs.BoundedZFCConsistency

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}


/-! ## Inversion for formula codes (in any model of the ZF bundle) -/

section Inversion

/-- `c = ⟨t, x⟩` with `t` a numeral. -/
def tagF (c t x : Nat) : NForm :=
  .ex (c + x + 1) (.and (ConstructibleReflect.natF (c + x + 1) t) (kpairF c (c + x + 1) x))

theorem nsat_tagF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (c t x : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (tagF c t x) ↔ ρ c = kpair H (natV H t) (ρ x) := by
  simp only [tagF, NSat, ConstructibleReflect.nsat_natF H, nsat_kpairF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, rfl, h⟩ => h, fun h => ⟨_, rfl, h⟩⟩

/-- `c = ⟨t, ⟨a, b⟩⟩`. -/
def tag2F (c t a b : Nat) : NForm :=
  .ex (c + a + b + 1) (.and (kpairF (c + a + b + 1) a b) (tagF c t (c + a + b + 1)))

theorem nsat_tag2F (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (c t a b : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (tag2F c t a b) ↔ ρ c = kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H (ρ a) (ρ b)) := by
  simp only [tag2F, NSat, nsat_kpairF H, nsat_tagF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨_, rfl, h⟩ => h, fun h => ⟨_, rfl, h⟩⟩

/-- The possible shapes of a formula code. -/
def CodeShape (H : ZFAxioms mem) (c : V) : Prop :=
  (∃ i j, mem i (omegaV H) ∧ mem j (omegaV H) ∧
    (c = kpair H (natV H 0) (kpair H i j) ∨ c = kpair H (natV H 1) (kpair H i j))) ∨
  c = kpair H (natV H 2) (vempty H) ∨
  (∃ a b, IsFormCodeSem H a ∧ IsFormCodeSem H b ∧
    (c = kpair H (natV H 3) (kpair H a b) ∨ c = kpair H (natV H 4) (kpair H a b) ∨
      c = kpair H (natV H 5) (kpair H a b))) ∨
  (∃ a, IsFormCodeSem H a ∧ (c = kpair H (natV H 6) a ∨ c = kpair H (natV H 7) a))

/-- The code property and its shape (name `0`). -/
def shapeF : NForm :=
  .and (ConstructibleDef.isCodeF 0)
  (.or (.ex 1 (.ex 2 (.and (SatSupport.inOmegaF 1) (.and (SatSupport.inOmegaF 2)
      (.or (tag2F 0 0 1 2) (tag2F 0 1 1 2))))))
  (.or (.ex 1 (.and (.all 2 (.imp (.mem 2 1) .bot)) (tagF 0 2 1)))
  (.or (.ex 1 (.ex 2 (.and (ConstructibleDef.isCodeF 1) (.and (ConstructibleDef.isCodeF 2)
      (.or (tag2F 0 3 1 2) (.or (tag2F 0 4 1 2) (tag2F 0 5 1 2)))))))
    (.ex 1 (.and (ConstructibleDef.isCodeF 1) (.or (tagF 0 6 1) (tagF 0 7 1)))))))

theorem nsat_shapeF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) :
    NSat mem ρ shapeF ↔ IsFormCodeSem H (ρ 0) ∧ CodeShape H (ρ 0) := by
  simp only [shapeF, NSat, ConstructibleDef.nsat_isCodeF H, SatSupport.nsat_inOmegaF H,
    nsat_tag2F H, nsat_tagF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => or_congr Iff.rfl (or_congr
    ⟨fun ⟨z, hz, h⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨vempty H, fun w hw => vempty_spec H w hw, h⟩⟩ Iff.rfl)
  rw [h, show z = vempty H from H.ext _ _ fun w =>
    ⟨fun hw => absurd hw (hz w), fun hw => absurd hw (vempty_spec H w)⟩]

/-- **Inversion**: every internal formula code is an atom, `⊥`, or a constructor
applied to internal codes. -/
theorem code_shape (H : ZFAxioms mem) : ∀ c, IsFormCodeSem H c → CodeShape H c :=
  fun c hc => (isFormCodeSem_ind' H (fun c => IsFormCodeSem H c ∧ CodeShape H c)
    (toForm id shapeF) (fun _ => vempty H)
    (fun y => by rw [sat_toForm, nsat_shapeF H]; rfl)
    (fun a b ha hb => ⟨isFormCodeSem_memAtom H ha hb, Or.inl ⟨a, b, ha, hb, Or.inl rfl⟩⟩)
    (fun a b ha hb => ⟨isFormCodeSem_eqAtom H ha hb, Or.inl ⟨a, b, ha, hb, Or.inr rfl⟩⟩)
    ⟨isFormCodeSem_bot H, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩
    (fun a b ha hb => ⟨isFormCodeSem_imp H ha.1 hb.1,
      Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, b, ha.1, hb.1, Or.inl rfl⟩))⟩)
    (fun a b ha hb => ⟨isFormCodeSem_and H ha.1 hb.1,
      Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, b, ha.1, hb.1, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩))⟩)
    (fun a b ha hb => ⟨isFormCodeSem_or H ha.1 hb.1,
      Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨a, b, ha.1, hb.1, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)⟩))⟩)
    (fun a ha => ⟨isFormCodeSem_all H ha.1, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, ha.1, Or.inl rfl⟩))⟩)
    (fun a ha => ⟨isFormCodeSem_ex H ha.1, Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, ha.1, Or.inr rfl⟩))⟩)
    c hc).2

end Inversion
section Ops

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP

/-- Bounded quantifiers agree because every member of a constructible set is constructible. -/
private theorem forall_memL_iff (A : {x // InL H hP x}) (P : V → Prop) :
    (∀ x : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP x A → P x.1) ↔ ∀ x, mem x A.1 → P x :=
  ⟨fun h x hx => h ⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP A.2 hx⟩ hx, fun h x hx => h x.1 hx⟩

private theorem exists_memL_iff (A : {x // InL H hP x}) (P : V → Prop) :
    (∃ x : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP x A ∧ P x.1) ↔ ∃ x, mem x A.1 ∧ P x :=
  ⟨fun ⟨x, hx, h⟩ => ⟨x.1, hx, h⟩, fun ⟨x, hx, h⟩ => ⟨⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP A.2 hx⟩, hx, h⟩⟩

/-- Equality of a constructible set with an ambient set, by extensionality. -/
theorem val_eq {u : {x // InL H hP x}} {v : V} (hv : ∀ z, mem z v → InL H hP z)
    (h : ∀ z : {x // InL H hP x}, mem z.1 u.1 ↔ mem z.1 v) : u.1 = v :=
  H.ext _ _ fun z => ⟨fun hz => (h ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP u.2 hz⟩).1 hz,
    fun hz => (h ⟨z, hv z hz⟩).2 hz⟩

theorem val_vpair (a b : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (vpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b).1 = vpair H a.1 b.1 := by
  refine val_eq H hR hP (fun z hz => ?_) fun z => ?_
  · exact ((vpair_spec H _ _ z).1 hz).elim (· ▸ a.2) (· ▸ b.2)
  · rw [show mem z.1 (vpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b).1 ↔ _ from
      vpair_spec (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b z, vpair_spec H, Subtype.ext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]

theorem val_vsingle (a : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (vsingle (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a).1 = vsingle H a.1 :=
  val_vpair H hR hP a a

theorem val_kpair (a b : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b).1 = kpair H a.1 b.1 := by
  show (vpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _).1 = vpair H _ _
  rw [val_vpair H hR hP, val_vsingle H hR hP, val_vpair H hR hP]

theorem val_vempty : (vempty (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)).1 = vempty H :=
  val_eq H hR hP (fun z hz => absurd hz (vempty_spec H z))
    fun z => iff_of_false (vempty_spec (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) z) (vempty_spec H _)

theorem val_vunion (a : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (vunion (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a).1 = vunion H a.1 := by
  refine val_eq H hR hP (fun z hz => ?_) fun z => ?_
  · obtain ⟨v, hzv, hva⟩ := (vunion_spec H _ z).1 hz
    exact inL_trans H hR hP (inL_trans H hR hP a.2 hva) hzv
  · rw [show mem z.1 (vunion (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a).1 ↔ _ from
      vunion_spec (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a z, vunion_spec H]
    simpa only [memL, and_comm] using exists_memL_iff H hR hP a (fun v => mem z.1 v)

theorem val_vcup (a b : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (vcup (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b).1 = vcup H a.1 b.1 := by
  show (vunion (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _).1 = vunion H _
  rw [val_vunion H hR hP, val_vpair H hR hP]

theorem val_vsucc (a : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (vsucc (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a).1 = vsucc H a.1 := by
  show (vcup (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _).1 = vcup H _ _
  rw [val_vcup H hR hP, val_vsingle H hR hP]

theorem val_natV : ∀ k, (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) k).1 = natV H k
  | 0 => val_vempty H hR hP
  | k + 1 => by rw [natV_succ, natV_succ, val_vsucc H hR hP, val_natV k]

theorem inductive_iff (c : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    inductiveV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c ↔ inductiveV H c.1 := by
  unfold inductiveV
  change (mem (vempty (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)).1 c.1 ∧
    ∀ y : {x // InL H hP x}, mem y.1 c.1 → mem (vsucc (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) y).1 c.1) ↔ _
  simp only [val_vempty H hR hP, val_vsucc H hR hP]
  exact and_congr Iff.rfl (forall_memL_iff H hR hP c fun y => mem (vsucc H y) c.1)

theorem inL_omega : InL H hP (omegaV H) := inL_ord H hR hP (ord_omega H)

theorem val_omegaV : (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)).1 = omegaV H := by
  refine val_eq H hR hP (fun z hz => inL_trans H hR hP (inL_omega H hR hP) hz) fun z => ?_
  rw [show mem z.1 (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)).1 ↔ _ from
    mem_omega_iff (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) z, mem_omega_iff H]
  exact ⟨fun h c hc => (mem_omega_iff H z.1).1 (h ⟨omegaV H, inL_omega H hR hP⟩
    ((inductive_iff H hR hP _).2 (omega_inductive H))) c hc,
    fun h c hc => h c.1 ((inductive_iff H hR hP c).1 hc)⟩

theorem mem_omegaN (n : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    mem n.1 (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)).1 ↔ mem n.1 (omegaV H) := by
  rw [val_omegaV H hR hP]

/-- The components of a constructible pair are constructible. -/
theorem inL_kpair {a b : V} (h : InL H hP (kpair H a b)) : InL H hP a ∧ InL H hP b := by
  have hs : InL H hP (vsingle H a) := inL_trans H hR hP h ((kpair_mem H a b _).2 (Or.inl rfl))
  have hp : InL H hP (vpair H a b) := inL_trans H hR hP h ((kpair_mem H a b _).2 (Or.inr rfl))
  exact ⟨inL_trans H hR hP hs ((vsingle_spec H a a).2 rfl),
    inL_trans H hR hP hp ((vpair_spec H a b b).2 (Or.inr rfl))⟩

theorem inL_of_kpair_mem {a b F : V} (hF : InL H hP F) (h : mem (kpair H a b) F) :
    InL H hP a ∧ InL H hP b :=
  inL_kpair H hR hP (inL_trans H hR hP hF h)

theorem kpairN_mem (a b F : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    mem (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b).1 F.1 ↔ mem (kpair H a.1 b.1) F.1 := by
  rw [val_kpair H hR hP]

theorem kpairN_eq (a b c : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    c = kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b ↔ c.1 = kpair H a.1 b.1 := by
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, val_kpair H hR hP]

/-- Functionality of a graph agrees. -/
theorem functional_iff (F : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (∀ x y y' : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) x y) F →
      memL H hP (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) x y') F → y = y') ↔
    (∀ x y y', mem (kpair H x y) F.1 → mem (kpair H x y') F.1 → y = y') := by
  refine ⟨fun h x y y' hy hy' => ?_, fun h x y y' hy hy' => Subtype.ext (h x.1 y.1 y'.1
    ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hy) ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hy'))⟩
  obtain ⟨hx, hyL⟩ := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP F.2 hy
  obtain ⟨-, hy'L⟩ := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP F.2 hy'
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (h ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hyL⟩ ⟨y', hy'L⟩ ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hy)
    ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hy'))

theorem isFunctionOn_iff (F d : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    IsFunctionOn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) F d ↔ IsFunctionOn H F.1 d.1 := by
  unfold IsFunctionOn
  refine and_congr (functional_iff H hR hP F) (and_congr ⟨fun h x hx => ?_, fun h x hx => ?_⟩
    ⟨fun h p hp => ?_, fun h p hp => ?_⟩)
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h ⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP d.2 hx⟩ hx
    exact ⟨y.1, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hy⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h x.1 hx
    exact ⟨⟨y, (inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP F.2 hy).2⟩, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hy⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hx, he⟩ := h ⟨p, inL_trans H hR hP F.2 hp⟩ hp
    exact ⟨x.1, y.1, hx, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hx, he⟩ := h p.1 hp
    have hxy := inL_kpair H hR hP (he ▸ p.2)
    exact ⟨⟨x, hxy.1⟩, ⟨y, hxy.2⟩, hx, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).2 he⟩

theorem isEnvOn_iff (A E : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    IsEnvOn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) A E ↔ IsEnvOn H A.1 E.1 := by
  unfold IsEnvOn
  rw [isFunctionOn_iff H hR hP]
  refine and_congr (Iff.of_eq (congrArg (IsFunctionOn H E.1) (val_omegaV H hR hP)))
    ⟨fun h n y hy => ?_, fun h n y hy => h n.1 y.1 ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hy)⟩
  obtain ⟨hn, hyL⟩ := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP E.2 hy
  exact h ⟨n, hn⟩ ⟨y, hyL⟩ ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hy)

/-- Application agrees on a graph with a recorded value. -/
theorem val_applyV {F x : {x // InL H hP x}}
    (hfun : ∀ a b b', mem (kpair H a b) F.1 → mem (kpair H a b') F.1 → b = b')
    {y : V} (hy : mem (kpair H x.1 y) F.1) : (applyV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) F x).1 = y := by
  rw [applyV_eq (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ((functional_iff H hR hP F).2 hfun) (x := x)
    (y := ⟨y, (inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP F.2 hy).2⟩) ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hy)]

theorem val_applyV_env {A E n : {x // InL H hP x}} (hE : IsEnvOn H A.1 E.1)
    (hn : mem n.1 (omegaV H)) : (applyV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) E n).1 = applyV H E.1 n.1 :=
  val_applyV H hR hP hE.1.1 (applyV_mem H (hE.1.2.1 n.1 hn))

theorem inL_nat {n : V} (hn : mem n (omegaV H)) : InL H hP n :=
  inL_trans H hR hP (inL_omega H hR hP) hn

theorem inL_kpair_of {a b : V} (ha : InL H hP a) (hb : InL H hP b) : InL H hP (kpair H a b) :=
  inL_pair H hR hP (inL_pair H hR hP ha ha) (inL_pair H hR hP ha hb)

theorem val_econs {d E : {x // InL H hP x}}
    (hfun : ∀ a b b', mem (kpair H a b) E.1 → mem (kpair H a b') E.1 → b = b') :
    (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) d E).1 = econs H d.1 E.1 := by
  have hfunN := (functional_iff H hR hP E).2 hfun
  refine val_eq H hR hP (fun z hz => ?_) fun z => ?_
  · rcases (econs_spec H hfun d.1 z).1 hz with rfl | ⟨n, hn, y, hy, rfl⟩
    · exact inL_kpair_of H hR hP (inL_nat H hR hP (vempty_in_omega H)) d.2
    · exact inL_kpair_of H hR hP (inL_ord H hR hP (ord_succ H (ord_of_mem (ord_omega H) hn)))
        (inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP E.2 hy).2
  · rw [show mem z.1 (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) d E).1 ↔ _ from
      econs_spec (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) hfunN d z, econs_spec H hfun d.1 z.1,
      kpairN_eq H hR hP, val_vempty H hR hP]
    refine or_congr Iff.rfl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, y, hy, he⟩
      refine ⟨n.1, (mem_omegaN H hR hP n).1 hn, y.1, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hy, ?_⟩
      rw [(kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he, val_vsucc H hR hP]
    · rintro ⟨n, hn, y, hy, he⟩
      have hnL := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP E.2 hy
      refine ⟨⟨n, hnL.1⟩, (mem_omegaN H hR hP _).2 hn, ⟨y, hnL.2⟩,
        (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hy, ?_⟩
      rwa [kpairN_eq H hR hP, val_vsucc H hR hP]

theorem val_vbit (p : Prop) : (vbit (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) p).1 = vbit H p := by
  by_cases hp : p
  · rw [vbit_pos _ hp, vbit_pos _ hp, val_natV H hR hP]
  · rw [vbit_neg _ hp, vbit_neg _ hp, val_natV H hR hP]

theorem val_satTriple (c e b : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c e b).1 = satTriple H c.1 e.1 b.1 := by
  show (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _).1 = kpair H _ _
  rw [val_kpair H hR hP, val_kpair H hR hP]

theorem inL_satTriple {c e b : V} (h : InL H hP (satTriple H c e b)) :
    InL H hP c ∧ InL H hP e ∧ InL H hP b :=
  ⟨(inL_kpair H hR hP h).1, inL_kpair H hR hP (inL_kpair H hR hP h).2⟩

theorem codeEq_iff (t : Nat) (c x : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    c = kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t) x ↔
      c.1 = kpair H (natV H t) x.1 := by
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, val_kpair H hR hP, val_natV H hR hP]

theorem codeEq2_iff (t : Nat) (c x y : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    c = kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t)
      (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) x y) ↔ c.1 = kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H x.1 y.1) := by
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, val_kpair H hR hP, val_natV H hR hP, val_kpair H hR hP]

theorem bitEq_iff (b : {x // InL H hP x}) (p q : Prop) (hpq : p ↔ q) :
    b = vbit (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) p ↔ b.1 = vbit H q := by
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, val_vbit H hR hP, vbit_congr H hpq]

theorem natEq_iff (b : {x // InL H hP x}) (k : Nat) :
    b = natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) k ↔ b.1 = natV H k := by
  rw [Subtype.ext_iff, val_natV H hR hP]

theorem tripleMem_iff (c e b S : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    memL H hP (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c e b) S ↔ mem (satTriple H c.1 e.1 b.1) S.1 := by
  show mem (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c e b).1 S.1 ↔ _
  rw [val_satTriple H hR hP]

section Clauses

variable {A R S c e b : {x // InL H hP x}} (he : IsEnvOn H A.1 e.1)
include he

omit he in
theorem atom_clause (t : Nat) (QN : {x // InL H hP x} → {x // InL H hP x} → Prop)
    (Q : V → V → Prop) (hQ : ∀ i j : {x // InL H hP x}, mem i.1 (omegaV H) → mem j.1 (omegaV H) →
      (QN i j ↔ Q i.1 j.1)) :
    (∃ i j : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP i (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)) ∧
      memL H hP j (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)) ∧
      c = kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t)
        (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) i j) ∧ b = vbit (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (QN i j)) ↔
    (∃ i j, mem i (omegaV H) ∧ mem j (omegaV H) ∧ c.1 = kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H i j) ∧
      b.1 = vbit H (Q i j)) := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hc, hb⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hc, hb⟩ => ?_⟩
  · have hi' := (mem_omegaN H hR hP i).1 hi
    have hj' := (mem_omegaN H hR hP j).1 hj
    exact ⟨i.1, j.1, hi', hj', (codeEq2_iff H hR hP t c i j).1 hc,
      (bitEq_iff H hR hP b _ _ (hQ i j hi' hj')).1 hb⟩
  · let i' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨i, inL_nat H hR hP hi⟩
    let j' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨j, inL_nat H hR hP hj⟩
    exact ⟨i', j', (mem_omegaN H hR hP i').2 hi, (mem_omegaN H hR hP j').2 hj,
      (codeEq2_iff H hR hP t c i' j').2 hc, (bitEq_iff H hR hP b _ _ (hQ i' j' hi hj)).2 hb⟩

omit he in
theorem bin_clause (t : Nat) (op : Prop → Prop → Prop) :
    (∃ c1 c2 b1 b2 : {x // InL H hP x},
      c = kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t)
        (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c1 c2) ∧
      memL H hP (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c1 e b1) S ∧
      memL H hP (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c2 e b2) S ∧
      b = vbit (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (op (b1 = natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) 1)
        (b2 = natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) 1))) ↔
    (∃ c1 c2 b1 b2, c.1 = kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H c1 c2) ∧
      mem (satTriple H c1 e.1 b1) S.1 ∧ mem (satTriple H c2 e.1 b2) S.1 ∧
      b.1 = vbit H (op (b1 = natV H 1) (b2 = natV H 1))) := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨c1, c2, b1, b2, hc, h1, h2, hb⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨c1, c2, b1, b2, hc, h1, h2, hb⟩ => ?_⟩
  · exact ⟨c1.1, c2.1, b1.1, b2.1, (codeEq2_iff H hR hP t c c1 c2).1 hc,
      (tripleMem_iff H hR hP _ _ _ _).1 h1, (tripleMem_iff H hR hP _ _ _ _).1 h2,
      (bitEq_iff H hR hP b _ _ (by rw [natEq_iff H hR hP, natEq_iff H hR hP])).1 hb⟩
  · have t1 := inL_satTriple H hR hP (inL_trans H hR hP S.2 h1)
    have t2 := inL_satTriple H hR hP (inL_trans H hR hP S.2 h2)
    let c1' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨c1, t1.1⟩
    let c2' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨c2, t2.1⟩
    let b1' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨b1, t1.2.2⟩
    let b2' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨b2, t2.2.2⟩
    exact ⟨c1', c2', b1', b2', (codeEq2_iff H hR hP t c c1' c2').2 hc,
      (tripleMem_iff H hR hP c1' e b1' S).2 h1, (tripleMem_iff H hR hP c2' e b2' S).2 h2,
      (bitEq_iff H hR hP b _ _ (by rw [natEq_iff H hR hP, natEq_iff H hR hP])).2 hb⟩

theorem quant_clause (t u v : Nat) :
    (∃ c1 : {x // InL H hP x}, c = kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t) c1 ∧
      ((b = natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) u ∧ ∀ d : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP d A →
          memL H hP (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c1 (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) d e)
            (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) u)) S) ∨
       (b = natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) v ∧ ∃ d : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP d A ∧
