          memL H hP (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c1 (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) d e)
            (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) v)) S))) ↔
    (∃ c1, c.1 = kpair H (natV H t) c1 ∧
      ((b.1 = natV H u ∧ ∀ d, mem d A.1 → mem (satTriple H c1 (econs H d e.1) (natV H u)) S.1) ∨
       (b.1 = natV H v ∧ ∃ d, mem d A.1 ∧
          mem (satTriple H c1 (econs H d e.1) (natV H v)) S.1))) := by
  have hT : ∀ (c1 d : {x // InL H hP x}) (k : Nat),
      memL H hP (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c1 (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) d e)
        (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) k)) S ↔
      mem (satTriple H c1.1 (econs H d.1 e.1) (natV H k)) S.1 := fun c1 d k => by
    show mem (satTriple (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _ _).1 S.1 ↔ _
    rw [val_satTriple H hR hP, val_econs H hR hP he.1.1, val_natV H hR hP]
  have hc1 : ∀ c1 : V, c.1 = kpair H (natV H t) c1 → InL H hP c1 := fun c1 h =>
    (inL_kpair H hR hP (h ▸ c.2)).2
  simp only [codeEq_iff H hR hP, natEq_iff H hR hP, hT]
  have hall (c1 : {x // InL H hP x}) := forall_memL_iff H hR hP A
    (fun d => mem (satTriple H c1.1 (econs H d e.1) (natV H u)) S.1)
  have hex (c1 : {x // InL H hP x}) := exists_memL_iff H hR hP A
    (fun d => mem (satTriple H c1.1 (econs H d e.1) (natV H v)) S.1)
  simp only [hall, hex]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨c1, hc, h⟩ => ⟨c1.1, hc, h⟩, fun ⟨c1, hc, h⟩ => ⟨⟨c1, hc1 c1 hc⟩, hc, h⟩⟩

/-- **The certificate step relation is absolute** (at a genuine environment). -/
theorem justified_iff :
    Justified (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) A R S c e b ↔ Justified H A.1 R.1 S.1 c.1 e.1 b.1 := by
  have hval : ∀ i : {x // InL H hP x}, mem i.1 (omegaV H) →
      (applyV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) e i).1 = applyV H e.1 i.1 := fun i hi =>
    val_applyV_env H hR hP he hi
  unfold Justified
  refine or_congr ?_ (or_congr ?_ (or_congr ?_ (or_congr ?_ (or_congr ?_ (or_congr ?_
    (or_congr ?_ ?_))))))
  · exact atom_clause H hR hP 0 _ _ fun i j hi hj => by
      show mem (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _).1 R.1 ↔ _
      rw [val_kpair H hR hP, hval i hi, hval j hj]
  · exact atom_clause H hR hP 1 _ _ fun i j hi hj => by
      rw [Subtype.ext_iff, hval i hi, hval j hj]
  · rw [codeEq_iff H hR hP, val_vempty H hR hP, natEq_iff H hR hP]
  · exact bin_clause H hR hP 3 fun p q => p → q
  · exact bin_clause H hR hP 4 And
  · exact bin_clause H hR hP 5 Or
  · exact quant_clause H hR hP he 6 1 0
  · exact quant_clause H hR hP he 7 0 1

end Clauses

theorem satClosed_iff (A R S : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    SatClosed (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) A R S ↔ SatClosed H A.1 R.1 S.1 := by
  refine ⟨fun h c e b hm => ?_, fun h c e b hm => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨hc, he, hb⟩ := inL_satTriple H hR hP (inL_trans H hR hP S.2 hm)
    obtain ⟨hE, hJ⟩ := h ⟨c, hc⟩ ⟨e, he⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ ((tripleMem_iff H hR hP _ _ _ _).2 hm)
    have hE' := (isEnvOn_iff H hR hP A ⟨e, he⟩).1 hE
    exact ⟨hE', (justified_iff H hR hP hE').1 hJ⟩
  · obtain ⟨hE, hJ⟩ := h c.1 e.1 b.1 ((tripleMem_iff H hR hP _ _ _ _).1 hm)
    exact ⟨(isEnvOn_iff H hR hP A e).2 hE, (justified_iff H hR hP hE).2 hJ⟩

theorem certifies_iff (A R S c e b : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    Certifies (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) A R S c e b ↔ Certifies H A.1 R.1 S.1 c.1 e.1 b.1 :=
  ⟨fun h => ⟨(satClosed_iff H hR hP A R S).1 h.closed, (tripleMem_iff H hR hP _ _ _ _).1 h.holds⟩,
   fun h => ⟨(satClosed_iff H hR hP A R S).2 h.closed, (tripleMem_iff H hR hP _ _ _ _).2 h.holds⟩⟩

theorem isSetStructure_iff (A R : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    IsSetStructure (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) A R ↔ IsSetStructure H A.1 R.1 := by
  refine ⟨fun h => ⟨?_, fun p hp => ?_⟩, fun h => ⟨?_, fun p hp => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h.nonempty; exact ⟨d.1, hd⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, he⟩ := h.pairs ⟨p, inL_trans H hR hP R.2 hp⟩ hp
    exact ⟨x.1, y.1, hx, hy, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he⟩
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := h.nonempty; exact ⟨⟨d, inL_trans H hR hP A.2 hd⟩, hd⟩
  · obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, he⟩ := h.pairs p.1 hp
    exact ⟨⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP A.2 hx⟩, ⟨y, inL_trans H hR hP A.2 hy⟩, hx, hy,
      (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).2 he⟩

/-- **Satisfaction is absolute** for codes of both models and genuine environments. -/
theorem satIn_iff {A R c e : {x // InL H hP x}} (hS : IsSetStructure H A.1 R.1)
    (hcN : IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c) (hcM : IsFormCodeSem H c.1)
    (he : IsEnvOn H A.1 e.1) :
    SatIn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) A R c e ↔ SatIn H A.1 R.1 c.1 e.1 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS'⟩
    have := (certifies_iff H hR hP A R S c e _).1 hS'
    rw [val_natV H hR hP] at this
    exact ⟨S.1, this⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨S, hcert⟩ := exists_certifies (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)
      ((isSetStructure_iff H hR hP A R).2 hS) hcN ((isEnvOn_iff H hR hP A e).2 he)
    have hM := (certifies_iff H hR hP A R S c e _).1 hcert
    rw [val_vbit H hR hP] at hM
    have hb := certifies_bit H hcM hM
    rw [vbit_pos H h] at hb
    exact (vbit_eq_one H _).1 hb

theorem memRel_iff (X R : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    MemRel (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) X R ↔ MemRel H X.1 R.1 := by
  refine ⟨fun h p => ⟨fun hp => ?_, ?_⟩, fun h p => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, he⟩ := (h ⟨p, inL_trans H hR hP R.2 hp⟩).1 hp
    exact ⟨a.1, b.1, ha, hb, hab, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
    have haL := inL_trans H hR hP X.2 ha
    have hbL := inL_trans H hR hP X.2 hb
    exact (h ⟨_, inL_kpair_of H hR hP haL hbL⟩).2
      ⟨⟨a, haL⟩, ⟨b, hbL⟩, ha, hb, hab, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).2 rfl⟩
  · rw [show memL H hP p R ↔ mem p.1 R.1 from Iff.rfl, h p.1]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, he⟩ => ⟨⟨a, inL_trans H hR hP X.2 ha⟩,
      ⟨b, inL_trans H hR hP X.2 hb⟩, ha, hb, hab, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).2 he⟩,
      fun ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, he⟩ => ⟨a.1, b.1, ha, hb, hab, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he⟩⟩

/-! ### Formula codes -/

/-- A code of `N`, read in `M` through the relativization of its formula. -/
theorem codeN_iff (c : V) (h : InL H hP c) :
    IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨c, h⟩ ↔
      ConstructibleReflect.CSat mem (InL H hP) (fun _ => c) (fIsFormCodeF 0) := by
  rw [← fIsFormCodeF_spec (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (fun _ => ⟨c, h⟩) 0]
  exact sat_sub (InL H hP) (fIsFormCodeF 0) (fun _ => ⟨c, h⟩)

/-- "`x` is a constructible code of `N`", as a named formula of `M`. -/
noncomputable def codeNF (x : Nat) : NForm :=
  .and (inLF H hP x) (ConstructibleReflect.relT (inLF H hP) (fun _ => x) (x + 1) (fIsFormCodeF 0))

omit hR in
theorem nsat_codeNF_aux (ρ : Nat → V) (x : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (codeNF H hP x) ↔ InL H hP (ρ x) ∧
      ConstructibleReflect.CSat mem (InL H hP) (fun _ => ρ x) (fIsFormCodeF 0) := by
  simp only [codeNF, NSat, nsat_inLF]
  rw [ConstructibleReflect.nsat_relT (InL H hP) (inLF H hP) (fun ρ x => nsat_inLF H hP ρ x)
    _ _ _ _ fun _ => by omega]

theorem nsat_codeNF (ρ : Nat → V) (x : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (codeNF H hP x) ↔ ∃ h : InL H hP (ρ x), IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨ρ x, h⟩ := by
  rw [nsat_codeNF_aux]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨h, hc⟩ => ⟨h, (codeN_iff H hR hP _ h).2 hc⟩,
    fun ⟨h, hc⟩ => ⟨h, (codeN_iff H hR hP _ h).1 hc⟩⟩

theorem codeN_congr {x y : {x // InL H hP x}} (hxy : x.1 = y.1)
    (h : IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) y) : IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) x :=
  (Subtype.ext hxy : x = y) ▸ h

theorem inL_natV (k : Nat) : InL H hP (natV H k) := inL_nat H hR hP (natV_mem_omega H k)

/-- **Codes of `M` are constructible codes of `N`.** -/
theorem code_up :
    ∀ c, IsFormCodeSem H c → ∃ h : InL H hP c, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨c, h⟩ := by
  have hk : ∀ (t : Nat) (a b : V), InL H hP a → InL H hP b →
      InL H hP (kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H a b)) := fun t a b ha hb =>
    inL_kpair_of H hR hP (inL_natV H hR hP t) (inL_kpair_of H hR hP ha hb)
  have hv2 : ∀ (t : Nat) (a b : {x // InL H hP x}),
      (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t)
        (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b)).1 = kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H a.1 b.1) :=
    fun t a b => by rw [val_kpair H hR hP, val_natV H hR hP, val_kpair H hR hP]
  have hv1 : ∀ (t : Nat) (a : {x // InL H hP x}),
      (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t) a).1 = kpair H (natV H t) a.1 :=
    fun t a => by rw [val_kpair H hR hP, val_natV H hR hP]
  have atom : ∀ (t : Nat) (a b : V), mem a (omegaV H) → mem b (omegaV H) →
      (∀ a b : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP a (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)) →
        memL H hP b (omegaV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)) →
        IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)
          (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t) (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b))) →
      ∃ h : InL H hP (kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H a b)),
        IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨_, h⟩ := by
    intro t a b ha hb hN
    let a' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨a, inL_nat H hR hP ha⟩
    let b' : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨b, inL_nat H hR hP hb⟩
    exact ⟨hk t a b a'.2 b'.2, codeN_congr H hR hP (hv2 t a' b').symm
      (hN a' b' ((mem_omegaN H hR hP a').2 ha) ((mem_omegaN H hR hP b').2 hb))⟩
  have bin : ∀ (t : Nat) (a b : V), (∃ h : InL H hP a, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨a, h⟩) →
      (∃ h : InL H hP b, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨b, h⟩) →
      (∀ a b : {x // InL H hP x}, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a →
        IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) b →
        IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)
          (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t) (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a b))) →
      ∃ h : InL H hP (kpair H (natV H t) (kpair H a b)),
        IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨_, h⟩ := by
    rintro t a b ⟨ha, hca⟩ ⟨hb, hcb⟩ hN
    exact ⟨hk t a b ha hb, codeN_congr H hR hP (hv2 t ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩).symm (hN _ _ hca hcb)⟩
  have un : ∀ (t : Nat) (a : V), (∃ h : InL H hP a, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨a, h⟩) →
      (∀ a : {x // InL H hP x}, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) a →
        IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (kpair (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)
          (natV (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) t) a)) →
      ∃ h : InL H hP (kpair H (natV H t) a), IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨_, h⟩ := by
    rintro t a ⟨ha, hca⟩ hN
    exact ⟨inL_kpair_of H hR hP (inL_natV H hR hP t) ha,
      codeN_congr H hR hP (hv1 t ⟨a, ha⟩).symm (hN _ hca)⟩
  refine isFormCodeSem_ind' H _ (toForm id (codeNF H hP 0)) (fun _ => vempty H)
    (fun y => by rw [sat_toForm, nsat_codeNF H hR hP]; rfl)
    (fun a b ha hb => atom 0 a b ha hb fun a b ha hb => isFormCodeSem_memAtom _ ha hb)
    (fun a b ha hb => atom 1 a b ha hb fun a b ha hb => isFormCodeSem_eqAtom _ ha hb)
    ⟨inL_kpair_of H hR hP (inL_natV H hR hP 2) (inL_natV H hR hP 0),
      codeN_congr H hR hP (by rw [val_kpair H hR hP, val_natV H hR hP, val_vempty H hR hP])
        (isFormCodeSem_bot (L_zfAxioms H hR hP))⟩
    (fun a b ha hb => bin 3 a b ha hb fun a b => isFormCodeSem_imp _)
    (fun a b ha hb => bin 4 a b ha hb fun a b => isFormCodeSem_and _)
    (fun a b ha hb => bin 5 a b ha hb fun a b => isFormCodeSem_or _)
    (fun a ha => un 6 a ha fun a => isFormCodeSem_all _)
    (fun a ha => un 7 a ha fun a => isFormCodeSem_ex _)

/-- `y` lies in some `V_γ` with `γ ∈ α`. -/
def RankBelow (α y : V) : Prop := ∃ γ T, mem γ α ∧ IsV H γ T ∧ mem y T

theorem rankBelow_step {α z y : V} (hα : Ord mem α) (hz : RankBelow H α z) (hy : mem y z) :
    RankBelow H α y := by
  obtain ⟨γ, T, hγ, hT, hzT⟩ := hz
  obtain ⟨δ, U, hδ, hU, hyU⟩ := (isV_spec H hR hP (ord_of_mem hα hγ) hT z).1 hzT
  exact ⟨δ, U, hα.1 γ hγ δ hδ, hU, hyU y hy⟩

theorem rankBelow_of_mem {α S z y : V} (hα : Ord mem α) (hS : IsV H α S) (hz : mem z S)
    (hy : mem y z) : RankBelow H α y := by
  obtain ⟨γ, T, hγ, hT, hzT⟩ := (isV_spec H hR hP hα hS z).1 hz
  exact ⟨γ, T, hγ, hT, hzT y hy⟩

/-- **Constructible codes of `N` are codes of `M`**, by a least-rank counterexample
and inversion of codes inside `N`. -/
theorem code_down (c : {x // InL H hP x}) (hc : IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) c) :
    IsFormCodeSem H c.1 := by
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hnc => ?_
  let Q : V → Prop := fun α => ∃ S x, IsV H α S ∧ mem x S ∧
    (∃ h : InL H hP x, IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨x, h⟩) ∧ ¬ IsFormCodeSem H x
  obtain ⟨α0, S0, hα0, hS0, hcS0⟩ := ZFRank.ranked H hR hP c.1
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hQm, hmin⟩ := least_ord H hR Q
    (.ex 1 (.ex 2 (.and (isVF 0 1) (.and (.mem 2 1) (.and (codeNF H hP 2)
      (.neg (ConstructibleDef.isCodeF 2)))))))
    (fun _ => vempty H)
    (fun α => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_isVF H, nsat_codeNF H hR hP, ConstructibleDef.nsat_isCodeF H, nsat_neg]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
      exact Iff.rfl)
    hα0 ⟨S0, c.1, hS0, hcS0, ⟨c.2, hc⟩, hnc⟩
  obtain ⟨S, x, hS, hxS, ⟨hx, hcx⟩, hnx⟩ := hQm
  -- members of lower rank that are codes of `N` are codes of `M`
  have below : ∀ y : {x // InL H hP x}, RankBelow H m y.1 →
      IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) y → IsFormCodeSem H y.1 := by
    intro y ⟨γ, T, hγ, hT, hyT⟩ hcy
    refine Classical.byContradiction fun hny => ?_
    rcases hmin γ (ord_of_mem hm hγ) ⟨T, y.1, hT, hyT, ⟨y.2, hcy⟩, hny⟩ with rfl | h
    · exact mem_irrefl H hR _ hγ
    · exact mem_irrefl H hR _ (hm.1 γ hγ m h)
  have r1 : ∀ (t : V) (p : V), x = kpair H t p → RankBelow H m p := fun t p he =>
    rankBelow_step H hR hP hm (rankBelow_of_mem H hR hP hm hS hxS
      (he ▸ (kpair_mem H t p _).2 (Or.inr rfl))) ((vpair_spec H t p p).2 (Or.inr rfl))
  have r2 : ∀ (t a b : V), x = kpair H t (kpair H a b) → RankBelow H m a ∧ RankBelow H m b :=
    fun t a b he => by
      have hp := r1 t _ he
      refine ⟨rankBelow_step H hR hP hm (rankBelow_step H hR hP hm hp
        ((kpair_mem H a b _).2 (Or.inl rfl))) ((vsingle_spec H a a).2 rfl), ?_⟩
      exact rankBelow_step H hR hP hm (rankBelow_step H hR hP hm hp
        ((kpair_mem H a b _).2 (Or.inr rfl))) ((vpair_spec H a b b).2 (Or.inr rfl))
  apply hnx
  rcases code_shape (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) ⟨x, hx⟩ hcx with
    ⟨i, j, hi, hj, h | h⟩ | h | ⟨a, b, ha, hb, h | h | h⟩ | ⟨a, ha, h | h⟩
  · rw [show x = _ from (codeEq2_iff H hR hP 0 _ i j).1 h]
    exact isFormCodeSem_memAtom H ((mem_omegaN H hR hP i).1 hi) ((mem_omegaN H hR hP j).1 hj)
  · rw [show x = _ from (codeEq2_iff H hR hP 1 _ i j).1 h]
    exact isFormCodeSem_eqAtom H ((mem_omegaN H hR hP i).1 hi) ((mem_omegaN H hR hP j).1 hj)
  · rw [show x = _ from (codeEq_iff H hR hP 2 _ _).1 h, val_vempty H hR hP]
    exact isFormCodeSem_bot H
  all_goals first
    | (have e : x = _ := (codeEq2_iff H hR hP _ _ a b).1 h
       obtain ⟨ra, rb⟩ := r2 _ _ _ e
       rw [e]
       first
         | exact isFormCodeSem_imp H (below a ra ha) (below b rb hb)
         | exact isFormCodeSem_and H (below a ra ha) (below b rb hb)
         | exact isFormCodeSem_or H (below a ra ha) (below b rb hb))
    | (have e : x = _ := (codeEq_iff H hR hP _ _ a).1 h
       have ra := r1 _ _ e
       rw [e]
       first
         | exact isFormCodeSem_all H (below a ra ha)
         | exact isFormCodeSem_ex H (below a ra ha))

/-! ### Constructible environments with prescribed finite parts -/

/-- `t` is the restriction of the graph `e` to the indices in `k`. -/
def IsRes (e k t : V) : Prop := ∀ p, mem p t ↔ mem p e ∧ ∃ i y, mem i k ∧ p = kpair H i y

omit hR hP in
theorem nsat_isRes (ρ : Nat → V) :
    NSat mem ρ (.all 3 ((NForm.mem 3 2).iff (.and (.mem 3 1) (.ex 4 (.ex 5
      (.and (.mem 4 0) (kpairF 3 4 5))))))) ↔ IsRes H (ρ 1) (ρ 0) (ρ 2) := by
  simp only [NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_kpairF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  rfl

/-- Finite restrictions of an environment with constructible values are constructible. -/
theorem res_inL {A e : V} (hA : InL H hP A) (he : IsEnvOn H A e) :
    ∀ k, mem k (omegaV H) → ∃ t, InL H hP t ∧ IsRes H e k t := by
  let φ : NForm := .ex 2 (.and (inLF H hP 2) (.all 3 ((NForm.mem 3 2).iff (.and (.mem 3 1)
    (.ex 4 (.ex 5 (.and (.mem 4 0) (kpairF 3 4 5))))))))
  have hφ : ∀ k, Sat mem (scons k (fun _ => e)) (toForm id φ) ↔ ∃ t, InL H hP t ∧ IsRes H e k t := by
    intro k
    rw [sat_toForm]
    simp only [φ, NSat, nsat_inLF]
    refine exists_congr fun t => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
    have := nsat_isRes H (upd (fun i => scons k (fun _ => e) (id i)) 2 t)
    simp only [NSat, nsat_iff] at this ⊢
    rw [this]
    simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
    rfl
  intro k hk
  refine (hφ k).1 (omega_ind H (toForm id φ) (fun _ => e) ((hφ _).2 ?_) (fun m hm ih => ?_) k hk)
  · refine ⟨vempty H, inL_nat H hR hP (vempty_in_omega H), fun p => ?_⟩
    exact iff_of_false (vempty_spec H p) fun ⟨_, i, _, hi, _⟩ => vempty_spec H i hi
  · obtain ⟨t, htL, ht⟩ := (hφ m).1 ih
    refine (hφ _).2 ⟨vcup H t (vsingle H (kpair H m (applyV H e m))), ?_, fun p => ?_⟩
    · have hk : InL H hP (kpair H m (applyV H e m)) :=
        inL_kpair_of H hR hP (inL_nat H hR hP hm) (inL_trans H hR hP hA (isEnvOn_apply H he hm))
      exact inL_union H hR hP (inL_pair H hR hP htL (inL_pair H hR hP hk hk))
    · rw [vcup_spec H t _ p, vsingle_spec H _ p, ht p]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨hpe, i, y, hi, rfl⟩ | rfl)
        · exact ⟨hpe, i, y, (vsucc_spec H m i).2 (Or.inl hi), rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨applyV_mem H (he.1.2.1 m hm), m, _, vsucc_self H m, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨hpe, i, y, hi, rfl⟩
        rcases (vsucc_spec H m i).1 hi with hi | rfl
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hpe, i, y, hi, rfl⟩
        · exact Or.inr (by rw [applyV_eq H he.1.1 hpe])

omit H hR hP in
/-- Pairs of elements of `U` lie in `P(P(U))`, in any model of the bundle. -/
theorem kpair_mem_pp {W : Type u} {memW : W → W → Prop} (HW : ZFAxioms memW) {U P1 P2 a b : W}
    (h1 : ∀ x, memW x P1 ↔ Sub memW x U) (h2 : ∀ x, memW x P2 ↔ Sub memW x P1)
    (ha : memW a U) (hb : memW b U) : memW (kpair HW a b) P2 := by
  refine (h2 _).2 fun q hq => (h1 q).2 ?_
  rcases (kpair_mem HW a b q).1 hq with rfl | rfl
  · intro z hz; rwa [(vsingle_spec HW a z).1 hz]
  · intro z hz; rcases (vpair_spec HW a b z).1 hz with rfl | rfl <;> assumption

/-- **Constructible environments with a prescribed finite part.** -/
theorem env_in_L (X : {x // InL H hP x}) {e n : V} (he : IsEnvOn H X.1 e)
    (hn : mem n (omegaV H)) :
    ∃ e' : {x // InL H hP x}, IsEnvOn H X.1 e'.1 ∧ ∀ i, mem i n → applyV H e i = applyV H e'.1 i := by
  obtain ⟨t, htL, ht⟩ := res_inL H hR hP X.2 he n hn
  have hd0 : mem (applyV H e (vempty H)) X.1 := isEnvOn_apply H he (vempty_in_omega H)
  let HN := L_zfAxioms H hR hP
  let ωN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨omegaV H, inL_omega H hR hP⟩
  let tN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨t, htL⟩
  let nN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨n, inL_nat H hR hP hn⟩
  let dN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨_, inL_trans H hR hP X.2 hd0⟩
  obtain ⟨P1, hP1⟩ := L_power H hR hP (vcup HN ωN X)
  obtain ⟨P2, hP2⟩ := L_power H hR hP P1
  let Q : {x // InL H hP x} → Prop := fun p => ∃ i y : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP i ωN ∧
    memL H hP y X ∧ p = kpair HN i y ∧ ((memL H hP i nN ∧ memL H hP p tN) ∨
      (¬ memL H hP i nN ∧ y = dN))
  let ρ : Nat → {x // InL H hP x} := fun i =>
    if i = 1 then ωN else if i = 2 then X else if i = 3 then nN else if i = 4 then tN else dN
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := sep_of HN Q
    (.ex 6 (.ex 7 (.and (.mem 6 1) (.and (.mem 7 2) (.and (kpairF 0 6 7)
      (.or (.and (.mem 6 3) (.mem 0 4)) (.and (.neg (.mem 6 3)) (.eq 7 5))))))))
    ρ (fun p => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_kpairF HN, nsat_neg]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
      rfl) P2
  -- membership in `s`, read in `M`
  have hsM : ∀ p, mem p s.1 ↔ ∃ i y, mem i (omegaV H) ∧ mem y X.1 ∧ p = kpair H i y ∧
      ((mem i n ∧ mem p t) ∨ (¬ mem i n ∧ y = applyV H e (vempty H))) := by
    refine fun p => ⟨fun hp => ?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨-, i, y, hi, hy, he', hc⟩ := (hs ⟨p, inL_trans H hR hP s.2 hp⟩).1 hp
      exact ⟨i.1, y.1, hi, hy, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he',
        hc.imp (fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, h2⟩) fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, congrArg Subtype.val h2⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, y, hi, hy, rfl, hc⟩
      have hiL := inL_nat H hR hP hi
      have hyL := inL_trans H hR hP X.2 hy
      let iN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨i, hiL⟩
      let yN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨y, hyL⟩
      have hU : ∀ z : {x // InL H hP x}, memL H hP z ωN ∨ memL H hP z X →
          memL H hP z (vcup HN ωN X) := fun z hz => (vcup_spec HN ωN X z).2 hz
      have hmem := kpair_mem_pp HN hP1 hP2 (hU iN (Or.inl hi)) (hU yN (Or.inr hy))
      have hpq : (kpair HN iN yN).1 = kpair H i y := val_kpair H hR hP iN yN
      have := (hs (kpair HN iN yN)).2 ⟨hmem, iN, yN, hi, hy, rfl, hc.imp
        (fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, show mem (kpair HN iN yN).1 t by rwa [hpq]⟩)
        fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h1, Subtype.ext h2⟩⟩
      exact hpq ▸ this
  have hte : ∀ p, mem p t → mem p e := fun p hp => ((ht p).1 hp).1
  have hfun : ∀ a b b', mem (kpair H a b) s.1 → mem (kpair H a b') s.1 → b = b' := by
    intro a b b' h1 h2
    obtain ⟨i, y, -, -, e1, c1⟩ := (hsM _).1 h1
    obtain ⟨i', y', -, -, e2, c2⟩ := (hsM _).1 h2
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e1
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e2
    rcases c1 with ⟨hi, ht1⟩ | ⟨hi, rfl⟩ <;> rcases c2 with ⟨hi', ht2⟩ | ⟨hi', rfl⟩
    · exact he.1.1 _ _ _ (hte _ ht1) (hte _ ht2)
    · exact absurd hi hi'
    · exact absurd hi' hi
    · rfl
  have hin : ∀ i, mem i (omegaV H) → mem i n → mem (kpair H i (applyV H e i)) s.1 :=
    fun i hi hin => (hsM _).2 ⟨i, _, hi, isEnvOn_apply H he hi, rfl,
      Or.inl ⟨hin, (ht _).2 ⟨applyV_mem H (he.1.2.1 i hi), i, _, hin, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  refine ⟨s, ⟨⟨hfun, fun i hi => ?_, fun p hp => ?_⟩, fun i y hy => ?_⟩, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · by_cases hin' : mem i n
    · exact ⟨_, hin i hi hin'⟩
    · exact ⟨_, (hsM _).2 ⟨i, _, hi, hd0, rfl, Or.inr ⟨hin', rfl⟩⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, y, hi, -, rfl, -⟩ := (hsM p).1 hp
    exact ⟨i, y, hi, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨i', y', -, hy', e1, -⟩ := (hsM _).1 hy
    rwa [(kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ e1).2]
  · exact (applyV_eq H hfun (hin i (ConstructibleZF.omega_trans H n hn i hi) hi)).symm

/-! ### Definability and `Def` -/

theorem def_down (X S : {x // InL H hP x}) (h : DefinableIn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) X S) :
    DefinableIn H X.1 S.1 := by
  obtain ⟨R, c, e, hRel, hc, he, hspec⟩ := h
  have he' := (isEnvOn_iff H hR hP X e).1 he
  have hRel' := (memRel_iff H hR hP X R).1 hRel
  have hS := setStructure_of_memRel H hRel' ⟨_, isEnvOn_apply H he' (vempty_in_omega H)⟩
  have hcM := code_down H hR hP c hc
  have key : ∀ z : {x // InL H hP x}, mem z.1 X.1 →
      (SatIn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) X R c (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) z e) ↔
        SatIn H X.1 R.1 c.1 (econs H z.1 e.1)) := by
    intro z hz
    rw [satIn_iff H hR hP hS hc hcM (by rw [val_econs H hR hP he'.1.1]; exact econs_isEnvOn H he' hz),
      val_econs H hR hP he'.1.1]
  refine ⟨R.1, c.1, e.1, hRel', hcM, he', fun z => ⟨fun hz => ?_, fun ⟨hz, hsat⟩ => ?_⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hzX, hsat⟩ := (hspec ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP S.2 hz⟩).1 hz
    exact ⟨hzX, (key ⟨z, _⟩ hzX).1 hsat⟩
  · exact (hspec ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP X.2 hz⟩).2 ⟨hz, (key ⟨z, _⟩ hz).2 hsat⟩

/-- **Definable subsets of a constructible set are constructible and `N`-definable.** -/
theorem def_up (X : {x // InL H hP x}) {S : V} (hd : DefinableIn H X.1 S) :
    ∃ S' : {x // InL H hP x}, S'.1 = S ∧ DefinableIn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) X S' := by
  obtain ⟨R, c, e, hRel, hc, he, hspec⟩ := hd
  have hne : ∃ d, mem d X.1 := ⟨_, isEnvOn_apply H he (vempty_in_omega H)⟩
  obtain ⟨RN, hRN⟩ := memRel_exists (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) X
  have hRN' := (memRel_iff H hR hP X RN).1 hRN
  have eR : RN.1 = R := H.ext _ _ fun p => by rw [hRN' p, hRel p]
  have hS := setStructure_of_memRel H hRel hne
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hsup⟩ := SatSupport.sat_support H hS c hc
  obtain ⟨hcL, hcN⟩ := code_up H hR hP c hc
  obtain ⟨e', he', hag⟩ := env_in_L H hR hP X he hn
  let cN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨c, hcL⟩
  have he'N := (isEnvOn_iff H hR hP X e').2 he'
  let ρ : Nat → {x // InL H hP x} := fun i =>
    if i = 1 then X else if i = 2 then RN else if i = 3 then e' else cN
  obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ := sep_of (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)
    (fun y => SatIn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) X RN cN (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) y e'))
    (.ex 5 (.and (econsAtomF 5 0 3) (satInF 1 2 4 5))) ρ
    (fun y => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_satInF (L_zfAxioms H hR hP)]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨E, hE, hsat⟩
        rw [nsat_econsAtomF (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _ _ _ (by
          simp (disch := omega) only [upd_other]; exact he'N.1.1)] at hE
        simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other] at hE
        rwa [hE] at hsat
      · intro hsat
        refine ⟨_, ?_, hsat⟩
        rw [nsat_econsAtomF (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) _ _ _ _ (by
          simp (disch := omega) only [upd_other]; exact he'N.1.1)]
        simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
        rfl) X
  have hcode : IsFormCodeSem (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) cN := hcN
  have key : ∀ z : {x // InL H hP x}, mem z.1 X.1 →
      (SatIn (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) X RN cN (econs (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) z e') ↔
        SatIn H X.1 R c (econs H z.1 e)) := by
    intro z hz
    have hEe : IsEnvOn H X.1 (econs H z.1 e'.1) := econs_isEnvOn H he' hz
    rw [satIn_iff H hR hP (eR ▸ hS) hcode hc (by rw [val_econs H hR hP he'.1.1]; exact hEe),
      val_econs H hR hP he'.1.1, eR]
    exact hsup _ _ hEe (econs_isEnvOn H he hz) (SatSupport.agreeP_econs H hn he' he hz
      ((SatSupport.agreeP_iff H hn he' he).2 fun i hi => (hag i hi).symm))
  refine ⟨S', H.ext _ _ fun z => ⟨fun hz => ?_, fun hz => ?_⟩, ⟨RN, cN, e', hRN, hcode, he'N, hS'⟩⟩
  · obtain ⟨hzX, hsat⟩ := (hS' ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP S'.2 hz⟩).1 hz
    exact (hspec z).2 ⟨hzX, (key _ hzX).1 hsat⟩
  · obtain ⟨hzX, hsat⟩ := (hspec z).1 hz
    exact (hS' ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP X.2 hzX⟩).2 ⟨hzX, (key ⟨z, _⟩ hzX).2 hsat⟩

/-- **`Def` is absolute**: the `N`-version of `Gdef X` is `Gdef X`. -/
theorem gdef_eq (X : {x // InL H hP x}) :
    (Gdef (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) X).1 = Gdef H hP X.1 := by
  refine val_eq H hR hP (fun S hS => ?_) fun S => ?_
  · rcases ((gdef_spec H hP X.1 S).1 hS).2 with hemp | hdef
    · have : S = vempty H := H.ext _ _ fun z =>
        ⟨fun hz => absurd hz (hemp z), fun hz => absurd hz (vempty_spec H z)⟩
      rw [this]; exact inL_nat H hR hP (vempty_in_omega H)
    · obtain ⟨S', rfl, -⟩ := def_up H hR hP X hdef
      exact S'.2
  · rw [show mem S.1 (Gdef (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) X).1 ↔ _ from
      gdef_spec (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) X S, gdef_spec H hP]
    refine and_congr (forall_memL_iff H hR hP S (fun z => mem z X.1))
      (or_congr (forall_memL_iff H hR hP S (fun _ => False)) ⟨def_down H hR hP X S, fun h => ?_⟩)
    obtain ⟨S', hS', hdef⟩ := def_up H hR hP X h
    rwa [show S' = S from Subtype.ext hS'] at hdef

/-! ### The hierarchy, and `V = L` in `L` -/

theorem approx_down (f d : {x // InL H hP x})
    (h : TransRec.Approx (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (Gdef (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP)) f d) :
    TransRec.Approx H (Gdef H hP) f.1 d.1 := by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := h
  refine ⟨fun p hp => ?_, fun b hb => ?_, fun b S S' hS hS' => ?_, fun b S hbS z => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨b, S, hb, he⟩ := h1 ⟨p, inL_trans H hR hP f.2 hp⟩ hp
    exact ⟨b.1, S.1, hb, (kpairN_eq H hR hP _ _ _).1 he⟩
  · obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := h2 ⟨b, inL_trans H hR hP d.2 hb⟩ hb
    exact ⟨S.1, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hS⟩
  · have hL := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP f.2 hS
    have hL' := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP f.2 hS'
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (h3 ⟨b, hL.1⟩ ⟨S, hL.2⟩ ⟨S', hL'.2⟩
      ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hS) ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hS'))
  · obtain ⟨hbL, hSL⟩ := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP f.2 hbS
    have h4' := h4 ⟨b, hbL⟩ ⟨S, hSL⟩ ((kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hbS)
    refine ⟨fun hz => ?_, fun ⟨c, T, hc, hcT, hzT⟩ => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨c, T, hc, hcT, hzT⟩ := (h4' ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP hSL hz⟩).1 hz
      refine ⟨c.1, T.1, hc, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 hcT, ?_⟩
      have : mem z (Gdef (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) T).1 := hzT
      rwa [gdef_eq H hR hP] at this
    · obtain ⟨hcL, hTL⟩ := inL_of_kpair_mem H hR hP f.2 hcT
      have hz' : mem z (Gdef (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) ⟨T, hTL⟩).1 := by
        rwa [gdef_eq H hR hP]
      have hzL := inL_trans H hR hP (Gdef (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) ⟨T, hTL⟩).2 hz'
      exact (h4' ⟨z, hzL⟩).2 ⟨⟨c, hcL⟩, ⟨T, hTL⟩, hc, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).2 hcT, hz'⟩

theorem isL_down (a S : {x // InL H hP x})
    (h : IsL (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) a S) : IsL H hP a.1 S.1 := by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, haS⟩ := h
  refine ⟨f.1, ?_, (kpairN_mem H hR hP _ _ _).1 haS⟩
  have := approx_down H hR hP f _ hf
  rwa [val_vsucc H hR hP] at this

theorem ord_iff (a : {x // InL H hP x}) : Ord (memL H hP) a ↔ Ord mem a.1 := by
  have htr : ∀ t : {x // InL H hP x}, Trans (memL H hP) t ↔ Trans mem t.1 := fun t =>
    ⟨fun h x hx z hz => h ⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP t.2 hx⟩ hx
        ⟨z, inL_trans H hR hP (inL_trans H hR hP t.2 hx) hz⟩ hz,
     fun h x hx z hz => h x.1 hx z.1 hz⟩
  unfold InternalOrd.Ord
  rw [htr a]
  exact and_congr_right fun _ =>
    ⟨fun h x hx => (htr ⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP a.2 hx⟩).1 (h _ hx),
     fun h x hx => (htr x).2 (h x.1 hx)⟩

/-- **`V = L` holds in `L`**: every constructible set is constructible in the
sense of the constructible model. -/
theorem vEqL (x : {x // InL H hP x}) : InL (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) x := by
  obtain ⟨a, S, ha, hS, hxS⟩ := x.2
  let aN : {x // InL H hP x} := ⟨a, inL_ord H hR hP ha⟩
  have haN : Ord (memL H hP) aN := (ord_iff H hR hP aN).2 ha
  obtain ⟨S', hS'⟩ := isL_exists (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_regular H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) haN
  have e : S'.1 = S := isL_unique H hR hP ha (isL_down H hR hP aN S' hS') hS
  exact ⟨aN, S', haN, hS', show mem x.1 S'.1 by rwa [e]⟩

end Ops

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleAbs

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleReflect

/-!
The constructible class satisfies ZF.

Separation in `L` reflects the formula into a closed stage `L_β`
(`ConstructibleReflect.reflect`), where the separated set is definable, hence
constructible. Replacement collects the images by Replacement in the model,
bounds them in one stage and separates. Together with the easy axioms of
`Constructible`, the substructure on `L` is a model of `SetTheory.ZFax_s`.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleZF

open NamedZF NForm InternalOrd InternalRank TransRec ConstructibleDef Constructible
  ConstructibleReflect LeanProofs.BoundedZFCConsistency

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

section Sep

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP

/-- Finitely many constructible sets lie in one stage. -/
theorem inL_common (v : Nat → V) :
    ∀ m, (∀ k, k < m + 1 → InL H hP (v k)) →
      ∃ γ T, Ord mem γ ∧ IsL H hP γ T ∧ ∀ k, k < m + 1 → mem (v k) T := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro hv
      obtain ⟨γ, T, hγ, hT, hx⟩ := hv 0 (by omega)
      exact ⟨γ, T, hγ, hT, fun k hk => by rwa [show k = 0 by omega]⟩
  | succ m ih =>
      intro hv
      obtain ⟨γ1, T1, ho1, hT1, h1⟩ := ih fun k hk => hv k (by omega)
      obtain ⟨γ2, T2, ho2, hT2, h2⟩ := hv (m + 1) (by omega)
      rcases trichotomy H hR γ1 ho1 γ2 ho2 with h | rfl | h
      · exact ⟨γ2, T2, ho2, hT2, fun k hk => by
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hk with hk | rfl
          · exact isL_mono H hR hP ho2 h hT1 hT2 _ (h1 k hk)
          · exact h2⟩
      · exact ⟨γ1, T1, ho1, hT1, fun k hk => by
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hk with hk | rfl
          · exact h1 k hk
          · rwa [isL_unique H hR hP ho1 hT2 hT1] at h2⟩
      · exact ⟨γ1, T1, ho1, hT1, fun k hk => by
          rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.1 hk with hk | rfl
          · exact h1 k hk
          · exact isL_mono H hR hP ho1 h hT2 hT1 _ h2⟩

omit hR hP in
/-- The set `{y ∈ T | (T, ∈) ⊨ φ[y, E]}` exists. -/
theorem satSet_exists {T R E : V} (hR' : MemRel H T R) (hE : IsEnvOn H T E) (hne : ∃ d, mem d T)
    (φ : Form) : ∃ S, ∀ y, mem y S ↔ mem y T ∧ RSat mem T (scons y (envVals H E)) φ := by
  have hst := setStructure_of_memRel H hR' hne
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := sep_of H (fun y => SatIn H T R (formCode H φ) (econs H y E))
    (.ex 5 (.and (econsAtomF 5 0 4) (satInF 1 2 3 5)))
    (fun i => if i = 1 then T else if i = 2 then R else if i = 3 then formCode H φ else E)
    (fun y => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_satInF H]
      refine ⟨fun ⟨e', he', hs⟩ => ?_, fun hs => ⟨econs H y E, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [nsat_econsAtomF H _ _ _ _ (by simp (disch := omega) only [upd_other]; exact hE.1.1)]
          at he'
        simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other] at he' hs
        simp only [show (2 : Nat) ≠ 1 by omega, show (3 : Nat) ≠ 1 by omega,
          show (3 : Nat) ≠ 2 by omega, show (4 : Nat) ≠ 1 by omega, show (4 : Nat) ≠ 2 by omega,
          show (4 : Nat) ≠ 3 by omega, if_false] at he' hs
        rw [he'] at hs; exact hs
      · rw [nsat_econsAtomF H _ _ _ _ (by simp (disch := omega) only [upd_other]; exact hE.1.1)]
        simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
        simp
      · simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
        simpa using hs) T
  refine ⟨S, fun y => ?_⟩
  rw [hS y]
  refine and_congr_right fun hy => ?_
  rw [satIn_formCode H hst hR' φ _ (econs_isEnvOn H hE hy)]
  exact rsat_congr T φ fun n => envVals_econs H hE y n

/-- **Separation in L.** -/
theorem inL_sep (φ : Form) (e : Nat → V) (he : ∀ n, InL H hP (e n)) {a : V} (ha : InL H hP a) :
    ∃ s, InL H hP s ∧ ∀ z, mem z s ↔ mem z a ∧ CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons z e) φ := by
  let m := bound φ
  let v : Nat → V := fun k => if k < m then e k else a
  have hv : ∀ k, k < m + 1 → InL H hP (v k) := fun k _ => by
    simp only [v]; split
    · exact he k
    · exact ha
  obtain ⟨α0, T0, hα0, hT0, hvT0⟩ := inL_common H hR hP v m hv
  obtain ⟨β, hαβ, hC⟩ := closed_exists H hR hP (qbodies φ) hα0
  obtain ⟨Tβ, hTβ⟩ := isL_exists H hR hP hC.1
  have hsub := isL_mono H hR hP hC.1 hαβ hT0 hTβ
  have haT : mem a Tβ := by simpa [v] using hsub _ (hvT0 m (by omega))
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEv⟩ := mk_env H haT (m + 1) v fun k hk => hsub _ (hvT0 k hk)
  obtain ⟨R, hR'⟩ := memRel_exists H hP Tβ
  let φ' : Form := .fAnd (.fMem 0 (m + 1)) φ
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := satSet_exists H hR' hE ⟨a, haT⟩ φ'
  have hTt := isL_trans H hR hP hC.1 hTβ
  have hEa : envVals H E m = a := by rw [hEv m (by omega)]; simp [v]
  have agree : ∀ z, CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons z (envVals H E)) φ ↔
      CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons z e) φ := fun z =>
    csat_ext_free _ φ _ _ fun n hn => by
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k =>
          have hk : k < m := by have := free_lt_bound φ _ hn; simp only [m]; omega
          simp only [scons]; rw [hEv k (by omega)]; simp [v, hk]
  have hall : ∀ z, mem z Tβ → ∀ n, mem (scons z (envVals H E) n) Tβ := fun z hz n => by
    cases n with
    | zero => exact hz
    | succ n => exact isEnvOn_apply H hE (natV_mem_omega H n)
  refine ⟨S, inL_of_definable H hR hP hC.1 hTβ (fun z hz => ((hS z).1 hz).1)
    (definable_env H hP hE φ' S hS), fun z => ?_⟩
  rw [hS z]
  simp only [φ', RSat, scons, hEa]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hz, hza, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨hza, (agree z).1 ((reflect H hR hP hC hTβ φ (fun _ h => h) _ (hall z hz)).2 hφ)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hza, hφ⟩
    have hz := hTt a haT z hza
    exact ⟨hz, hza, (reflect H hR hP hC hTβ φ (fun _ h => h) _ (hall z hz)).1 ((agree z).2 hφ)⟩

end Sep

/-! ## Renaming and the constructible substructure -/

theorem csat_rename (P : V → Prop) :
    ∀ (φ : Form) (r : Nat → Nat) (e : Nat → V),
      CSat mem P e (rename r φ) ↔ CSat mem P (fun n => e (r n)) φ
  | .fMem _ _, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | .fEq _ _, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | .fBot, _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | .fImp a b, r, e | .fAnd a b, r, e | .fOr a b, r, e => by
      simp only [rename, CSat, csat_rename P a r e, csat_rename P b r e]
  | .fAll a, r, e => by
      simp only [rename, CSat]
      refine forall_congr' fun d => imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
      rw [csat_rename P a]
      exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun e' => CSat mem P e' a) (funext fun n => up_env r d e n))
  | .fEx a, r, e => by
      simp only [rename, CSat]
      refine exists_congr fun d => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
      rw [csat_rename P a]
      exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun e' => CSat mem P e' a) (funext fun n => up_env r d e n))

theorem vals_scons (P : V → Prop) (x : {x // P x}) (e : Nat → {x // P x}) :
    (fun n => (scons x e n).1) = scons x.1 (fun n => (e n).1) :=
  funext fun n => by cases n <;> rfl

/-- Satisfaction in the substructure on a class is satisfaction relativized to it. -/
theorem sat_sub (P : V → Prop) :
    ∀ (φ : Form) (e : Nat → {x // P x}),
      Sat (fun a b : {x // P x} => mem a.1 b.1) e φ ↔ CSat mem P (fun n => (e n).1) φ
  | .fMem _ _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | .fEq _ _, e => ⟨fun h => congrArg Subtype.val h, fun h => Subtype.ext h⟩
  | .fBot, _ => Iff.rfl
  | .fImp a b, e | .fAnd a b, e | .fOr a b, e => by
      simp only [Sat, CSat, sat_sub P a e, sat_sub P b e]
  | .fAll a, e => by
      have key d := (sat_sub P a (scons d e)).trans (by rw [vals_scons P d e])
      exact ⟨fun h d hd => (key ⟨d, hd⟩).1 (h ⟨d, hd⟩), fun h d => (key d).2 (h d.1 d.2)⟩
  | .fEx a, e => by
      have key d := (sat_sub P a (scons d e)).trans (by rw [vals_scons P d e])
      exact ⟨fun ⟨d, hd⟩ => ⟨d.1, d.2, (key d).1 hd⟩, fun ⟨d, hd, h⟩ => ⟨⟨d, hd⟩, (key _).2 h⟩⟩


/-! ## Replacement and the model -/

section Model

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP

omit hR hP in
theorem omega_trans : ∀ n, mem n (omegaV H) → ∀ y, mem y n → mem y (omegaV H) := by
  have key := omega_ind H (toForm id (.all 2 (.imp (.mem 2 0) (.mem 2 1)))) (fun _ => omegaV H)
  have hspec : ∀ n, Sat mem (scons n (fun _ => omegaV H))
      (toForm id (.all 2 (.imp (.mem 2 0) (.mem 2 1)))) ↔ ∀ y, mem y n → mem y (omegaV H) := by
    intro n
    rw [sat_toForm]
    simp only [NSat]
    simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
    rfl
  intro n hn
  refine (hspec n).1 (key ((hspec _).2 fun y hy => absurd hy (vempty_spec H y))
    (fun m hm ih => (hspec _).2 fun y hy =>
      ((vsucc_spec H m y).1 hy).elim ((hspec m).1 ih y) fun e => e ▸ hm) n hn)

omit hR hP in
theorem ord_omega : Ord mem (omegaV H) :=
  ⟨fun n hn y hy => omega_trans H n hn y hy, fun n hn => nat_transitive H n hn⟩

theorem inL_ord {a : V} (ha : Ord mem a) : InL H hP a := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := isL_exists H hR hP (ord_succ H ha)
  exact ⟨_, S, ord_succ H ha, hS, ord_mem_isL H hR hP ha hS⟩

/-- Every stage is constructible. -/
theorem inL_stage {b T : V} (hb : Ord mem b) (hT : IsL H hP b T) : InL H hP T := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := isL_exists H hR hP (ord_succ H hb)
  exact ⟨_, S, ord_succ H hb, hS, isL_mem H hR hP (ord_succ H hb) (vsucc_self H b) hT hS⟩

omit H hR hP in
def rslots (m : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | 1 => 1
  | k + 2 => if k < m then 100 + k else 100

omit H hR hP in
def swapRen : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 1
  | 1 => 0
  | k + 2 => k + 3

/-- **Replacement in L.** -/
theorem inL_repl (psi : Form) (e : Nat → V) (he : ∀ n, InL H hP (e n))
    (hfun : ∀ x y1 y2, InL H hP x → InL H hP y1 → InL H hP y2 →
      CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons y1 (scons x e)) psi →
      CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons y2 (scons x e)) psi → y1 = y2)
    {a : V} (ha : InL H hP a) :
    ∃ r, InL H hP r ∧ ∀ y, InL H hP y →
      (mem y r ↔ ∃ x, mem x a ∧ CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons y (scons x e)) psi) := by
  let Rel : V → V → Prop := fun x y => InL H hP x ∧ InL H hP y ∧
    CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons y (scons x e)) psi
  obtain ⟨Img, hImg⟩ := repl_of H Rel
    (.and (inLF H hP 1) (.and (inLF H hP 0)
      (relT (inLF H hP) (rslots (bound psi)) (100 + bound psi + 1) psi)))
    (fun i => e (i - 100))
    (fun x y => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_inLF H hP]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
      refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ => ?_
      rw [nsat_relT (InL H hP) (inLF H hP) (nsat_inLF H hP) psi _ _ _ fun i => by
        rcases i with _ | _ | k <;> simp only [rslots] <;> first | omega | (split <;> omega)]
      refine csat_ext_free _ psi _ _ fun n hn => ?_
      have hlt := free_lt_bound psi n hn
      rcases n with _ | _ | k
      · show upd (upd _ 1 x) 0 y 0 = y
        rw [upd_same]
      · show upd (upd _ 1 x) 0 y 1 = x
        rw [upd_other _ _ (by omega), upd_same]
      · have hk : k < bound psi := by omega
        simp only [rslots, hk, if_true, scons]
        rw [upd_other _ _ (by omega), upd_other _ _ (by omega)]
        simp)
    (fun x y1 y2 h1 h2 => hfun x y1 y2 h1.1 h1.2.1 h2.2.1 h1.2.2 h2.2.2) a
  obtain ⟨β, T, hβ, hT, hImgT⟩ := stage_bound H hR hP (A := Img) fun y hy =>
    ((hImg y).1 hy).elim fun _ h => h.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsspec⟩ := inL_sep H hR hP (.fEx (.fAnd (.fMem 0 2) (rename swapRen psi)))
    (scons a e) (fun n => by cases n with | zero => exact ha | succ n => exact he n)
    (inL_stage H hR hP hβ hT)
  refine ⟨s, hs, fun y hy => ?_⟩
  rw [hsspec y]
  have hren : ∀ x, CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons x (scons y (scons a e))) (rename swapRen psi) ↔
      CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons y (scons x e)) psi := fun x => by
    rw [csat_rename]
    exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun e' => CSat mem (InL H hP) e' psi) (funext fun n => by
      rcases n with _ | _ | k <;> rfl))
  simp only [CSat, scons, hren]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, x, -, hxa, hx⟩; exact ⟨x, hxa, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hxa, hx⟩
    have hxL := inL_trans H hR hP ha hxa
    exact ⟨hImgT y ((hImg y).2 ⟨x, hxa, hxL, hy, hx⟩), x, hxL, hxa, hx⟩

end Model

/-- The membership relation of the constructible substructure. -/
def memL (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) :
    {x // InL H hP x} → {x // InL H hP x} → Prop := fun a b => mem a.1 b.1

section ModelAxioms

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP

/-- **The constructible substructure satisfies the ZF bundle.** -/
theorem L_zfAxioms : ZFAxioms (memL H hP) where
  ext a b h := Subtype.ext (H.ext a.1 b.1 fun x =>
    ⟨fun hx => (h ⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP a.2 hx⟩).1 hx,
     fun hx => (h ⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP b.2 hx⟩).2 hx⟩)
  sep phi e a := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hspec⟩ := inL_sep H hR hP phi (fun n => (e n).1) (fun n => (e n).2) a.2
    refine ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
    show mem x.1 s ↔ mem x.1 a.1 ∧ _
    rw [hspec x.1]
    exact and_congr_right fun _ => ((sat_sub (mem := mem) (InL H hP) phi (scons x e)).trans
      (by rw [vals_scons (InL H hP) x e])).symm
  pair a b := by
    refine ⟨⟨_, inL_pair H hR hP a.2 b.2⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
    show mem x.1 (vpair H a.1 b.1) ↔ _
    rw [vpair_spec H a.1 b.1 x.1, Subtype.ext_iff, Subtype.ext_iff]
  union u := by
    refine ⟨⟨_, inL_union H hR hP u.2⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
    show mem x.1 (vunion H u.1) ↔ _
    rw [vunion_spec H u.1 x.1]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨v, hxv, hvu⟩ => ⟨⟨v, inL_trans H hR hP u.2 hvu⟩, hxv, hvu⟩,
      fun ⟨v, hxv, hvu⟩ => ⟨v.1, hxv, hvu⟩⟩
  inf := by
    have hω := inL_ord H hR hP (ord_omega H)
    have he0 := inL_ord H hR hP (ord_of_mem (ord_omega H) (vempty_in_omega H))
    refine ⟨⟨_, hω⟩, ⟨⟨_, he0⟩, vempty_in_omega H, fun z hz => vempty_spec H z.1 hz⟩, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    have hxo := ord_of_mem (ord_omega H) hx
    refine ⟨⟨_, inL_ord H hR hP (ord_succ H hxo)⟩, omega_succ H x.1 hx, fun t => ?_⟩
    show mem t.1 (vsucc H x.1) ↔ _
    rw [vsucc_spec H x.1 t.1, Subtype.ext_iff]
    exact Iff.rfl
  repl psi e hfun a := by
    have hrel : ∀ (x y : {x // InL H hP x}), relOf (memL H hP) psi e y x ↔
        CSat mem (InL H hP) (scons y.1 (scons x.1 (fun n => (e n).1))) psi := fun x y => by
      unfold relOf
      refine (sat_sub (mem := mem) (InL H hP) psi _).trans ?_
      exact Iff.of_eq (congrArg (fun e' => CSat mem (InL H hP) e' psi) (funext fun n => by
        rcases n with _ | _ | k <;> rfl))
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hspec⟩ := inL_repl H hR hP psi (fun n => (e n).1) (fun n => (e n).2)
      (fun x y1 y2 hx hy1 hy2 h1 h2 => congrArg Subtype.val
        (hfun ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y1, hy1⟩ ⟨y2, hy2⟩ ((hrel _ _).2 h1) ((hrel _ _).2 h2))) a.2
    refine ⟨⟨r, hr⟩, fun y => ?_⟩
    show mem y.1 r ↔ _
    rw [hspec y.1 y.2]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨x, hxa, hx⟩ => ⟨⟨x, inL_trans H hR hP a.2 hxa⟩, hxa, (hrel _ _).2 hx⟩,
      fun ⟨x, hxa, hx⟩ => ⟨x.1, hxa, (hrel _ _).1 hx⟩⟩

theorem L_power : ∀ a : {x // InL H hP x}, ∃ p : {x // InL H hP x}, ∀ x : {x // InL H hP x},
    memL H hP x p ↔ Sub (memL H hP) x a := by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hspec⟩ := inL_power H hR hP a.2
  refine ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, fun x => ?_⟩
  show mem x.1 p ↔ _
  rw [hspec x.1 x.2]
  exact ⟨fun h y hy => h y.1 hy, fun h y hy => h ⟨y, inL_trans H hR hP x.2 hy⟩ hy⟩

theorem L_regular : Regular (memL H hP) := by
  intro a ⟨x, hx⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ := hR a.1 ⟨x.1, hx⟩
  exact ⟨⟨m, inL_trans H hR hP a.2 hm⟩, hm, fun ⟨z, hz1, hz2⟩ => hmin ⟨z.1, hz1, hz2⟩⟩

end ModelAxioms

/-- Any structure with the ZF bundle, Power and Regularity is a model of `ZFax_s`. -/
theorem zfax_of {W : Type u} {memW : W → W → Prop} (H : ZFAxioms memW)
    (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, memW x p ↔ Sub memW x a) (hR : Regular memW) (v : Nat → W) :
    ∀ f, ZFax_s f → Sat memW v f := by
  intro f hf
  rcases hf with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | ⟨phi, rfl⟩ | ⟨psi, rfl⟩
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Ext_form) Ext_form).mpr (bridge_Ext.mpr H.ext) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Reg_form) Reg_form).mpr (bridge_Reg.mpr hR) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Pow_form) Pow_form).mpr (bridge_Pow.mpr hP) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Pair_form) Pair_form).mpr (bridge_Pair.mpr H.pair) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Union_form) Union_form).mpr (bridge_Union.mpr H.union) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound Inf_form) Inf_form).mpr (fun env => (bridge_Inf env).mpr H.inf) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound (Sep_form phi)) (Sep_form phi)).mpr
      (fun env => bridge_Sep.mpr H.sep phi env) v
  · exact (closeN_valid (bound (Repl_form psi)) (Repl_form psi)).mpr
      (fun env => (bridge_Repl psi env).mpr (H.repl psi env)) v

/-- **The constructible class of a model of ZF is a model of ZF.** -/
theorem L_models_ZF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem)
    (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (v : Nat → {x // InL H hP x}) :
    ∀ f, ZFax_s f → Sat (memL H hP) v f :=
  zfax_of (L_zfAxioms H hR hP) (L_power H hR hP) (L_regular H hR hP) v

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleZF

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.TransRec
import BoundedZFCConsistency.InternalSatTotality

/-!
Definable subsets of a set, inside a model of ZF.

For a set `X` of the model, `MemRel X R` says that `R` is the membership
relation of `X` as a set of Kuratowski pairs, and `DefinableIn X S` says that
`S = {y ∈ X | (X, ∈) ⊨ φ[y, e]}` for some internal formula code `φ` and some
internal environment `e` over `X`. Satisfaction is
`BoundedZFCConsistency.InternalSatTotality.SatIn`: satisfaction of coded
formulas over set-sized structures, by certificates, total and single-valued
on every internal code (including nonstandard ones).

`Gdef X = {S ⊆ X | S = ∅ or S is definable over X}` is a definable operation
(`defOp`); its stages (`TransRec`) form Gödel's constructible hierarchy. The
empty set is added so that `Gdef ∅ = {∅}`: with an empty carrier there is no
environment, so nothing would otherwise be definable over `∅`.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleDef

open NamedZF NForm InternalOrd InternalRank TransRec LeanProofs.BoundedZFCConsistency

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

/-- Read slot `i` of an embedded De Bruijn formula at the `i`-th listed name. -/
def argsOf (l : List Nat) (i : Nat) : Nat := l.getD i 0

/-! ## The membership relation of a set -/

def MemRel (H : ZFAxioms mem) (X R : V) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, mem p R ↔ ∃ a b, mem a X ∧ mem b X ∧ mem a b ∧ p = kpair H a b

def memRelF (R X : Nat) : NForm :=
  let n := R + X + 1
  .all n ((NForm.mem n R).iff (.ex (n + 1) (.ex (n + 2) (.and (.mem (n + 1) X)
    (.and (.mem (n + 2) X) (.and (.mem (n + 1) (n + 2)) (kpairF n (n + 1) (n + 2))))))))

theorem nsat_memRelF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (R X : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (memRelF R X) ↔ MemRel H (ρ X) (ρ R) := by
  simp only [memRelF, NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_kpairF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  rfl

theorem memRel_exists (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (X : V) :
    ∃ R, MemRel H X R := by
  obtain ⟨P1, hP1⟩ := hP X
  obtain ⟨P2, hP2⟩ := hP P1
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := sep_of H (fun p => ∃ a b, mem a X ∧ mem b X ∧ mem a b ∧ p = kpair H a b)
    (.ex 1 (.ex 2 (.and (.mem 1 3) (.and (.mem 2 3) (.and (.mem 1 2) (kpairF 0 1 2))))))
    (fun _ => X)
    (fun p => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_kpairF H]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]) P2
  refine ⟨R, fun p => ?_⟩
  rw [hR p]
  refine ⟨fun h => h.2, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨(hP2 _).2 fun q hq => (hP1 q).2 ?_, a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
  rcases (kpair_mem H a b q).1 hq with rfl | rfl
  · intro z hz; rwa [(vsingle_spec H a z).1 hz]
  · intro z hz; rcases (vpair_spec H a b z).1 hz with rfl | rfl <;> assumption

/-! ## Internal satisfaction as a named formula -/

/-- `b = 1` (the internal numeral `{∅}`). -/
def oneF (b : Nat) : NForm :=
  .all (b + 1) ((NForm.mem (b + 1) b).iff (.all (b + 2) (.imp (.mem (b + 2) (b + 1)) .bot)))

theorem nsat_oneF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (b : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (oneF b) ↔ ρ b = natV H 1 := by
  simp only [oneF, NSat, nsat_iff]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  have hz : ∀ z, (∀ m, ¬ mem m z) ↔ z = vempty H := fun z =>
    ⟨fun h => H.ext _ _ fun m => ⟨fun hm => absurd hm (h m), fun hm => absurd hm (vempty_spec H m)⟩,
     fun h m hm => vempty_spec H m (h ▸ hm)⟩
  have h1 : ∀ z, mem z (natV H 1) ↔ z = vempty H := fun z => by
    rw [natV_succ, natV_zero, vsucc_spec H (vempty H) z]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.elim (fun h => absurd h (vempty_spec H z)) id, Or.inr⟩
  exact ⟨fun h => H.ext _ _ fun z => by rw [h z, hz, h1], fun h z => by rw [h, h1, hz]⟩

/-! ### Embedded certificate formulas -/

def isCodeF (c : Nat) : NForm := .atom (fIsFormCodeF 0) (argsOf [c])
def envOnF (e A : Nat) : NForm := .atom (fEnvOnF 0 1) (argsOf [e, A])
def satClosedF (S A R : Nat) : NForm := .atom (fSatClosedF 0 1 2) (argsOf [S, A, R])
def tripleMemF (c e b S : Nat) : NForm := .atom (fTripleMemF 0 1 2 3) (argsOf [c, e, b, S])
def econsAtomF (z d E : Nat) : NForm := .atom (fEconsF 0 1 2) (argsOf [z, d, E])

theorem nsat_isCodeF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (c : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (isCodeF c) ↔ IsFormCodeSem H (ρ c) := by
  simp only [isCodeF, NSat]; rw [fIsFormCodeF_spec H]; rfl

theorem nsat_envOnF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (e A : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (envOnF e A) ↔ IsEnvOn H (ρ A) (ρ e) := by
  simp only [envOnF, NSat]; rw [fEnvOnF_spec H]; rfl

theorem nsat_satClosedF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (S A R : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (satClosedF S A R) ↔ SatClosed H (ρ A) (ρ R) (ρ S) := by
  simp only [satClosedF, NSat]; rw [fSatClosedF_spec H]; rfl

theorem nsat_tripleMemF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (c e b S : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (tripleMemF c e b S) ↔ mem (satTriple H (ρ c) (ρ e) (ρ b)) (ρ S) := by
  simp only [tripleMemF, NSat]; rw [fTripleMemF_spec H]; rfl

theorem nsat_econsAtomF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (z d E : Nat)
    (hfun : ∀ x y y', mem (kpair H x y) (ρ E) → mem (kpair H x y') (ρ E) → y = y') :
    NSat mem ρ (econsAtomF z d E) ↔ ρ z = econs H (ρ d) (ρ E) := by
  simp only [econsAtomF, NSat]; rw [fEconsF_spec H _ 0 1 2 hfun]; rfl

/-- `(A, R) ⊨ c[e]` (internal satisfaction). -/
def satInF (A R c e : Nat) : NForm :=
  let n := A + R + c + e + 1
  .ex n (.ex (n + 1) (.and (oneF (n + 1)) (.and (satClosedF n A R) (tripleMemF c e (n + 1) n))))

theorem nsat_satInF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (A R c e : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (satInF A R c e) ↔ SatIn H (ρ A) (ρ R) (ρ c) (ρ e) := by
  simp only [satInF, NSat, nsat_oneF H, nsat_satClosedF H, nsat_tripleMemF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨S, _, rfl, hc, hh⟩ => ⟨S, hc, hh⟩, fun ⟨S, hc, hh⟩ => ⟨S, _, rfl, hc, hh⟩⟩

/-! ## Definable subsets -/

/-- `S` is a subset of `X` definable over `(X, ∈)` with parameters from `X`. -/
def DefinableIn (H : ZFAxioms mem) (X S : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ R c e, MemRel H X R ∧ IsFormCodeSem H c ∧ IsEnvOn H X e ∧
    ∀ y, mem y S ↔ mem y X ∧ SatIn H X R c (econs H y e)

def definableF (X S : Nat) : NForm :=
  let n := X + S + 1
  .ex n (.ex (n + 1) (.ex (n + 2) (.and (memRelF n X) (.and (isCodeF (n + 1))
    (.and (envOnF (n + 2) X)
    (.all (n + 3) ((NForm.mem (n + 3) S).iff (.and (.mem (n + 3) X)
      (.ex (n + 4) (.and (econsAtomF (n + 4) (n + 3) (n + 2)) (satInF X n (n + 1) (n + 4))))))))))))

theorem nsat_definableF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (ρ : Nat → V) (X S : Nat) :
    NSat mem ρ (definableF X S) ↔ DefinableIn H (ρ X) (ρ S) := by
  simp only [definableF, NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_memRelF H, nsat_satInF H, nsat_isCodeF H,
    nsat_envOnF H]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  refine exists_congr fun R => exists_congr fun c => exists_congr fun e => ?_
  refine and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun _ => and_congr_right fun hE => ?_
  refine forall_congr' fun y => iff_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr_right fun _ => ?_)
  have key : ∀ e', NSat mem (upd (upd (upd (upd (upd ρ (X + S + 1) R) (X + S + 1 + 1) c)
      (X + S + 1 + 2) e) (X + S + 1 + 3) y) (X + S + 1 + 4) e')
      (econsAtomF (X + S + 1 + 4) (X + S + 1 + 3) (X + S + 1 + 2)) ↔ e' = econs H y e := by
    intro e'
    rw [nsat_econsAtomF H _ _ _ _ (by simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]; exact hE.1.1)]
    simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨e', he', hs⟩ => ?_, fun hs => ⟨_, (key _).2 rfl, hs⟩⟩
  rwa [(key e').1 he'] at hs

/-! ## The stage operation -/

theorem gdef_exists (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (X : V) :
    ∃ D, ∀ S, mem S D ↔ Sub mem S X ∧ ((∀ z, ¬ mem z S) ∨ DefinableIn H X S) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hPX⟩ := hP X
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := sep_of H (fun S => (∀ z, ¬ mem z S) ∨ DefinableIn H X S)
    (.or (.all 2 (.imp (.mem 2 0) .bot)) (definableF 1 0)) (fun _ => X)
    (fun S => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_definableF H]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]) P
  exact ⟨D, fun S => by rw [hD S, hPX S]⟩

/-- `Gdef X = {S ⊆ X | S = ∅ or S is definable over X}`. -/
noncomputable def Gdef (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (X : V) : V :=
  (gdef_exists H hP X).choose

theorem gdef_spec (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (X S : V) :
    mem S (Gdef H hP X) ↔ Sub mem S X ∧ ((∀ z, ¬ mem z S) ∨ DefinableIn H X S) :=
  (gdef_exists H hP X).choose_spec S

/-- The graph of `Gdef` (output name `y`, input name `x`). -/
def gdefF (y x : Nat) : NForm :=
  let n := y + x + 1
  .all n ((NForm.mem n y).iff (.and (subF n x)
    (.or (.all (n + 1) (.imp (.mem (n + 1) n) .bot)) (definableF x n))))

/-- `Gdef` is a definable operation. -/
noncomputable def defOp (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) :
    DefOp mem (Gdef H hP) where
  gF := gdefF
  spec := fun ρ y x => by
    simp only [gdefF, NSat, nsat_iff, nsat_subF, nsat_definableF H]
    simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact H.ext _ _ fun S => by rw [h S, gdef_spec H hP]
    · intro h S; rw [h, gdef_spec H hP]

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleDef

import BusyBeaver.ZFC.ConstructibleDef

/-!
Gödel's constructible hierarchy inside a model of ZF.

`IsL a S` says that `S = L_a`: the stage `a` of the hierarchy of
`ConstructibleDef.Gdef` (`TransRec`). This module proves the basic facts:

* the **truth bridge** `satIn_formCode`: for a standard formula `φ`, internal
  satisfaction of its code over `(X, ∈)` is satisfaction of `φ` with
  quantifiers bounded by `X` (`RSat`), read at the environment's values;
* every member of a transitive set `X` is definable over `X`, and so is `X`
  itself, so stages are transitive, increasing, and `L_a ∈ L_{a+1}`.
-/

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Constructible

open NamedZF NForm InternalOrd InternalRank TransRec ConstructibleDef
  LeanProofs.BoundedZFCConsistency

universe u
variable {V : Type u} {mem : V → V → Prop}

/-! ## Satisfaction with bounded quantifiers -/

/-- Satisfaction with every quantifier bounded by `X`. -/
def RSat (mem : V → V → Prop) (X : V) : (Nat → V) → Form → Prop
  | e, .fMem i j => mem (e i) (e j)
  | e, .fEq i j => e i = e j
  | _, .fBot => False
  | e, .fImp a b => RSat mem X e a → RSat mem X e b
  | e, .fAnd a b => RSat mem X e a ∧ RSat mem X e b
  | e, .fOr a b => RSat mem X e a ∨ RSat mem X e b
  | e, .fAll a => ∀ d, mem d X → RSat mem X (scons d e) a
  | e, .fEx a => ∃ d, mem d X ∧ RSat mem X (scons d e) a

theorem rsat_congr (X : V) (φ : Form) {e e' : Nat → V} (h : ∀ n, e n = e' n) :
    RSat mem X e φ ↔ RSat mem X e' φ := by rw [funext h]

/-- The values of an internal environment, as an external one. -/
noncomputable def envVals (H : ZFAxioms mem) (e : V) : Nat → V := fun n => applyV H e (natV H n)

theorem envVals_econs (H : ZFAxioms mem) {X e : V} (he : IsEnvOn H X e) (d : V) (n : Nat) :
    envVals H (econs H d e) n = scons d (envVals H e) n := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact econs_zero H he.1.1 d
  | succ n => exact econs_succ H he d (natV_mem_omega H n)

theorem setStructure_of_memRel (H : ZFAxioms mem) {X R : V} (hR : MemRel H X R)
    (hne : ∃ d, mem d X) : IsSetStructure H X R :=
  ⟨hne, fun p hp => by obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hb, -, rfl⟩ := (hR p).1 hp; exact ⟨a, b, ha, hb, rfl⟩⟩

/-- **The truth bridge.** Internal satisfaction of a standard formula's code
is satisfaction with quantifiers bounded by the carrier. -/
theorem satIn_formCode (H : ZFAxioms mem) {X R : V} (hS : IsSetStructure H X R)
    (hR : MemRel H X R) :
    ∀ (φ : Form) (e : V), IsEnvOn H X e →
      (SatIn H X R (formCode H φ) e ↔ RSat mem X (envVals H e) φ)
  | .fMem i j, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fMem, satIn_memAtom H hS (natV_mem_omega H i) (natV_mem_omega H j) he, hR]
      refine ⟨fun ⟨a, b, _, _, hab, hp⟩ => ?_, fun h => ⟨_, _,
        isEnvOn_apply H he (natV_mem_omega H i), isEnvOn_apply H he (natV_mem_omega H j), h, rfl⟩⟩
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := kpair_inj H _ _ _ _ hp
      exact hab
  | .fEq i j, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fEq, satIn_eqAtom H hS (natV_mem_omega H i) (natV_mem_omega H j) he]
      rfl
  | .fBot, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fBot]
      exact ⟨fun h => satIn_bot H h, False.elim⟩
  | .fImp a b, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fImp, satIn_imp H hS (formCode_isFormCodeSem H a) (formCode_isFormCodeSem H b) he,
        satIn_formCode H hS hR a e he, satIn_formCode H hS hR b e he]
      rfl
  | .fAnd a b, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fAnd, satIn_and H hS (formCode_isFormCodeSem H a) (formCode_isFormCodeSem H b) he,
        satIn_formCode H hS hR a e he, satIn_formCode H hS hR b e he]
      rfl
  | .fOr a b, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fOr, satIn_or H hS (formCode_isFormCodeSem H a) (formCode_isFormCodeSem H b) he,
        satIn_formCode H hS hR a e he, satIn_formCode H hS hR b e he]
      rfl
  | .fAll a, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fAll, satIn_all H hS (formCode_isFormCodeSem H a) he]
      refine forall_congr' fun d => imp_congr_right fun hd => ?_
      rw [satIn_formCode H hS hR a _ (econs_isEnvOn H he hd)]
      exact rsat_congr X a (envVals_econs H he d)
  | .fEx a, e, he => by
      rw [formCode_fEx, satIn_ex H hS (formCode_isFormCodeSem H a) he]
      refine exists_congr fun d => and_congr_right fun hd => ?_
      rw [satIn_formCode H hS hR a _ (econs_isEnvOn H he hd)]
      exact rsat_congr X a (envVals_econs H he d)

/-! ## Definable members -/

section Members

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hP

omit hP in
theorem constEnv_apply {d n : V} (hn : mem n (omegaV H)) : applyV H (constEnv H d) n = d := by
  have he := constEnv_isEnvOn H (A := vsingle H d) ((vsingle_spec H d d).2 rfl)
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := he.1.2.1 n hn
  rw [applyV_eq H he.1.1 hy]; exact (vsingle_spec H d y).1 (he.2 n y hy)

/-- A set definable over `X` by a standard formula with one parameter. -/
theorem definable_formCode {X a : V} (ha : mem a X) (φ : Form) (S : V)
    (hS : ∀ y, mem y S ↔ mem y X ∧ RSat mem X (scons y (fun _ => a)) φ) : DefinableIn H X S := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := memRel_exists H hP X
  have hst := setStructure_of_memRel H hR ⟨a, ha⟩
  have he := constEnv_isEnvOn H (A := X) ha
  refine ⟨R, formCode H φ, constEnv H a, hR, formCode_isFormCodeSem H φ, he, fun y => ?_⟩
  rw [hS y]
  refine and_congr_right fun hy => ?_
  rw [satIn_formCode H hst hR φ _ (econs_isEnvOn H he hy)]
  refine rsat_congr X φ fun n => ?_
  rw [envVals_econs H he y n]
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n => exact (constEnv_apply H (natV_mem_omega H n)).symm

/-- Every member of a transitive set is definable over it. -/
theorem mem_gdef_of_mem {X a : V} (hX : Trans mem X) (ha : mem a X) : mem a (Gdef H hP X) := by
  refine (gdef_spec H hP X a).2 ⟨fun z hz => hX a ha z hz, Or.inr ?_⟩
  exact definable_formCode H hP ha (.fMem 0 1) a fun y =>
    ⟨fun hy => ⟨hX a ha y hy, hy⟩, fun h => h.2⟩

/-- Every set is definable over itself. -/
theorem self_mem_gdef (X : V) : mem X (Gdef H hP X) := by
  refine (gdef_spec H hP X X).2 ⟨fun _ h => h, ?_⟩
  by_cases hne : ∃ d, mem d X
  · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hne
    exact Or.inr (definable_formCode H hP hd (.fEq 0 0) X fun y => ⟨fun hy => ⟨hy, rfl⟩, fun h => h.1⟩)
  · exact Or.inl fun z hz => hne ⟨z, hz⟩

end Members

/-! ## The constructible stages -/

section Stages

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP

/-- `S = L_a`. -/
def IsL (a S : V) : Prop := IsStage H (Gdef H hP) a S

theorem isL_exists {a : V} (ha : Ord mem a) : ∃ S, IsL H hP a S :=
  stage_exists' H hR (defOp H hP) ha

theorem isL_unique {a S S' : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : IsL H hP a S) (h' : IsL H hP a S') : S = S' :=
  stage_unique H hR ha h h'

theorem isL_spec {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (h : IsL H hP a S) :
    ∀ z, mem z S ↔ ∃ c T, mem c a ∧ IsL H hP c T ∧ mem z (Gdef H hP T) :=
  stage_spec H hR (defOp H hP) ha h

theorem isL_mono {a c S T : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hc : mem c a) (hT : IsL H hP c T)
    (hS : IsL H hP a S) : Sub mem T S :=
  stage_mono H hR (defOp H hP) ha hc hT hS

/-- Stages are transitive. -/
theorem isL_trans {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hS : IsL H hP a S) : Trans mem S := by
  intro z hz w hw
  obtain ⟨c, T, hc, hT, hzT⟩ := (isL_spec H hR hP ha hS z).1 hz
  exact isL_mono H hR hP ha hc hT hS w (((gdef_spec H hP T z).1 hzT).1 w hw)

/-- `L_c ⊆ G(L_c) ⊆ L_a` for `c ∈ a`: each stage is a member of the next. -/
theorem isL_mem {a c S T : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hc : mem c a) (hT : IsL H hP c T)
    (hS : IsL H hP a S) : mem T S :=
  (isL_spec H hR hP ha hS T).2 ⟨c, T, hc, hT, self_mem_gdef H hP T⟩

end Stages

/-! ## Definability with several parameters -/

section Params

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hP

/-- A set cut out of `X` by a standard formula, with parameters read from an
internal environment over `X`, is definable over `X`. -/
theorem definable_env {X e : V} (he : IsEnvOn H X e) (φ : Form) (S : V)
    (hS : ∀ y, mem y S ↔ mem y X ∧ RSat mem X (scons y (envVals H e)) φ) : DefinableIn H X S := by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := memRel_exists H hP X
  have hne : ∃ d, mem d X := ⟨_, isEnvOn_apply H he (vempty_in_omega H)⟩
  have hst := setStructure_of_memRel H hR hne
  refine ⟨R, formCode H φ, e, hR, formCode_isFormCodeSem H φ, he, fun y => ?_⟩
  rw [hS y]
  refine and_congr_right fun hy => ?_
  rw [satIn_formCode H hst hR φ _ (econs_isEnvOn H he hy)]
  exact rsat_congr X φ fun n => (envVals_econs H he y n).symm

end Params

/-! ## Ordinals in L -/

/-- `x₀` is an ordinal: transitive, with transitive members. -/
def ordForm : Form :=
  .fAnd (.fAll (.fImp (.fMem 0 1) (.fAll (.fImp (.fMem 0 1) (.fMem 0 2)))))
    (.fAll (.fImp (.fMem 0 1) (.fAll (.fImp (.fMem 0 1) (.fAll (.fImp (.fMem 0 1) (.fMem 0 2)))))))

/-- Being an ordinal is absolute for transitive sets. -/
theorem rsat_ordForm {X x : V} (hX : Trans mem X) (hx : mem x X) (e : Nat → V) :
    RSat mem X (scons x e) ordForm ↔ Ord mem x := by
  simp only [ordForm, RSat, scons]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨fun y hy z hz => h1 y (hX x hx y hy) hy z (hX y (hX x hx y hy) z hz) hz,
      fun y hy z hz w hw => ?_⟩
    have hyX := hX x hx y hy
    have hzX := hX y hyX z hz
    exact h2 y hyX hy z hzX hz w (hX z hzX w hw) hw
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact ⟨fun y _ hy z _ hz => h1 y hy z hz, fun y _ hy z _ hz w _ hw => h2 y hy z hz w hw⟩

section OrdinalsInL

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP

/-- **`L_a ∩ Ord = a`.** -/
theorem isL_ord : ∀ a, Ord mem a → ∀ S, IsL H hP a S → ∀ x, (mem x S ∧ Ord mem x) ↔ mem x a := by
  refine ord_induction H hR _
    (.all 1 (.imp (isStageF (defOp H hP) 0 1) (.all 2 ((NForm.and (.mem 2 1) (ordF 2)).iff (.mem 2 0)))))
    (fun _ => vempty H)
    (fun a => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_isStageF H (defOp H hP), nsat_ordF, nsat_iff]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
      rfl) ?_
  intro a ha IH S hS x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxS, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨c, T, hc, hT, hxT⟩ := (isL_spec H hR hP ha hS x).1 hxS
    have hsub : Sub mem x T := ((gdef_spec H hP T x).1 hxT).1
    have hle := le_of_sub H hR hx (ord_of_mem ha hc) fun y hy =>
      (IH c hc T hT y).1 ⟨hsub y hy, ord_of_mem hx hy⟩
    exact hle.elim (fun e => e ▸ hc) fun h => ha.1 c hc x h
  · intro hxa
    have hx := ord_of_mem ha hxa
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := isL_exists H hR hP hx
    refine ⟨(isL_spec H hR hP ha hS x).2 ⟨x, T, hxa, hT, ?_⟩, hx⟩
    have hTt := isL_trans H hR hP hx hT
    refine (gdef_spec H hP T x).2 ⟨fun y hy => ((IH x hxa T hT y).2 hy).1, ?_⟩
    by_cases hne : ∃ d, mem d T
    · obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hne
      exact Or.inr (definable_env H hP (constEnv_isEnvOn H (A := T) hd) ordForm x fun y =>
        ⟨fun hy => ((IH x hxa T hT y).2 hy).elim fun hyT hyo =>
          ⟨hyT, (rsat_ordForm hTt hyT _).2 hyo⟩,
          fun ⟨hyT, hy⟩ => (IH x hxa T hT y).1 ⟨hyT, (rsat_ordForm hTt hyT _).1 hy⟩⟩)
    · exact Or.inl fun z hz => hne ⟨z, ((IH x hxa T hT z).2 hz).1⟩

/-- Every ordinal is constructible: `a ∈ L_{a+1}`. -/
theorem ord_mem_isL {a S : V} (ha : Ord mem a) (hS : IsL H hP (vsucc H a) S) : mem a S :=
  ((isL_ord H hR hP _ (ord_succ H ha) S hS a).2 (vsucc_self H a)).1

end OrdinalsInL

/-! ## The constructible class -/

/-- `x` is constructible. -/
def InL (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (x : V) : Prop :=
  ∃ a S, Ord mem a ∧ IsL H hP a S ∧ mem x S

/-- The named formula for `InL` (free name `x`). -/
noncomputable def inLF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (x : Nat) :
    NForm :=
  .ex (x + 1) (.ex (x + 2) (.and (ordF (x + 1)) (.and (isStageF (defOp H hP) (x + 1) (x + 2))
    (.mem x (x + 2)))))

theorem nsat_inLF (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a) (ρ : Nat → V)
    (x : Nat) : NSat mem ρ (inLF H hP x) ↔ InL H hP (ρ x) := by
  simp only [inLF, NSat, nsat_ordF, nsat_isStageF H (defOp H hP)]
  simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
  rfl

section Class

variable (H : ZFAxioms mem) (hR : Regular mem) (hP : ∀ a, ∃ p, ∀ x, mem x p ↔ Sub mem x a)
include H hR hP


theorem inL_trans {x y : V} (hx : InL H hP x) (hy : mem y x) : InL H hP y := by
  obtain ⟨a, S, ha, hS, hxS⟩ := hx
  exact ⟨a, S, ha, hS, isL_trans H hR hP ha hS x hxS y hy⟩

/-- Membership in `L_a` persists to larger stages. -/
theorem isL_le {a b S T x : V} (hb : Ord mem b) (hab : a = b ∨ mem a b) (hS : IsL H hP a S)
    (hT : IsL H hP b T) (hx : mem x S) : mem x T := by
  rcases hab with rfl | hab
  · rwa [isL_unique H hR hP hb hT hS]
  · exact isL_mono H hR hP hb hab hS hT x hx

/-- **Stage bounds.** A set of constructible sets lies in one stage. -/
theorem stage_bound {A : V} (hA : ∀ x, mem x A → InL H hP x) :
    ∃ b T, Ord mem b ∧ IsL H hP b T ∧ Sub mem A T := by
  let Q : V → V → Prop := fun x a => ∃ S, IsL H hP a S ∧ mem x S
  let Lst : V → V → Prop := fun x a => Ord mem a ∧ Q x a ∧ ∀ c, Ord mem c → Q x c → a = c ∨ mem a c
  have hLst : ∀ x, mem x A → ∃ a, Lst x a := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨a, S, ha, hS, hxS⟩ := hA x hx
    exact least_ord H hR (Q x)
      (.ex 1 (.and (isStageF (defOp H hP) 0 1) (.mem 2 1))) (fun _ => x)
      (fun y => by
        simp only [NSat, nsat_isStageF H (defOp H hP)]
        simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
        rfl) ha ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := repl_of H Lst
    (.and (ordF 0) (.and (.ex 2 (.and (isStageF (defOp H hP) 0 2) (.mem 1 2)))
      (.all 3 (.imp (.and (ordF 3) (.ex 4 (.and (isStageF (defOp H hP) 3 4) (.mem 1 4))))
        (.or (.eq 0 3) (.mem 0 3)))))) (fun _ => A)
    (fun x a => by
      simp only [NSat, nsat_ordF, nsat_isStageF H (defOp H hP), and_imp]
      simp (disch := omega) only [upd_same, upd_other]
      rfl)
    (fun x a1 a2 h1 h2 => (h1.2.2 a2 h2.1 h2.2.1).elim id fun h =>
      (h2.2.2 a1 h1.1 h1.2.1).elim Eq.symm fun h' =>
        absurd (h1.1.1 a2 h' a1 h) (mem_irrefl H hR a1)) A
  have hBord : ∀ a, mem a B → Ord mem a := fun a ha => ((hB a).1 ha).elim fun _ h => h.2.1
  have hβ := ord_vunion H hBord
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := isL_exists H hR hP hβ
  refine ⟨_, T, hβ, hT, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hax⟩ := hLst x hx
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ := hax.2.1
  have haB : mem a B := (hB a).2 ⟨x, hx, hax⟩
  have hle := le_of_sub H hR hax.1 hβ fun w hw => (vunion_spec H B w).2 ⟨a, hw, haB⟩
  exact isL_le H hR hP hβ hle hS hT hxS

/-- Two constructible sets lie in one stage. -/
theorem stage_bound2 {x y : V} (hx : InL H hP x) (hy : InL H hP y) :
    ∃ b T, Ord mem b ∧ IsL H hP b T ∧ mem x T ∧ mem y T := by
  obtain ⟨b, T, hb, hT, hsub⟩ := stage_bound H hR hP (A := vpair H x y) fun z hz => by
    rcases (vpair_spec H x y z).1 hz with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  exact ⟨b, T, hb, hT, hsub x ((vpair_spec H x y x).2 (Or.inl rfl)),
    hsub y ((vpair_spec H x y y).2 (Or.inr rfl))⟩

/-- A subset of a stage that is definable over it is constructible. -/
theorem inL_of_definable {b T S : V} (hb : Ord mem b) (hT : IsL H hP b T) (hsub : Sub mem S T)
    (hdef : DefinableIn H T S) : InL H hP S := by
  obtain ⟨T', hT'⟩ := isL_exists H hR hP (ord_succ H hb)
  exact ⟨_, T', ord_succ H hb, hT', (isL_spec H hR hP (ord_succ H hb) hT' S).2
    ⟨b, T, vsucc_self H b, hT, (gdef_spec H hP T S).2 ⟨hsub, Or.inr hdef⟩⟩⟩

omit hR hP in
/-- The internal environment `x, y, y, …` over `T`. -/
theorem env2 {T x y : V} (hx : mem x T) (hy : mem y T) :
    IsEnvOn H T (econs H x (constEnv H y)) ∧
      envVals H (econs H x (constEnv H y)) 0 = x ∧ envVals H (econs H x (constEnv H y)) 1 = y := by
  have he := constEnv_isEnvOn H (A := T) hy
  refine ⟨econs_isEnvOn H he hx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [envVals_econs H he x 0]; rfl
  · rw [envVals_econs H he x 1]; exact constEnv_apply H (natV_mem_omega H 0)

/-! ### Pairing, Union and Power in L -/

theorem inL_pair {x y : V} (hx : InL H hP x) (hy : InL H hP y) : InL H hP (vpair H x y) := by
  obtain ⟨b, T, hb, hT, hxT, hyT⟩ := stage_bound2 H hR hP hx hy
  obtain ⟨he, h0, h1⟩ := env2 H hxT hyT
  refine inL_of_definable H hR hP hb hT (fun z hz => ?_) (definable_env H hP he
    (.fOr (.fEq 0 1) (.fEq 0 2)) _ fun z => ?_)
  · rcases (vpair_spec H x y z).1 hz with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
  · rw [vpair_spec H x y z]
    simp only [RSat, scons, h0, h1]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [*]
    · exact fun h => h.2

theorem inL_union {x : V} (hx : InL H hP x) : InL H hP (vunion H x) := by
  obtain ⟨b, T, hb, hT, hxT, -⟩ := stage_bound2 H hR hP hx hx
  obtain ⟨he, h0, -⟩ := env2 H hxT hxT
  have hTt := isL_trans H hR hP hb hT
  refine inL_of_definable H hR hP hb hT (fun z hz => ?_) (definable_env H hP he
    (.fEx (.fAnd (.fMem 0 2) (.fMem 1 0))) _ fun z => ?_)
  · obtain ⟨w, hzw, hwx⟩ := (vunion_spec H x z).1 hz
    exact hTt w (hTt x hxT w hwx) z hzw
  · rw [vunion_spec H x z]
    simp only [RSat, scons, h0]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨w, hzw, hwx⟩ => ⟨hTt w (hTt x hxT w hwx) z hzw, w, hTt x hxT w hwx, hwx, hzw⟩,
      fun ⟨_, w, _, hwx, hzw⟩ => ⟨w, hzw, hwx⟩⟩

/-- **Power in L**: the constructible subsets of a constructible set form a constructible set. -/
theorem inL_power {x : V} (hx : InL H hP x) :
    ∃ p, InL H hP p ∧ ∀ z, InL H hP z → (mem z p ↔ Sub mem z x) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hPx⟩ := hP x
  -- the constructible subsets of `x`
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := sep_of H (InL H hP) (inLF H hP 0) (fun _ => x)
    (fun z => by rw [nsat_inLF H hP]; rfl) P
  obtain ⟨b, T, hb, hT, hQT⟩ := stage_bound H hR hP (A := vcup H Q (vsingle H x))
    (fun z hz => ((vcup_spec H Q _ z).1 hz).elim (fun hz => ((hQ z).1 hz).2) fun hz => by
      rwa [(vsingle_spec H x z).1 hz])
  have hxT : mem x T := hQT x ((vcup_spec H Q _ x).2 (Or.inr ((vsingle_spec H x x).2 rfl)))
  have hTt := isL_trans H hR hP hb hT
  obtain ⟨he, h0, -⟩ := env2 H hxT hxT
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := sep_of H (fun z => Sub mem z x) (subF 0 1) (fun _ => x)
    (fun z => by rw [nsat_subF]; rfl) T
  refine ⟨p, inL_of_definable H hR hP hb hT (fun z hz => ((hp z).1 hz).1)
    (definable_env H hP he (.fAll (.fImp (.fMem 0 1) (.fMem 0 2))) p fun z => ?_), fun z hz => ?_⟩
  · rw [hp z]
    refine and_congr_right fun hzT => ?_
    simp only [RSat, scons, h0]
    exact ⟨fun h w _ hw => h w hw, fun h w hw => h w (hTt z hzT w hw) hw⟩
  · rw [hp z]
    exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨hQT z ((vcup_spec H Q _ z).2 (Or.inl ((hQ z).2
      ⟨(hPx z).2 h, hz⟩))), h⟩⟩

end Class

end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Constructible

/-
  Fol.lean

  GENERIC first-order logic over the language of set theory: one binary
  relation symbol (rendered fMem) and equality (fEq), with De Bruijn
  variables.  Nothing in this file mentions any particular theory.

  Lean 4 port of the Rocq/Coq development `Logic/FirstOrder/Coq/Fol.v`.
  Statement-for-statement faithful; proofs re-idiomatized for Lean.

  - Created (UTC): 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z  (see git history for exact stamp)
-/

namespace SetTheory

/-! ## Cantor pairing (self-contained replacement for Coq's Stdlib Cantor) -/

namespace Cantor

/-- Triangular numbers, defined recursively (no division). -/
def tri : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => tri n + n + 1

/-- The Cantor pairing function: `toNat (x, y) = y + tri (x + y)`. -/
def toNat (p : Nat × Nat) : Nat := p.2 + tri (p.1 + p.2)

/-- Inverse of the pairing: walk the anti-diagonals. -/
def ofNat : Nat → Nat × Nat
  | 0 => (0, 0)
  | n+1 =>
    match ofNat n with
    | (0, y) => (y+1, 0)
    | (x+1, y) => (x, y+1)

theorem toNat_ofNat : ∀ n, toNat (ofNat n) = n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n+1 => by
    have ih := toNat_ofNat n
    show toNat (match ofNat n with
      | (0, y) => (y+1, 0)
      | (x+1, y) => (x, y+1)) = n+1
    cases h : ofNat n with
    | mk x y =>
      rw [h] at ih
      cases x with
      | zero => simp [toNat, tri] at ih ⊢; omega
      | succ x' =>
        simp [toNat] at ih ⊢
        have harg : x' + (y + 1) = x' + 1 + y := by omega
        rw [harg]; omega

theorem tri_le (n : Nat) : n ≤ tri n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [tri]
  | succ n ih => simp only [tri]; omega

theorem tri_mono : ∀ {m n : Nat}, m ≤ n → tri m ≤ tri n := by
  intro m n h
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Nat.le_refl _
  | step _ ih => simp only [tri]; omega

theorem toNat_inj {p q : Nat × Nat} (h : toNat p = toNat q) : p = q := by
  obtain ⟨x1, y1⟩ := p; obtain ⟨x2, y2⟩ := q
  simp [toNat] at h
  have hs : x1 + y1 = x2 + y2 := by
    rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (x1 + y1) (x2 + y2) with hlt | heq | hgt
    · have hm := tri_mono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlt)
      simp only [tri] at hm; omega
    · exact heq
    · have hm := tri_mono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hgt)
      simp only [tri] at hm; omega
  have ht : tri (x1 + y1) = tri (x2 + y2) := by rw [hs]
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
  omega

theorem ofNat_toNat (p : Nat × Nat) : ofNat (toNat p) = p :=
  toNat_inj (toNat_ofNat (toNat p))

/-- Both components are dominated by the code: `x + y ≤ toNat (x, y)`. -/
theorem add_le_toNat (x y : Nat) : x + y ≤ toNat (x, y) := by
  have := tri_le (x + y); simp [toNat]; omega

end Cantor

/-! ## Syntax: formulas and renaming -/

inductive Form : Type
  | fMem : Nat → Nat → Form
  | fEq  : Nat → Nat → Form
  | fBot : Form
  | fImp : Form → Form → Form
  | fAnd : Form → Form → Form
  | fOr  : Form → Form → Form
  | fAll : Form → Form
  | fEx  : Form → Form
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

open Form

def fIff (a b : Form) : Form := fAnd (fImp a b) (fImp b a)

/-! ### Renaming of De Bruijn variables -/

def up (r : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => 0
  | k+1 => r k + 1

def rename (r : Nat → Nat) : Form → Form
  | fMem i j => fMem (r i) (r j)
  | fEq i j  => fEq (r i) (r j)
  | fBot     => fBot
  | fImp a b => fImp (rename r a) (rename r b)
  | fAnd a b => fAnd (rename r a) (rename r b)
  | fOr a b  => fOr (rename r a) (rename r b)
  | fAll a   => fAll (rename (up r) a)
  | fEx a    => fEx (rename (up r) a)

/-- Instantiate De Bruijn 0 by variable `k` (and decrement the rest). -/
def inst (k : Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => k
  | m+1 => m

/-! ### Free variables, and the equational theory of renaming -/

def Free : Nat → Form → Prop
  | n, fMem i j => n = i ∨ n = j
  | n, fEq i j  => n = i ∨ n = j
  | _, fBot     => False
  | n, fImp a b => Free n a ∨ Free n b
  | n, fAnd a b => Free n a ∨ Free n b
  | n, fOr a b  => Free n a ∨ Free n b
  | n, fAll a   => Free (n+1) a
  | n, fEx a    => Free (n+1) a

/-- Renamings agreeing on the free variables act equally. -/
theorem rename_ext_free (f : Form) :
    ∀ r r', (∀ n, Free n f → r n = r' n) → rename r f = rename r' f := by
  induction f with
  | fMem i j =>
    intro r r' h
    simp [rename, h i (Or.inl rfl), h j (Or.inr rfl)]
  | fEq i j =>
    intro r r' h
    simp [rename, h i (Or.inl rfl), h j (Or.inr rfl)]
  | fBot => intro r r' h; rfl
  | fImp a b iha ihb =>
    intro r r' h
    simp [rename, iha _ _ (fun n hn => h n (Or.inl hn)),
          ihb _ _ (fun n hn => h n (Or.inr hn))]
  | fAnd a b iha ihb =>
    intro r r' h
    simp [rename, iha _ _ (fun n hn => h n (Or.inl hn)),
          ihb _ _ (fun n hn => h n (Or.inr hn))]
  | fOr a b iha ihb =>
    intro r r' h
    simp [rename, iha _ _ (fun n hn => h n (Or.inl hn)),
          ihb _ _ (fun n hn => h n (Or.inr hn))]
  | fAll a ih =>
    intro r r' h; simp [rename]
    exact ih _ _ (fun n hn => by
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k => simp [up, h k hn])
  | fEx a ih =>
    intro r r' h; simp [rename]
    exact ih _ _ (fun n hn => by
      cases n with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ k => simp [up, h k hn])

/-- Renamings agreeing pointwise act equally. -/
theorem rename_ext (f : Form) (r r' : Nat → Nat) (h : ∀ n, r n = r' n) :
    rename r f = rename r' f :=
  rename_ext_free f r r' (fun n _ => h n)

/-- Renaming composition. -/
theorem rename_comp (f : Form) :
    ∀ r r', rename r (rename r' f) = rename (fun n => r (r' n)) f := by
  induction f with
  | fMem i j => intro r r'; rfl
  | fEq i j => intro r r'; rfl
  | fBot => intro r r'; rfl
  | fImp a b iha ihb => intro r r'; simp [rename, iha, ihb]
  | fAnd a b iha ihb => intro r r'; simp [rename, iha, ihb]
  | fOr a b iha ihb => intro r r'; simp [rename, iha, ihb]
  | fAll a ih =>
    intro r r'; simp [rename, ih]
    exact rename_ext a _ _ (fun n => by cases n <;> simp [up])
  | fEx a ih =>
    intro r r'; simp [rename, ih]
    exact rename_ext a _ _ (fun n => by cases n <;> simp [up])

/-- Cons on renamings, and the identity `inst k ∘ up s = scons_nat k s`. -/
def scons_nat (k : Nat) (s : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat
  | 0 => k
  | m+1 => s m

theorem inst_up (k : Nat) (s : Nat → Nat) (n : Nat) :
    inst k (up s n) = scons_nat k s n := by
  cases n <;> rfl

theorem rename_inst_up (a : Form) (k : Nat) (s : Nat → Nat) :
    rename (inst k) (rename (up s) a) = rename (scons_nat k s) a := by
  rw [rename_comp]; exact rename_ext a _ _ (inst_up k s)

/-- Pushing a renaming `r` past an instantiation `inst k`: normalizes the
quantifier and equality-elimination cases of `Prov_rename`. -/
theorem rename_inst_push (a : Form) (r : Nat → Nat) (k : Nat) :
    rename r (rename (inst k) a) = rename (inst (r k)) (rename (up r) a) := by
  rw [rename_comp, rename_comp]
  exact rename_ext a _ _ (fun n => by cases n <;> rfl)
